local local_class = newclass('MovieMainSection16')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MovieMain @
		Comment = 가디언테일즈 촬영시작 ~ 가디언 테일즈 프롤로그 촬영 씬 @
		Index = 15 @
		NextSections = 16 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
    --베일/유진 대화 체크 여부
	self.talk_to_bale = false
	self.talk_to_euguene = false
    --분장 여부
	self.ischange = false
	self.eugene_background = nil

	self.starpiece_effect = nil

	self.retake_interact_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			local platform = get_field_object('eva_platform')
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, platform) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_eva, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	}

	self.kicked_dummy = false

	self.interact = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_sneak_headcrusher')

	self.eugene = get_character("eugene_1")
	self.bale = get_character("bale_1")
	self.staff1 = get_character("Staff_1")
	self.staff2 = get_character("Staff_2")
	self.staff3 = get_character("Staff_3")
	self.staff5 = get_character("Staff_5")
	self.staff6 = get_character("Staff_6")
	self.eva = get_character("knight_captain")
	self.knight_zaco = get_character("knight_fake")
	self.bob = get_character("knight_bob")
	self.linda = get_character("knight_linda")
	self.princess = get_character("princess")
	self.eugene1 = get_character("eugene")

	-- 촬영 종료 여부 변수
	self.film_over = false

	-- 이건 인베이더의 위험성을 알릴 기회라구!
	self.bob.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_s16_70'

	-- 인베이더 놈들! 진실을 알려야 해 !
	self.linda.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_s16_71'

	-- 나… 난 출연 안 시켜줘?
	self.princess.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_s16_72'

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_plitvice_buff')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.retake_interact_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.retake_interact_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		self.retake_interact_handler = nil
	end

	if self.starpiece_effect ~= nil then
		self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
	end

	if self.bale ~= nil then
		self.bale.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.staff5 ~= nil then
		self.staff5.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.eva ~= nil then
		self.eva.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.eugene ~= nil then
		self.eugene.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.staff3 ~= nil then
		self.staff3.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.staff6 ~= nil then
		self.staff6.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.staff1 ~= nil then
		self.staff1.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.eugene_background ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.eugene_background.gameObject)
	end

	self.eugene = nil
	self.bale = nil
	self.staff1 = nil
	self.staff2 = nil
	self.staff3 = nil
	self.staff5 = nil
	self.staff6 = nil
	self.eva = nil
	self.knight_zaco = nil
	self.bob = nil
	self.linda = nil
	self.princess = nil
	self.eugene1 = nil
	self.eugene_background = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
  	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= 'movie_1_5' then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bale) and not self.interact then
			self.interact = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eva) and not self.interact then
			self.interact = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eva_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eugene) and not self.interact then
			self.interact = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff3) and not self.interact then
			self.interact = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff3_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff1) and not self.interact then
			self.interact = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff1_select, self))
		end
	end

	local excutable_intro = stage.Name == self.controller.stage_5_name and self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState('seen_stage5_intro') == -1
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) and excutable_intro then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.movie_1_5_start, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'change_check1' then

		if self.talk_to_bale == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_event, self))
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:change_event()

	if self.ischange == false then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		-- 이번씬에선 분장을 꼭 하셔야 해요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.staff1, { key = 'movie_s18_1', skip = true })
		party_util.align_to_target(user_party.Leader.Position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

end

	end

	if self.starpiece_effect ~= nil then
		self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
		self.starpiece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dummy_tab_process(retake)
	local eugene = get_character('eugine_zaco')
	local player = get_character('knight_fake')
	local eugene_dummy = get_field_object('dummy1')
	local player_dummy = get_field_object('dummy2')
	local current_tab_count = 0
	local tabable_duration = 15
	local max_tab_count = 25
	local max_anim_time_scale = 20
	local bale_cheer_time = 2
	local bale_cheer_time_passed = 0
	local hitter_effects = {}
	local hit_routines = {}
	local hit_animations = {
		'attack',
		'gauntlet_left_jap_attack',
		'gauntlet_right_jap_attack',
		'gauntlet_kick',
		'gauntlet_kick2'
	}
	local hit_times = { 0.25 }

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				bale_cheer_time_passed = 0
				current_tab_count = current_tab_count + 1
			end

			return true
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	local hit_process = function(hitter, data)
		local progress = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'progress', 0)
		local anim_scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'scale')
		local anim_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'name')
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(hitter, anim_name) / anim_scale

		local hit_time
		for i, name in ipairs(hit_animations) do
			if name == anim_name and hit_times[i] ~= nil then
				hit_time = hit_times[i] / anim_scale
			end
		end

		-- 맞는 시간이 세팅되있지않다면 sfx 콜백으로 처리
		if hit_time == nil then
			local sfx_handler = function(_, _)
				camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

				local dummy = lua_helper.reference_equals(hitter, eugene) and eugene_dummy or player_dummy
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.dummy_hit_reaction, self, dummy, math.max(0.25, anim_duration / 2)))
			end
			local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('gauntlet_combo_attack2', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true)
			req.loop = false
			req.sfxHandler = sfx_handler
			req.nextAnimation = 'idle'
			hitter:SetAnimation(req)

			wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		else
			character_util.set_anim(hitter, { name = anim_name, loop = false, scale = anim_scale, next_anim = 'idle' })

			wait_for_sec(hit_time)

			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

			local dummy = lua_helper.reference_equals(hitter, eugene) and eugene_dummy or player_dummy
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.dummy_hit_reaction, self, dummy, progress))

			wait_for_sec(anim_duration - hit_time)
		end
	end

	local bale_cheer_event = function(key)
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bale, { key = key, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = player.Position})
	end

	local fire_sfx
	local tap_sfx
	local tab_event_process = function()
		local tab_time_passed = 0
		local bale_cheer_routine
		local bale_cheer_key = 'bale_cheer_event_1'
		local playable_anims = { hit_animations[1] }
		local hitters = { player }

		-- 첫 촬영때만 유진이 더미를 때리게함.
		if not retake then
			table.insert(hitters, eugene)
			hit_routines[eugene] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(hit_process, eugene, { name = playable_anims[1], scale = 1 }))
		end

		hit_routines[player] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(hit_process, player, { name = playable_anims[1], scale = 1 }))

		while current_tab_count <= max_tab_count and tab_time_passed < tabable_duration do
			local tap_progress = current_tab_count / max_tab_count

			-- 더미 치는 애들의 몸에 불이 붙었을때부터 탭 타이머를 업데이트해줌
			if tap_progress > 0.25 then
				tab_time_passed = tab_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			-- 베일 응원 이벤트 처리
			-- 베일은 첫 촬영때만 응원 해줌.
			if not retake then
				bale_cheer_time_passed = math.min(bale_cheer_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime, bale_cheer_time)
				if bale_cheer_routine ~= nil then
					if bale_cheer_routine.IsDone then
						bale_cheer_time_passed = 0
						bale_cheer_routine = nil
					elseif bale_cheer_time_passed < bale_cheer_time then
						-- 베일이 응원해주던 도중 플레이어가 탭한 경우
						stop_coroutine(bale_cheer_routine)
						speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.bale)
						bale_cheer_routine = nil
					end
				else
					if bale_cheer_time_passed >= bale_cheer_time then
						bale_cheer_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(bale_cheer_event, bale_cheer_key))
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
						bale_cheer_key = bale_cheer_key == 'bale_cheer_event_2' and 'bale_cheer_event_1' or 'bale_cheer_event_2'
					end
				end
			end

			-- 탭 진행도에 따라 신규 히트 애니메이션을 넣어준다.
			local add_anim_step = 1 / #hit_animations
			if tap_progress > add_anim_step * #playable_anims then
				table.insert(playable_anims, hit_animations[#playable_anims + 1])
			end

			-- 탭 진행도가 절반을 넘었으면 때리는 애들의 몸에 불꽃 이펙트를 붙여준다.
			if tap_progress > 0.25 then
				local size = table_util.get_size(hitter_effects)
				if size == 0 then
					fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_03', loop = true, fade_out_time = 2 })
					tap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_pet_bite_loop_01', loop = true })
				end

				for _, hitter in ipairs(hitters) do
					if hitter_effects[hitter] == nil then
						music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted, 1.5)
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_fire_01')
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
						hitter_effects[hitter] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_plitvice_buff'):Instantiate(hitter.Position)
					end
				end
			end

			local anim_scale = 1 + tap_progress *  (max_anim_time_scale - 1)
			local anim_name = playable_anims[random_util.get_random_int(1, #playable_anims)]

			-- 더미 때리는 루틴을 실행시킬수있으면 실행
			for hitter, routine in pairs(hit_routines) do
				if routine.IsDone then
					hit_routines[hitter] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(hit_process, hitter, { name = anim_name, scale = anim_scale, progress = tap_progress }))
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		return current_tab_count >= max_tab_count
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	local kickable = tab_event_process()

	tap_sfx:Stop()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 남은 히트 루틴이 있다면 완료될때까지 기다려준다
	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(hit_routines)

	local rotate_dummy = function(dummy, target_angle, duration)
		local start_angle = 0

		local shadow = dummy.Transform:Find('shadow')
		shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local eval = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress)
			local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, target_angle, eval)

			dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up) *
					unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_angle, unity_class.vector3.right)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local kick_dummy = function(hitter, dummy)
		local sfx_handler = function(_, _)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(dummy.Position)

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_air_spin_01')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fall_down_01')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_shadow_beast_rush_01')

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(rotate_dummy, dummy, 1800, 1.5))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(sp_util.sine_move, dummy,
					{to = dummy.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 12, duration = 1.5, height = 8}))
			music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_heroic_moment", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 2)

		end
		local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('gauntlet_kick', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true)
		req.loop = false
		req.sfxHandler = sfx_handler
		req.nextAnimation = 'idle'
		hitter:SetAnimation(req)

		wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(hitter, 'gauntlet_kick'))

	end

	-- 발로 찰수있으면 허수아비를 발로 차버리고 에바에게서 스타피스를 받음.
	if kickable then
		local kick_routines = { util.cs_generator(kick_dummy, player, player_dummy) }

		-- 첫 촬영때만 유진이 발로 허수아비를 찰수있게 함.
		if not retake then
			table.insert(kick_routines, util.cs_generator(kick_dummy, eugene, eugene_dummy))
		end

		wait_all(kick_routines)

		-- 0.5초 정도 기다렸다 에바대사를 친다.
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 훌륭해!!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		local eva = retake and get_character('retake_eva') or get_character('knight_captain')
		eva:SetEmotion('burning', true)
		eva:SetAnimation('release', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'retake_guardian_scene_4', skip = true })
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
		eva:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	fire_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	for _, effect in pairs(hitter_effects) do
		effect:Dispose()
	end

	return kickable
end

function local_class:dummy_hit_reaction(dummy, tap_progress)
	local min_angle = 10
	local max_angle = 80
	local shadow = dummy.Transform:Find('shadow')
	local start_angle = 0
	local target_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(min_angle, max_angle, tap_progress)
	local duration = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.25, 0.15, tap_progress)

	-- 히트 이펙트 표시
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit"):Instantiate(dummy.Position)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local eval = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress)
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, target_angle, eval)

		dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_angle, unity_class.vector3.right)
		shadow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-cur_angle, unity_class.vector3.right)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up)
	shadow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
end

function local_class:interact_to_eva()
	local eva = get_character('retake_eva')
	local eva_png = 'knight_captain'

	local platform = get_field_object('eva_platform')
	party_util.align_party(platform.Position, 'right')

	if self.kicked_dummy then
		-- 역시 가디언 테스트 마지막 합격자 다운 허수아비 치기였어!
		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		eva:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		eva:SetAnimation('clap', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'retake_guardian_scene_4_1', skip = true, portraitname = eva_png })
		clap_sfx:Stop()

		-- 에바 몸의 스타피스 이펙트 제거
		if self.starpiece_effect ~= nil then
			self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
			self.starpiece_effect = nil
		end

		-- 스타피스를 던져줌
		local star_piece = get_field_object('prologue_starpiece')
		star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(eva.Position + unity_class.vector3.up))
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 에바한테 더이상 상호작용 못하게
		if self.retake_interact_handler ~= nil then
			local eva_platform = get_field_object('eva_platform')
			eva_platform.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.retake_interact_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
			self.retake_interact_handler = nil
		end
	else
		-- 방금찍은 가디언 트레이닝 씬 말인데..
		eva:SetAnimation('idle', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'retake_guardian_scene_1', skip = true, portraitname = eva_png })

		-- 가디언의 기상을 보여주기엔 좀 부족했다고 생각하지 않아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'retake_guardian_scene_2', skip = true, portraitname = eva_png })

		-- 허수아비를 날려버릴 정도로 더 빠르고 강하게 다시 찍어보는게 어떨까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'retake_guardian_scene_3', skip = true, portraitname = eva_png })

		-- 도전한다. / 아무것도 아니다.
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'retake_challenge', 'mercy' }, { 'no_retake', 'brutal' } })

		-- 재촬영을 선택했을때
		if choose_result == 1 then
			self:start_retake()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_retake()
	local player = get_character('knight_fake')
	local eva = get_character('retake_eva')
	local eugene = get_character('eugene_1')
	local bale = get_character('bale_1')
	local eugene_dummy = get_field_object('dummy1')
	local player_dummy = get_field_object('dummy2')
	local eva_png = 'knight_captain'

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	eugene.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	bale.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	eugene_dummy.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	player_dummy.Position = vector(-1, 0, 27)

	-- 유저가 자코 기사로 분장을 안했을경우에만 자코 기사로 바꿔준다.
	local pre_convert_leader = user_party.Leader
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('knight_fake'), pre_convert_leader) then
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(player)
	end

	character_util.set_position(player, player_dummy.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.75)
	player.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	player:RemoveEmotion()
	player:RemoveAnimation()

	camera_util.move(vector(0, 0, 31), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(vector(0, 0, 27), 3)

	local player_hit_dummy = function()
		for _= 1, 6 do
			character_util.set_anim(player, {name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})

			wait_for_sec(0.25)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dummy_hit_reaction, self, player_dummy, 0.25))

			wait_for_sec(0.35)
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 더미 다 칠때까지 대기
	player_hit_dummy()

	-- 더미 탭 프로세스
	local kick_success = self:dummy_tab_process(true)

	self.kicked_dummy = kick_success

	if not kick_success then
		-- 아직 부족해..
		eva:SetEmotion('tired', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, {key = 'retake_guardian_scene_5', skip = true, portraitname = eva_png})
		eva:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(pre_convert_leader, user_party.Leader) then
		local origin_leader_info = user.Party[0]
		local origin_leader_name = CS.Oak.PartyUtil.GeneratePartyName(user.Party, origin_leader_info)
		local origin_leader = get_character(origin_leader_name)

		-- 스테이지에 입장했을때의 리더로 변환해야하는 경우에는 파티까지 전부 붙여준다.
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(pre_convert_leader, origin_leader) then
			party_manager:RestorePlayerParty()
		else
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(pre_convert_leader)
		end
	end

	user_party.Leader.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	party_util.position_party(vector(0, 0, 26), 'left', 'arc')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 현재 리더가 자코가 아니라면 사용한 자코를 우주로 보내준다.
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('knight_fake'), user_party.Leader) then
		character_util.set_position(get_character('knight_fake'), unity_class.vector3.one * 999)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.retake_interact_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.retake_interact_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		self.retake_interact_handler = nil
	end

	if self.touch_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	self.trio1.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.trio2.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.trio3.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local diameter = 1
	local bombing_area = field:GetZone('bombing_area').Bounds
	local area_width = math.floor(bombing_area.size.x)
	local area_height = math.floor(bombing_area.size.z)
	local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(bombing_area.center) + unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) + unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
	for y = 0, area_height - 1 do
		for x = 0, area_width - 1 do
			local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (diameter / 2.0 + x)
			local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (diameter / 2.0 + y)
			local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset
			table.insert(self.bombing_points, target_point)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= 'movie_1_5' then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bale) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_select2, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eugene) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff1) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff1_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff3) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff3_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.trio1) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trio1_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.trio2) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trio2_select, self)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.trio3) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trio3_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bombing_kkondae')) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_kkondae, self)
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) then
		if e.IsComplete then
			self.timer_over = true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'change_check2' then

		if self.ischange == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_event, self))
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:start_timer(duration)
	self.timer_over = false

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer);

	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, duration, nil,
						CS.Oak.InGameTimer.TimerType.DeltaTime)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
end

function local_class:end_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end

		rest = 2

	local staffs_throw_type = { throw_types.random, throw_types.to_player, throw_types.random }
	local staff_routines = {}

	-- 폭탄에 맞을때의 리액션

		target:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

		local fly_time = 0.75
		target.SpineController:Rotate(720, fly_time)
		character_util.jump(target, 2.5, fly_time)
		wait_for_sec(fly_time)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

		-- NG 이벤트가 판정되지않았을떄만 다시 일어서도록 함.
		if current_hit_count < max_hit_count then
			target:Shake(0.05, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			target:RemoveEmotion()
			target:SetAnimation('get', true)
			character_util.jump(target, 0.5, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			target:RemoveAnimation()
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	-- 폭탄에 맞을때 불리는 콜백
	local hit_cb = function(hit_target)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, self.eugene) then

			-- 이벤트가 종료 판정이 났다면 폭탄에 맞지 않도록 함.
			if self.timer_over or current_hit_count >= max_hit_count then return end

			-- 폭탄을 맞아서 리액션 중일때는 NG 판정이 안되도록 함.
			if hit_reaction_routines[hit_target] ~= nil and not hit_reaction_routines[hit_target].IsDone then return end

			current_hit_count = current_hit_count + 1

			hit_reaction_routines[hit_target] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(hit_reaction, hit_target))
		end
	end

	self:start_timer(bombing_duration)

	while true do

		-- 이벤트 종료 판정이 났다면 플레이어 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 종료
		if self.timer_over or current_hit_count >= max_hit_count then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			-- 타이머 종료
			self:end_timer()

			-- 모든 폭탄 리액션이 끝날때까지 기다려준다.
			coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(hit_reaction_routines)

			return self.timer_over
		end

		-- 스태프들 폭탄 던지는 거 처리
		for i, staff in ipairs(staffs) do
			local state = staff_states[staff]
			local routine = staff_routines[staff]
			local bomb = self.throw_bombs[staff]

			if state == staff_state.throwing then
				if routine == nil then
					local throw_type = staffs_throw_type[i]
					local shoot_point
					if throw_type == throw_types.to_player then
						shoot_point = user_party.Leader.Position
					else
						shoot_point = self.bombing_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.bombing_points)]
					end

					staff_routines[staff] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.throw_bomb, self, staff, bomb, shoot_point, nil, hit_cb))
				elseif routine.IsDone then
					if staffs_rest_duration[i] > 0 then
						staff_states[staff] = staff_state.rest
					end
					staff_routines[staff] = nil
				end
			elseif state == staff_state.rest then
				if routine == nil then
					staff_routines[staff] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(wait_for_sec, staffs_rest_duration[i]))
				elseif routine.IsDone then
					staff_states[staff] = staff_state.throwing
					staff_routines[staff] = nil
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:mass_bombing_event()
	local player = user_party.Leader
	local eugene = self.eugene
	local shoot_bomb_count = 20

	player.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	player:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	eugene.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	eugene:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	eugene:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	local shoot_points = {}
	table.insert(shoot_points, player.Position)
	table.insert(shoot_points, eugene.Position)

	local player_point_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(player.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * self.bomb_radius * 2)
	local eugene_point_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(eugene.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * self.bomb_radius * 2)
	local available_shoot_points = {}
	for _, point in ipairs(self.bombing_points) do
		if not player_point_bound:Contains(point) and not eugene_point_bound:Contains(point) then
			table.insert(available_shoot_points, point)
		end
	end

	local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = shoot_bomb_count})
	for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
		table.insert(shoot_points, point)
	end

	local attack_ranges = {}
	for i, point in ipairs(shoot_points) do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_fire_01')
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.bomb_radius)
		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, point, 0)
		attack_range_util.hide(attack_range)


		local progress = (i + .0) / #shoot_points
		local show_time = unity_class.random.value * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.25, 0.05, progress)

		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, show_time)

		wait_for_sec(show_time)

		table.insert(attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end

	-- 공격범위가 올라온씬을 0.5초정도 보여준다.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local throw_bomb = function(attack_range, bomb, speed, explode_cb)
		local throw_speed = speed or 8
		local time_passed = 0

		bomb.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(get_character('bombing_staff_1').Position)
		local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(attack_range.transform.position)
		local dist = (shoot_pos - start_pos).magnitude
		local throw_duration = dist / throw_speed
		while time_passed < throw_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / throw_duration)
			local cur_h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 7

			bomb.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, shoot_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_h

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

		bomb.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Explosion_Bomb_new"):Instantiate(shoot_pos)

		local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(shoot_pos, self.bomb_radius)
		for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
			local fo = collide_objs[i]

			if explode_cb ~= nil then
				explode_cb(fo)
			end
		end

		collide_objs:Dispose()
	end

	local fly_routines = {}
	local fly_process = function(target)
		target.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
		target:SetEmotion('confused', true)
		target:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

		target.SpineController:Rotate(1080, 1)
		character_util.jump(target, 6, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local cb = function(hit_target)
		if fly_routines[hit_target] == nil and (lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, player) or lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, eugene)) then
			fly_routines[hit_target] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
										util.cs_generator(fly_process, hit_target))
		end
	end

	-- 폭탄 대량 투하
	for i, range in ipairs(attack_ranges) do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				throw_bomb, range, self.mass_bombs[i], 8 + unity_class.random.value * 8, cb))
	end

	-- 주인공과 유진이 맞을떄까지 대기

	while true do
		if table_util.get_size(fly_routines) >= 2 then
			coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(fly_routines)
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:throw_bomb(staff, bomb, shoot_pos, speed, explode_cb)
	local throw_speed = speed or 8
	local time_passed = 0

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_fire_01')
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(shoot_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, self.bomb_radius)
	attack_range:Show()

	bomb.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(staff.Position)
	local dist = (shoot_pos - start_pos).magnitude
	local throw_duration = dist / throw_speed
	while time_passed < throw_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / throw_duration)
		local cur_h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 7

		bomb.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, shoot_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_h

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

	bomb.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Explosion_Bomb_new"):Instantiate(shoot_pos)

	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(shoot_pos, self.bomb_radius)

	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if explode_cb ~= nil then
			explode_cb(fo)
		else
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, get_character('eugene_1')) then
				fo.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
			end
		end
	end

	collide_objs:Dispose()
end

function local_class:start_filming()
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted, 2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_enemy_attack", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)

	local selected_party = user.Party
	for i = 1, selected_party.Count - 1 do
		local info = selected_party[i]
		local character_name = CS.Oak.PartyUtil.GeneratePartyName(selected_party, info)
		local character = get_character(character_name)
		character.Position = vector(22+i, 0, 24)
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'up')
	end

	-- FIXME: 재시작할떄마다 프리로드 하는게 별로 안좋아보임. 캐싱을 해두는게 좋을듯?
	-- 연출에서 쓸 폭탄을 런타임에 프리로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local tileset = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'tilesets/gimmick', 'gimmick.tileset')
	local bomb = tileset.transform:Find('[GIMMICK]bomb1')

	local idx = 1
	local throw_staffs = {}
	while true do
		local staff = get_character('bombing_staff_' .. idx)
		if staff == nil then
			break
		end

		table.insert(throw_staffs, staff)
		idx = idx + 1
	end

	self.throw_bombs = {}
	for _, npc in ipairs(throw_staffs) do
		local clone_bomb = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb)
		clone_bomb.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.throw_bombs[npc] = clone_bomb
	end

	local offsets = { 0.75, 0.55, 0.55 }
	for i, staff in ipairs(throw_staffs) do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(staff.Name .. '_stand')
		local bomb = self.throw_bombs[staff]

		staff.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(marker.position, 1)
		staff.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		staff:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		staff:SetAnimation('hold_loop', true)
		bomb.transform.position = staff.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * offsets[i]
	end

	self.mass_bombs = {}
	for _ = 1, #self.bombing_points do
		local clone_bomb = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb)
		clone_bomb.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		clone_bomb.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		table.insert(self.mass_bombs, clone_bomb)
	end

	-- NPC 폭탄hold
	local npc_bombs = {}
	local npcs = {self.bob, self.princess, self.eva, self.linda}
	local positions = {vector(22, 1, 33), vector(24, 1 ,33 ), vector(26, 1 ,33 ), vector(28, 1 ,33 )}
	for i, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
		npc.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
		npc:SetEmotion('greed', true)
		npc:SetAnimation('hold_loop', true)
		npc.Position = positions[i]

		local clone_bomb = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb)
		clone_bomb.transform.position = npc.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.9
		clone_bomb.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		table.insert(npc_bombs, clone_bomb)
	end

	res_holder:Dispose()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(tileset)

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(25, 0, 27))
	user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')
	user_party.Leader:RemoveEmotion()
	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()

	self.eugene.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.5
	self.eugene.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')
	self.eugene:RemoveEmotion()
	self.eugene:RemoveAnimation()

	character_util.set_direction(self.bale, "up")
	character_util.set_direction(self.staff5, "right")
	character_util.set_direction(self.staff2, "left")

	self.staff5:SetAnimation("release", true)
	self.bale:SetAnimation("release", true)
	self.staff2:SetAnimation("attack", true)
	self.staff5:SetEmotion("smile", true)
	self.staff2:SetEmotion("smile", true)

	character_util.set_position(self.staff5, vector(18, 0, 26))
	character_util.set_position(self.staff2, vector(31, 0, 26))
	character_util.set_position(self.bale, vector(26, 1, 23))

	self.bale.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	camera_util.move(vector(25, 0, 33), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(4)

	--액션!!
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_movie_end_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bale, {key = 'movie_s17_13', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = user_party.Leader.Position, skip = true})

	-- 유진 파티에 붙여줌
	if not user_party:Contains(self.eugene) then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.eugene, user_party)
	end

	-- NPC들이 들고있던 폭탄 제거
	for _, bomb in ipairs(npc_bombs) do
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bomb.gameObject)
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.controller.stage5_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	local success = self:bombing_process(8)

	if success then
		self:end_filming_event()
	else
		self:ng_event()
	end

	if self.throw_bombs ~= nil then
		for _, bomb in pairs(self.throw_bombs) do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(bomb.gameObject)
		end
		self.throw_bombs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:start_retake()
	local kkondae = get_character('bombing_kkondae')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local diameter = 1
	local bombing_area = field:GetZone('bombing_area').Bounds
	local area_width = math.floor(bombing_area.size.x)
	local area_height = math.floor(bombing_area.size.z)
	local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(bombing_area.center) + unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) + unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
	self.bombing_points = {}
	for y = 0, area_height - 1 do
		for x = 0, area_width - 1 do
			local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (diameter / 2.0 + x)
			local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (diameter / 2.0 + y)
			local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset
			table.insert(self.bombing_points, target_point)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.Position = vector(22 + i, 0, 24)
		member.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')
	end

	local unnecessary_npcs = {

	}
	for _, npc in ipairs(unnecessary_npcs) do

	end

		end

	end

	local tileset = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'tilesets/gimmick', 'gimmick.tileset')
	local bomb = tileset.transform:Find('[GIMMICK]bomb1')

	self.throw_bombs = {}
	for _, npc in ipairs(throw_staffs) do
		local clone_bomb = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb)
		clone_bomb.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.throw_bombs[npc] = clone_bomb
	end

	local offsets = { 0.75, 0.55, 0.55 }
	for i, staff in ipairs(throw_staffs) do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(staff.Name .. '_stand')
		local bomb = self.throw_bombs[staff]

		staff.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(marker.position, 1)
		staff.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		staff:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		staff:SetAnimation('hold_loop', true)
		bomb.transform.position = staff.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * offsets[i]
	end

	res_holder:Dispose()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(tileset)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(4)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	local success = self:bombing_process(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	kkondae.Position = vector(20, 0, 4.5)
	kkondae.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	kkondae:RemoveEmotion()
	kkondae:RemoveAnimation()

	party_util.position_party(kkondae.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 'left')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if success then
		-- 전성기 시절 나를 보는것 같군! 훌륭해!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		kkondae:SetEmotion('smile', true)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kkondae, {key = 'retake_bombing_scene_6', skip =true})
		kkondae:RemoveAnimation()

			self.starpiece_effect:Dispose()

		star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(kkondae.Position + unity_class.vector3.up))
		wait_for_sec(2)

		kkondae:RemoveAnimation()

function local_class:wire_qte()
	local start_pos = vector(49.5, 12, 26)
	local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos, 2)
	local qte_success = true
	local move_duration = 10
	local angular_accel = 0.5
	local angular_speed = 0
	local current_angle = 0
	local swipe_power = 2

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, start_pos, 1)

	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				angular_speed = angular_speed + swipe_power

			elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				angular_speed = angular_speed - swipe_power
			end

			return true
		end
	}
	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	local player_fall = function()
		local rotate_count = 4
		local fall_speed = 26
		local dist = (end_pos - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude
		local fall_duration = dist / fall_speed

		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

		camera_util.move(end_pos, fall_duration)

		-- TODO: 플레이어 뱅글뱅글 돌게해야함.
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:Rotate(360 * rotate_count - current_angle, fall_duration)
        music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, end_pos, nil, fall_speed)

		user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	end

	-- 스와이프 가이드 이벤트 부분

	local guide_angle = 25
	local swipe_success = false
	local played_left_swipe = false
	local played_right_swipe = false
	local guide_routine
	local current_guide_dir

	local swipe_guide_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			local swipe_dir = current_guide_dir  == 'left' and CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft or CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight
			swipe_success = e.TouchEventType == swipe_dir

			return true
		end
	}

	local swipe_guide_event = function(dir_str)
		local guide_duration = 2
		swipe_success = false

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

		current_guide_dir = dir_str
		message_system:Subscribe(swipe_guide_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_tap_guide_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(dir_str)

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < guide_duration and not swipe_success do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(swipe_guide_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

		guide_routine = nil
	end

	camera_util.move(end_pos, move_duration)

	local rope_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true})

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < move_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_duration)

		-- TODO: 등가속 운동 말고 가속운동으로 만들어보기?
		local sign = current_angle < 0 and -1 or 1
		angular_speed = angular_speed + (sign * angular_accel * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		current_angle = current_angle + angular_speed

		user_party.Leader.SpineController:Rotate(current_angle, 0)
		user_party.Leader.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		if guide_routine == nil then
			if current_angle > guide_angle and not played_right_swipe then
				played_right_swipe = true
				guide_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(swipe_guide_event, 'right'))
			elseif current_angle < -1 * guide_angle and not played_left_swipe then
				played_left_swipe = true
				guide_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(swipe_guide_event, 'left'))
			end
		end

		-- 플레이어가 180도 이상 돌아버렸다면 추락후 NG 이벤트 실행
		if math.abs(current_angle) > 180 then
			qte_success = false
			rope_sfx:Stop()
			player_fall()
			self:ng_event()
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	rope_sfx:Stop()

	-- 가이드 루틴 해제
	if guide_routine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(guide_routine)
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(swipe_guide_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		guide_routine = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

function local_class:staff1_select()
	if self.ischange then

		self.staff1:SetAnimation("release", true)
		self.staff1:SetEmotion("smile", true)
		-- 분장이 너무 훌륭하다고 생각하지 않아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.staff1, { key = 'movie_s18_2'})
		self.staff1:SetAnimation("idle", true)
		self.staff1:SetEmotion("idel", true)
	end

	if self.ischange == false then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		party_util.align_party(self.staff1, 'right', 1, 'linear')
		--분장을 시작 하시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.staff1, { key = 'movie_s18_1_1', skip = true })

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local wait = true
		local go = false

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_s18_1_2"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				go = true;
				wait = false;

			end
		})

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_s16_45"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				go = false;
				wait = false;

			end

		})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)
		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if go then
			self.ischange = true
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equipping_01')
			user_party.Leader:SetAnimation("eat", true)
			wait_for_sec(1)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, get_character('knight_dark')) == false then
				local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1
				for i = 1, loop_count do
					user_party[i].Position = vector(45, 0, 50-i)
				end

				character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(45, 0, 50))
				--복장 바뀜 /구현필요
				local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
				param.HidePreviousParty = false
				CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(get_character('knight_dark'), param)
				character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(47, 0, 8))
				character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, "left")
				character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

				wait_for_sec(0.25)
			end

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			coroutine.yield()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
            --이떄 마커는 포지션(맵 위치가 맞음)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.stage5_marker_name, vector(50, 1, 20))
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_costume_equip_01')
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		end
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= 'movie_1_5' then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and self.ischange == false then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff1) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff1_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bale) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eugene) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_select, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('shooting_kkondae')) then
			local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(60005)
			if self.film_over or main_quest.InnerProgress > 18 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_kkondae, self)
			else
				-- 라떼는 말이야 날아가는 모기한마리도 눈을 감고 맞출 수 있었다고!
				local kkondae = get_character('shooting_kkondae')
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kkondae)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kkondae, { key = 'retake_shooting_scene_1', skip = true })
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'change_check4' then

		if self.ischange == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
		end

		if self.ischange == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_event, self))
		end

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:fly_reaction(target)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fall_down_01')

	character_util.stop(target)
	target.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')

	target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	character_util.spine_rotate(target, 1080, fly_duration)

			table.remove(self.npcs_to_shoot, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_energy_ball()
	local prepare_duration = 6
	local speed = 20
	local radius = 0.3
	local energy_ball
	local charge_effect
	local black_aura
	local offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0.25)
	local ball_max_scale = 0.3
	local charge_max_scale = 0.4
	local rotate_angle = 60
	local rotate_speed = 1.25
	local shotable_duration = prepare_duration / 3
	local radius_ratio = 1.6

	local shoot_process = function(energy_ball, direction)
		local life_time = 7
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < life_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local hit = false
			local hit_ifos = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(energy_ball.transform.position, radius)
			for i = 0, hit_ifos.Count - 1 do
				local target = hit_ifos[i]
				hit = table_util.contain_value(self.npcs_to_shoot, target) or lua_helper.type_compare(target.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour)

				if table_util.contain_value(self.npcs_to_shoot, target) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fly_reaction, self, target))
					break
				elseif lua_helper.type_compare(target.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_field_object('starpiece_dummy')) then
						self.current_target_hit_count = self.current_target_hit_count + 1
						self:update_count_ui(target, self.starpiece_game_hit_count - self.current_target_hit_count)
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_dummy, self, target, 50, 0.25))
					end

					break
				end
			end
			hit_ifos:Dispose()

			-- 무언가에 맞았다면 루프 탈출
			if hit then
				break
			end

			energy_ball.transform.position = energy_ball.transform.position + direction * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_impact_lightning_01')
		local explosion = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj_Explosion'):Instantiate(energy_ball.transform.position)
		explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

		energy_ball:Dispose()

		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count - 1
		self:update_ammo_ui(self.shoot_count)
	end

	-- 총 충전 최소시간을 만족하지못했을떄 발생하는 이벤트
	local shoot_fail_reaction = function()
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 베일이 같은 카메라 그리드 안에있을때만 리더에게 무기 쏘는 팁을 알려주도록함.
		local bale = get_character('bale_1')
		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, bale.Position) then
			-- 특수제작한 소품이라 버튼을 일정시간 눌러 예열을 시켜야 해!
			bale:SetEmotion('attack', true)
			bale:SetAnimation('release', true)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bale, { key = 'movie5_shooting_fail', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
			bale:RemoveEmotion()
			bale:RemoveAnimation()
		end

		user_party.Leader:RemoveEmotion()
		user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('boong_attack_ready_loop', true)

	energy_ball = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Chapter6_Sapa_energyball'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + offset)
	charge_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Chapter6_Sapa_energyball_cast'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + offset)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, shotable_duration))

	local charge_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_flower_charge_01', loop = true})

	local start_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
	local current_dir
	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawSphere(energy_ball.transform.position, radius, unity_class.color.red)

		-- 공 발사 여부 업데이트
		if self.player_touch_state ~= 'touchdown' or time_passed >= prepare_duration then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

			charge_sfx:Stop()

			if charge_effect ~= nil then
				charge_effect:Dispose()
			end

			if black_aura ~= nil then
				black_aura:Dispose()
			end

			if time_passed >= shotable_duration then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_dark_magician_shoot_01')
				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
				shoot_process(energy_ball, current_dir)
				break
			else
				energy_ball:Dispose()
				shoot_fail_reaction()
				break
			end
		end

		-- 공을 쏠수있는 시간이 됐다면 검은색 아우라 이펙트를 붙여줌
		if time_passed >= shotable_duration and black_aura == nil then
			black_aura = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char_black'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
		end

		-- 공이랑 캐스트 이펙트 크기 & 반지름 업데이트
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / prepare_duration)
		energy_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.1, ball_max_scale, progress)
		charge_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.1, charge_max_scale, progress)
		radius = energy_ball.transform.localScale.x * radius_ratio

		-- 공이랑 캐스트 이펙트 위치 업데이트
		local sine_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(time_passed * rotate_speed) * -1
		local current_angle = rotate_angle * sine_val
		current_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(current_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * start_dir
		local ball_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + current_dir
		energy_ball.transform.position = ball_pos
		charge_effect.transform.position = ball_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.shooting_routine = nil
end

function local_class:player_shooting_event()
	self.npcs_to_shoot = { get_character('eugene_1'), get_character('knight_captain'), get_character('princess') }
	self.shoot_count = 10

	for _, npc in ipairs(self.npcs_to_shoot) do
		npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 공격버튼 활성화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'shooting_event_touch_process')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	-- 모든 배우를 다 맞추거나 총알이 다 소진 될떄까지 대기
	while #self.npcs_to_shoot ~= 0 and self.shoot_count > 0 do coroutine.yield() end

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	return #self.npcs_to_shoot <= 0
end

function local_class:move_spike(spike, waypoints, speed)
	local move = function(to, speed)
		local from = spike.Position
		local dist = (to - from).magnitude
		local duration = dist / speed

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(from, to, progress)

			spike.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		spike.Position = to
	end

	while true do
		for _, point in ipairs(waypoints) do
			move(point, speed)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:rotate_dummy(dummy, target_angle, duration)
	local start_angle = 0

	local shadow = dummy.Transform:Find('shadow')
	shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local eval = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress)
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, target_angle, eval)

		dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.up) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_angle, unity_class.vector3.right)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	dummy.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
end

function local_class:retake_shooting_event()
	self.shoot_count = self.starpiece_game_max_ammo
	self.current_target_hit_count = 0

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 공격버튼 활성화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'shooting_event_touch_process')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	-- 타겟 적중 횟수를 다 채우거나 총알이 다 소진 될떄까지 대기
	while self.shoot_count > 0 and self.current_target_hit_count < self.starpiece_game_hit_count do coroutine.yield() end

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	return self.current_target_hit_count >= self.starpiece_game_hit_count
end

function local_class:attach_count_ui(target, count)
	local offset = vector(0, 1, 0.5)
	local ui = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIDuelBuffState'):Instantiate(target.transform.position + offset)
	local tmp = ui.transform:Find('BuffCountText'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))
	ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(false)
	tmp.text = count

	self.count_uis[target] = ui
end

function local_class:update_count_ui(target, value)
	local ui = self.count_uis[target]
	if ui ~= nil then
		local tmp = ui.transform:Find('BuffCountText'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))
		tmp.text = value
	end
end

function local_class:detach_count_ui(target)
	local ui = self.count_uis[target]
	if ui ~= nil then
		ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(true)
		ui:Dispose()
		self.count_uis[target] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:attach_ammo_ui(target, count)
	local offset = vector(0, 1, 0.5)
	self.ammo_ui = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIDuelBuffState'):Instantiate(target.Position + offset)

	self.ammo_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(false)

function local_class:update_ammo_ui(value)

function local_class:detach_ammon_ui()
	if self.ammo_ui ~= nil then
		self.ammo_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.ammo_ui:Dispose()
		self.ammo_ui = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	self:setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우 시작 이벤트를 실행시킴
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(94.5, 0, 16))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.invader_director = nil
	self.teatan_fat = nil
	self.crowd_list = nil
	self.reporter = nil

	self.throw_rock_routine = nil

	self.crowd_list = nil
	self.battle_zone_staff_list = nil
	self.battle_zone_stuntman_list = nil

	self.nicole = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.crowd_zone_name and self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_crowd then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_crowd

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crowd_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.interview_zone_name and self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_invader_director_event then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_invader_director_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interview_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name and self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_battle_event then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_battle_event

		self:battle_event()
	elseif zone_name == self.manhole_1_name or zone_name == self.manhole_2_name or zone_name == self.concert_1_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(94.5, 0, 16))
	elseif zone_name == self.manhole_under_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(123, 0, 172))
	elseif zone_name == self.concert_2_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(-20, 0, 95))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and e.CameraGrid.name == self.interview_camera_grid_name and
			self.event_progress >= EventProgress.see_invader_director_event then
		if self.throw_rock_routine == nil then
			self.throw_rock_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_event, self, self.thorw_rock_event_included_player))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and e.CameraGrid.name == self.interview_camera_grid_name and
			self.event_progress >= EventProgress.see_invader_director_event then
		if self.throw_rock_routine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.throw_rock_routine)
			self.throw_rock_routine = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_actor, self))
	end
end

-- 관중들이 티탄 여자와 주인공에게 돌 던지는 이벤트
function local_class:throw_rock_event(include_player)
	-- 랜덤으로 던지는 방향, 몇 번째 NPC가 던지는지, 던지고 나서 다음 던질 때까지의 대기 시간을 설정함
	local rand_dir = 0
	local rand_index = 0
	local rand_delay = 0
	local rand_talk = 0
	local check_target = 0

	while true do
		rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
		rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, self.crowd_list.Count))
		rand_delay = unity_class.random.Range(0.2, 0.5)

		local thrower = self.crowd_list[rand_index]

		if include_player then
			check_target = check_target + 1
		end

		if check_target < 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_target, self, thrower, self.teatan_fat))
		else
			check_target = 0

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_target, self, thrower, user_party_leader))
		end

		rand_talk = rand_talk + 1

		if rand_talk == 10 then
			rand_talk = 0

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(thrower, { key = 'movie_main_s2_crowd_2', skip = false })
		end

		wait_for_sec(rand_delay)
	end
end

-- 돌 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_swing_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "attack", loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = self.rock_item_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "02_hit_projectile_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
	if (rock.Position - target.Position).magnitude < 0.5 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_npc_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

-- 촬영장에서 니콜과 엑스트라와 싸우는 이벤트
function local_class:battle_event()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	-- 배틀게이트 닫힘
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i))
	end

	-- 스턴트맨과 니콜 적으로 변경
	for i = 0, self.battle_zone_stuntman_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.battle_zone_stuntman_list[i], self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
		command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(
				self.battle_zone_stuntman_list[i], user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	end

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.nicole, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
	command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(
			self.nicole, user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	character_util.set_death_type(self.nicole, "prostrate")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= 'movie_1_5' then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and self.ischange == false then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.staff1) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff1_select, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bale) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_select, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and not self.eugene_hp_lower_half then
		local target = e.Info.target
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.eugene) and target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio <= 0.5 then
			self.eugene_hp_lower_half = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eugene_half_hp_event, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		return false
	end

	if e.Zone.Name == 'change_check5' then

		if self.ischange == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_event, self))
		end

	end
	return false
end

		local start_pos = self.champion_sword.Position

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
			local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, target_angle, progress)

			self.champion_sword.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) *
					unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
			self.champion_sword.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self.champion_sword.Position = target_pos
		self.champion_sword.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(target_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) *

function local_class:staff1_select()

	if self.ischange and self.film_over == false then

		self.staff1:SetAnimation("release", true)
		self.staff1:SetEmotion("smile", true)
		-- 분장이 너무 훌륭하다고 생각하지 않아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.staff1, { key = 'movie_s18_2', skip = true })
		self.staff1:SetAnimation("idle", true)
		self.staff1:SetEmotion("idel", true)
	end

	if self.ischange == false then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		party_util.align_party(self.staff1, 'right', 1, 'linear')
		--분장을 시작 하시겠어요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.staff1, { key = 'movie_s18_1_1', skip = true })

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local wait = true
		local go = false

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_s18_1_2"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				go = true;
				wait = false;

			end
		})

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_s16_45"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				go = false;
				wait = false;

			end

		})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)
		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if go then
			self.ischange = true
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equipping_01')
			user_party.Leader:SetAnimation("eat", true)
			wait_for_sec(1)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, get_character('knight_dark')) == false then
				local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1
				for i = 1, loop_count do
					user_party[i].Position = vector(40, 0, 31-i)
				end

				character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(40, 0, 31))
				--복장 바뀜 /구현필요
				local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
				param.HidePreviousParty = false
				CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(get_character('knight_dark'), param)
				character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(98, 0, 9))
				character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, "left")
				user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
				wait_for_sec(1)
			end

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			coroutine.yield()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.stage5_marker_name, self.bale)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_costume_equip_01')
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		end
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

end

function local_class:bomb_defuse_event(e)
	if e.isDefused then
		-- 인터렉트 해체 완료 이벤트 발생
		if e.bomb.name=='event_bomb_1' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_end_event, self))
		elseif e.bomb.name=='event_bomb_2' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_2_end_event, self))
		elseif e.bomb.name=='event_bomb_3' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_3_end_event, self))
		end

	else return
		-- 인터렉트 해체 시작 이벤트 발생
	end
end


-- 배틀 게이트 온오프 함수: 매뉴얼 타입이 트루이면 클로즈, 거짓이면 오픈
function local_class:gate_manual_controll(manual_type,battle_num, length)
	if manual_type then
		for i=1, length do
			local temp_name = "battle_".. battle_num .."_gate_".. i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end

	elseif not manual_type then
		for i=1, length do
			local temp_name = "battle_".. battle_num .."_gate_".. i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end
	end
	return
end

-- 인트로 이벤트: 관객 입장 연출
function local_class:intro_audience()
	local audience_1 = get_character('audience_1')
	local audience_2 = get_character('audience_2')
	local audience_3 = get_character('audience_3')
	local staff_3 = get_character('staff_3')

	character_util.set_emotion(staff_3, {name = "sleep"})
	character_util.set_anim(staff_3, {name = "seat"})

	character_util.move_waypoint(audience_2,
	{vector(-1,0,-15),
	vector(-1,0,-4),
	vector(-4,0,-4)
	}, 6, true, "stop", "floor", "right", "01_dash_01")

	character_util.move_waypoint(audience_1,
	{vector(0,0,-15),
	vector(0,0,-4),
	vector(1,0,-4)
	}, 4, false, "stop", "floor", "up", "01_dash_01")

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(audience_3,
	{vector(0,0,-15),
	vector(0,0,-4),
	vector(-3,0,-4)
	}, 5, false, "stop", "floor", "left", "01_dash_01")

	character_util.set_emotion(audience_2, {name = "awesome"})
	character_util.set_anim(audience_2, {name = "release"})
	character_util.set_emotion(audience_3, {name = "smile"})
	character_util.set_anim(audience_3, {name = "nod"})

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_anim(audience_1, {name = "hold_loop"})

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.jump(audience_1, 0.5, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	character_util.remove_anim(audience_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(audience_3)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.jump(audience_1, 0.5, 0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,util.cs_generator(character_util.jump, audience_2, 1, 0.5))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(audience_2, vector(-4,1,-5), 5, false, "stop", "floor", "up")
	character_util.set_position(audience_2, vector(-4,0.5,-5), false)
	character_util.set_anim(audience_2, {name = "seat"})

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,util.cs_generator(character_util.jump, audience_3, 1, 0.5))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(audience_3, vector(-3,1,-5), 5, false, "stop", "floor", "up")
	character_util.set_position(audience_3, vector(-3,0.5,-5), false)
	character_util.set_anim(audience_3, {name = "seat"})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(audience_1)
	character_util.set_direction(audience_1, "left")
	character_util.set_anim(audience_1, {name = "sing"})
	character_util.set_emotion(audience_1, {name = "love"})
	return

	local cosplayer_3 = get_character('cosplayer_3')
	local cosplayer_4 = get_character('cosplayer_4')
	local cosplayer_5 = get_character('cosplayer_5')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- batman_eugene: (smile, victory_get) 정의의 히어로! 배트퀸!
	character_util.set_direction(cosplayer_1,"right")
	character_util.set_anim(cosplayer_1, {name = "victory_extra"})
	character_util.set_emotion(cosplayer_1, {name = "smile"})
