	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cosplayer_1, {key="movie_s21_cosplayer_1", typespeed = 3, bubble_direction = 'ct'})
	-- 정의의 히어로! 배트퀸!

	character_util.set_direction(cosplayer_2,"left")
	character_util.set_anim(cosplayer_2, {name = "victory_extra"})
	character_util.set_emotion(cosplayer_2, {name = "smile"})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- kingsman_eugene: (idle, idle) manner, maketh, man
	character_util.set_direction(cosplayer_3,"left")
	character_util.set_anim(cosplayer_3, {name = "cross_arm"})
	character_util.set_emotion(cosplayer_3, {name = "idle"})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cosplayer_3, {key="movie_s21_cosplayer_2", typespeed = 3, bubble_direction = 'cb'})
	-- manner, maketh, man
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- jedi_eugene: (sleep, seat) 포스가 함께하기를…
	character_util.set_direction(cosplayer_4,"right")
	character_util.set_anim(cosplayer_4, {name = "cross_arm"})
	character_util.set_emotion(cosplayer_4, {name = "sleep_deep"})

	character_util.set_direction(cosplayer_5,"left")
	character_util.set_anim(cosplayer_5, {name = "cross_arm"})
	character_util.set_emotion(cosplayer_5, {name = "sleep_deep"})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cosplayer_5, {key="movie_s21_cosplayer_3", typespeed = 3, bubble_direction = 'ct'})

	for i=1, 5 do

			character_util.set_anim(temp, {name = "idle"})
			character_util.set_emotion(temp, {name = "idle"})

		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end

	-- 대사 재생 완료/일정 시간경과 시
	self.section_21_cosplayer_open = false
	return

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
   	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BombDefuseEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BombDefuseEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.section_22_boss_open = nil
	self.section_22_ending_check = nil
	self.boss_camera_center = nil
	self.bomb_event_bubble_pos = nil

	self.theater_tint_color = nil
	self.theater_tint_key = nil
	self.theater_top_pos = nil
	self.theater_center_pos = nil
	self.epilogue_center_pos = nil

	self.bomb_explosion_color = nil
	self.bomb_explosion_pos = nil
	self.marker_bomb_boss = nil
	self.marker_bomb_boss_pos = nil
	self.theater_audience_pos = nil

	self.audience_script_pos = nil
	self.section_22_gate_on = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		-- 스테이지 시작 시 처리.
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_start_event, self))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "section_22_boss" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_22_ending, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BombDefuseEvent) then
		self:bomb_defuse_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:stage_start_event()

		return true
	end

	local eugene_playable = self:set_eugene_playable()
	local event_bomb_boss = get_field_object('event_bomb_boss')
	local marker_name = 'backstage_point'
	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(eugene_playable, vector(11.5, 0, 18.5))
	event_bomb_boss.Position = vector(-1,0,16)


	self:section22_theater_setting()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	camera_util.move_async(eugene_playable.Position, 0, {end_target = eugene_playable})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	party_util.position_party(start_marker.position, start_marker.direction)
	camera_util.move_async(eugene_playable.Position, 0, {end_target = eugene_playable})

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	local exit_outside2 = get_field_object('outside_2_exit')
	exit_outside2.Position = vector(99,0,99)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		name = 'ondemand/movie/audio:bgm_batqueen', state = 'field'
	})

	-- field_ui_manager:Show()
	-- coroutine.yield()
	-- field_ui_manager:Hide()

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	coroutine.yield(
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(start_marker.position, start_marker.direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

end


function local_class:section22_theater_setting()

	character_util.set_direction(user_leader,"up")
	character_util.set_anim(user_leader, {name = "seat"})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_leader, {name = "idle"})

	for i=1, 4 do
		local temp = get_character('staff_'..i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(temp)
		if i==1 then
			character_util.set_position(temp, vector(4, 0.2, -4.8))
		elseif i==2 then

		elseif i==3 then
			character_util.set_position(temp, vector(4, 0.2, -7.8))
		elseif i==4 then
			character_util.set_position(temp, vector(4, 0.2, -10.8))
		end
		character_util.set_direction(temp,"up")
		character_util.set_anim(temp, {name = "idle"})
		character_util.set_emotion(temp, {name = "idle"})
	end

	for i=1, 17 do
		local temp = get_character('audience_'..i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(temp)
		character_util.set_position(temp, self.theater_audience_pos[i])
		character_util.set_direction(temp,"up")
		character_util.set_anim(temp, {name = "idle"})
		character_util.set_emotion(temp, {name = "idle"})
	end

end


function local_class:bomb_defuse_event(e)
	local bomb = get_field_object('event_bomb_boss')
	if e.isDefused then
		-- 인터렉트 해체 완료 이벤트 발생
	else
		-- 인터렉트 해체 시작 이벤트 발생
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.bomb, bomb) then
			e.bomb.FieldObjectBehaviour:CancelDefusing()
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_22_boss_intro, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local eugene_playable = get_character('eugene_playable')
	local user_leader_char = user_party_leader

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, eugene_playable) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_leader_char) then
		return
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "section_22_boss" then
		if self.section_22_gate_on == false then
			self.section_22_gate_on = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_gate_manual_controll, self, true))
		end
	end

end



-- 배틀 게이트 온오프 함수: 매뉴얼 타입이 트루이면 클로즈, 거짓이면 오픈
function local_class:boss_gate_manual_controll(manual_type)
	if manual_type then
		for i=1, 8 do
			local temp_name = "boss_gate_"..i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end

	elseif not manual_type then
		for i=1, 8 do
			local temp_name = "boss_gate_"..i
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(temp_name))
		end
	end
	return
end

	local playable = get_character('eugene_playable')

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(playable, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(user_leader, 'enabled')

	return playable
end


function local_class:move_fx(fx_cast_name, fx_end_name, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration
	local fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_cast_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fx.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_end_name):Instantiate(target_pos)
	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:free_fall_jump(target, height)
	local v = 8 -- 속도
	local a = 25 -- 가속도
	local count = 0

	-- 바운스 시 콜백 되는 함수
	local cb = function ()
		if count < 3 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
			count = count +1
		end
	end

	local to = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position, height)
	character_util.set_position(target, to, true)

	local y_calc = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(v, a, height, 3, cb)
	while not y_calc:IsDone() do
		y_calc:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local target_y = unity_class.mathf.Max(y_calc:GetDistance(), 0)
		local next_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position, target_y)
		character_util.set_position(target, next_pos, true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

local local_class = newclass('MovieMainSection3')

local EventProgress = {
	idle = 0,
	talk_with_eugene = 1,
	mission_clear = 2
}

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MovieMain @
		Comment = 유진과 함께 초코칩 없는 초코칩 아이스크림과 파니니를 사서 니콜 비위 맞추기. @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_1'

	self.eugene = nil

	-- 파니니 상인
	self.juice_clerk = nil

	-- 아이스크림 상인
	self.ice_cream_shop = nil

	-- Interact할 아이스크림 판매대
	self.ice_cream_shop_front = nil

	-- 파니니 획득했는지 저장
	self.is_got_juice = false

	-- 아이스크림 획득했는지 저장
	self.is_got_ice_cream = false

	-- 한 번 이상 아이스크림 인트로 이벤트를 본 경우
	self.see_ice_cream_intro_event = false

	-- NPC 이름
	self.eugene_name = 'eugene'
	self.ice_cream_shop_name = 'ice_shop_1'
	self.juice_clerk_name = 'juice_shop_1'
	self.club_guard_name = "club_guard_"

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.ice_cream_shop_front_name = 'ice_cream_shop'

	-- 존 이름
	self.juice_line_zone_name = 'section_3_juice_line_start'
	self.manhole_1_name = "manhole_outside_1"
	self.manhole_2_name = "manhole_outside_2"
	self.manhole_under_name = "under_pass"
	self.concert_1_name = "concert_outside"
	self.concert_2_name = "concert_inside"

	-- 아이템 이름
	self.ice_cream_item_spec_name = 'soft_icecream'
	self.juice_item_spec_name = 'panini'

	-- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "movie_main"
	self.juice_quest_marker_name = "juice"
	self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name = "ice_cream"
	self.quest_tracker_name_1 = "movie_main_s3_tracker_0"
	self.quest_tracker_name_2 = "movie_main_s3_tracker_1"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.eugene = get_character(self.eugene_name)

	self.juice_clerk = get_character(self.juice_clerk_name)
	self.ice_cream_shop = get_character(self.ice_cream_shop_name)

	self.ice_cream_shop_front = get_field_object(self.ice_cream_shop_front_name)

	-- 이 섹션에서 시작한 경우 유진 위치 설정
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
		character_util.set_position(self.eugene, vector(96, 0, 17))
		character_util.set_direction(self.eugene, "left")
	end

	self.eugene.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.eugene)

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.eugene)
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.eugene = nil
	self.juice_clerk = nil
	self.ice_cream_shop = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.juice_line_zone_name then
			if not self.is_got_juice and self.event_progress >= EventProgress.talk_with_eugene then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.waiting_juice_event, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_1_name or e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_2_name or e.Zone.Name == self.concert_1_name then
			if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.eugene)
			elseif self.event_progress == EventProgress.talk_with_eugene then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.juice_quest_marker_name)
				if not self.is_got_ice_cream then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ice_cream_shop)
				end
				if not self.is_got_juice then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.juice_quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.juice_clerk)
				end
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_under_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.juice_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(123, 0, 172))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.concert_2_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.juice_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(-20, 0, 95))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eugene) and self.event_progress < EventProgress.talk_with_eugene then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.talk_with_eugene

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_eugene_event, self))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ice_cream_shop_front) then
		if not self.is_got_ice_cream and self.event_progress >= EventProgress.talk_with_eugene then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_ice_cream_game, self))
		end
	end

-- 아이스크림 가게에서 아이크림을 구매
function local_class:start_ice_cream_game()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.eugene)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.move_to(self.eugene, vector(81.2, 0, -1), 1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.align_party(vector(80.3, 0, 0), 'down')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	if not self.see_ice_cream_intro_event then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_negative_02", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		character_util.set_direction(self.eugene, "left")
		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_11', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "bomb_idle" })
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party_leader, nil, "question")

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "question", loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_12', skip = true})

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_13', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)

		local wait_for_branch = true
		local selection = 0

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		local talk_branch_1 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_main_s3_14"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		local talk_branch_2 = {
			Text = game_string:GetString("movie_main_s3_17"),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				selection = 1
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_1)
		branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = self.eugene
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if selection == 0 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "shoot" })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_15', skip = true})

			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "cast" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_16', skip = true})
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "bomb_idle" })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_18', skip = true})

			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "cast" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_19', skip = true})
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.eugene, "up")
		character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "up")

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_throw_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.ice_cream_item_spec_name).Id
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.ice_cream_shop.Position, target = user_party_leader.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	item.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_to(self.eugene, self.eugene.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
			1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.align_party(self.eugene.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), "left", 1, "arc")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(self.eugene, "left")

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")

	if not self.see_ice_cream_intro_event then
		self.see_ice_cream_intro_event = true

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_20', skip = true})

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "cast" })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_21', skip = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_emphasize_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "shoot" })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_22', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	local wait = true
	local is_success = false
	local callback = function(success)
		is_success = success
		wait = false
	end

	local mini_game_state = CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCreamState()
	mini_game_state.TimeLimit = 8
	mini_game_state.CloseCb = callback
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCream.Instance, mini_game_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCream))

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_success then
		-- 성공
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_positive_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "victory_extra" })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "smile" })

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "victory_extra" })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "smile" })

		self.is_got_ice_cream = true

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.ice_cream_quest_marker_name)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_clap_01", loop = true, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "clap" })

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_23', skip = true})

		clap_sfx:FadeOut(0)

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "victory_extra" })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "awesome" })

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_24', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_25', skip = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_sadness_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "cast" })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_26', skip = true})

		-- 아이스크림 가게에 Interact 불가능하게 수정
		self.ice_cream_shop_front.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	else
		-- 실패
		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "bomb_idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "tired" })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_fail_minigame_0', skip = true})

		character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "shoot" })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_fail_minigame_1', skip = true})
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	if is_success and self.is_got_juice then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mission_clear_event, self))
	else
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.eugene, user_party, true)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:waiting_juice_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 주스를 사기까지의 줄 루트
	local points = {
		vector(60.5, 0, 31),
		vector(61, 0, 30),
		vector(61, 0, 29),
		vector(61, 0, 28),
		vector(61, 0, 27),
		vector(61, 0, 26),
		vector(60, 0, 26),
		vector(59, 0, 26),
		vector(58, 0, 26),
		vector(57, 0, 26),
		vector(56, 0, 26),
		vector(55, 0, 26),
		vector(54, 0, 26),
		vector(54, 0, 25),
		vector(54, 0, 24),
		vector(54, 0, 23),
		vector(54, 0, 22)
	}

	local shop_front_pos = vector(60.5, 0, 32)

	local directions = { CS.Oak.Direction.Up }

	for i = 2, #points do
		directions[i] = vector_util.to_direction(points[i - 1] - points[i])
	end

	local npc_count = 11
	local leader_index = npc_count + 1
	local line_head_index = 1

	local line_characters = {}

	for i = 1, npc_count do
		line_characters[i] = get_character('juice_guest_' .. i - 1)
	end

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		line_characters[i + npc_count] = user_party[i - 1]
	end

	local walk_speed = 1

	-- 주스를 사고, 나가는 길 루트
	local out_route = {
		vector(60, 0, 30),
		vector(60, 0, 27),
		vector(53, 0, 27),
		vector(53, 0, 17),
		vector(40, 0, 17),
	}

	-- 인트로 이벤트
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.eugene)

	character_util.move_to(self.eugene, user_party_leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, true)

	party_util.align_party(user_party_leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), "right", 1, "arc")

	character_util.look_at(self.eugene, user_party_leader)

	character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_27', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "question", loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_28', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.eugene, user_party, true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 파티를 줄의 맨 끝으로 이동
	local party_move_routine = {}
	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local routine = util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, user_party[i - 1], points[i + npc_count], 3, false, nil, nil, directions[i + npc_count])
		table.insert(party_move_routine, routine)
	end

	wait_all(party_move_routine)

	while leader_index - 1 > line_head_index do
		yield_return_func(self.buy_juice, self, line_characters[line_head_index], out_route)

		yield_return_func(self.line_progress_next, self, line_head_index, line_characters, points, walk_speed, directions)

		if line_head_index == 2 then
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "smlie" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_29', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)
		elseif line_head_index == 4 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_30', skip = true })
		elseif line_head_index == 6 then
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_31', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)
		elseif line_head_index == 8 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "question", loop = false })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_32', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)
		elseif line_head_index == 10 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "bomb_idle" })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "tired" })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_33', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)
		else
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		line_head_index = line_head_index + 1
	end

	yield_return_func(self.buy_juice, self, line_characters[line_head_index], out_route)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	party_util.align_party(shop_front_pos, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_throw_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.juice_item_spec_name).Id
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = self.juice_clerk.Position,target = user_party_leader.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	item.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_positive_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, self.eugene)

	character_util.look_at(self.eugene, user_party_leader)
	character_util.set_anim(self.eugene, { name = "success" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.eugene, { name = "smile" })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.eugene, { key = 'movie_main_s3_34', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.eugene)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.eugene)

	self.is_got_juice = true

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.juice_quest_marker_name)

	if self.is_got_ice_cream then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mission_clear_event, self))
	else
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

-- 주스를 사려는 손님 줄을 다음 위치로 이동
function local_class:line_progress_next(line_head_index, line_characters, points, walk_speed, directions)
	for i = line_head_index + 1, #line_characters do
		local pos_index = i - line_head_index
		wp_util.move_way_points(line_characters[i],
			{waypoints = points[pos_index], speed = walk_speed, last_direction = directions[pos_index]})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)
end

-- 손님이 주스를 사고 나감
function local_class:buy_juice(fo, route)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo, { waypoints = vector(60.5, 0, 31), speed = 1 })

	-- 주스를 사려고 가게 앞으로 가는건 기다리지만, 사고 난 이후에 나가는 행동은 기다릴 필요가 없어서 별도의 코루틴으로 실행
	local out_route_move = function()
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo, { waypoints = route, speed = 4.5 })
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(out_route_move))
end

-- 두 가지 미션을 모두 클리어하고 다음 섹션으로 이동하는 이벤트

local EventProgress = {
	idle = 0,
	see_nicole_event = 1,

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.dancer_name = "club_dancer_"

	self.manhole_2_name = "manhole_outside_2"
	self.manhole_under_name = "under_pass"
	self.concert_1_name = "concert_outside"
	self.concert_2_name = "concert_inside"
	self.club_under_name = "invader_quest_actors_fight"

	-- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "movie_main"
	self.quest_tracker_name_1 = "movie_main_s4_tracker_0"
	self.quest_tracker_name_2 = "movie_main_s4_tracker_1"
	self.quest_tracker_name_3 = "movie_main_s4_tracker_2"

	-- 커스텀 이벤트 이름
	self.stop_club_event_custom_key = "stop_club_event"
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.eugene = get_character(self.eugene_name)
	self.nicole = get_character(self.nicole_name)
	self.invader_director = get_character(self.invader_director_name)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		party_util.add_member(self.eugene)
	end

	self:setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(60, 0, 42))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.eugene = nil
	self.nicole = nil
	self.invader_director = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.club_zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.nicole)

			if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_nicole_event then
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
			else
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.room_enter_event_zone_name and self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_nicole_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_nicole_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nicole_and_invader_director_event, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.ending_zone_name and self.event_progress == EventProgress.talk_with_nicole then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.get_out_club

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_event, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_1_name or e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_2_name or e.Zone.Name == self.concert_1_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(60, 0, 42))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.manhole_under_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(123, 0, 172))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.concert_2_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(-20, 0, 95))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.club_under_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
			vector(40, 0, 121))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.club_zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(60, 0, 42))

			if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_nicole_event then
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
			else
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.nicole) and self.event_progress < EventProgress.talk_with_nicole then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.talk_with_nicole

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_nicole_event, self))
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('MovieMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MovieMain @
		Comment = 은행 강도씬 촬영 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		goblin_talk = 1,
		room_enter = 2,
		pre_battle = 3,
		battle = 4,
		cloth = 5
	}

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_2'

	self.team = {}

	self.cnt1 = 0
	self.cnt2 = 0
	self.cnt3 = 0
	self.cnt4 = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local goblin = get_character('goblin')

	if goblin.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		goblin.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker1')
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker1', 27, true, goblin)

	local staff1 = get_character('staff_1')
	local staff2 = get_character('staff_2')

	character_util.set_active_state(staff1, "enabled")
	character_util.set_active_state(staff2, "enabled")

	character_util.set_position(staff1, vector(-19, 0, 9.5))
	character_util.set_position(staff2, vector(-19, 0, 8.5))

	character_util.set_direction(staff1, "right")
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff1)

	character_util.set_direction(staff2, "right")
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff2)

	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('extra'), "disabled")
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('staff_sub'), "disabled")

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_start, self))

	local exit = get_field_object('set1_exit')
	exit.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local exit = get_field_object('set2_exit')
	exit.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_lasthit")

	return
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local banker1 = get_character('banker_1')
	local banker2 = get_character('banker_2')
	local banker3 = get_character('banker_3')
	local goblin = get_character('goblin')
	local cloth = get_character('staff_cloth')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('lock_interact')) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.goblin_talk then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.room_enter
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_rob, self, e.Target))
			-- sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_rob, self, e.Target)
			--[[
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('cloth_interact_1')) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cloth then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.take_off, self))
			]]
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, goblin) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.goblin_talk
			--self:goblin_talk()
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.goblin_talk, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, cloth) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cloth then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.take_off, self))
		end

	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then


		if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' or e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_4' then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.pre_battle then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_on_1, self, e.Target))
				return true
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'banker_1' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none and self.cnt1 == 0 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(banker1, { key = 'movie_s5_banker_1', skip = false })
			self.cnt1 = self.cnt1 + 1
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'banker_2' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none and self.cnt2 == 0 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(banker2, { key = 'movie_s5_banker_2', skip = false })
			self.cnt2 = self.cnt2 + 1
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'banker_3' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none and self.cnt3 == 0 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(banker3, { key = 'movie_s5_banker_2', skip = false })
			self.cnt3 = self.cnt3 + 1
		elseif user_party.Leader.Position.x > 4 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.x < 53 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z > 23.5 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z < 71 then
			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', vector(18.5, 0, 29)) --야외
		elseif user_party.Leader.Position.x > 60 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.x < 70 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z > 65 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z < 75 then
			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', vector(68.5, 0, 67)) --세트2
		elseif user_party.Leader.Position.x > 70 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.x < 120 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z > -15 and
				user_party.Leader.Position.z < 15 then
			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', vector(94.5, 0, -2)) --세트3
		else
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker1')
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker1', 27, true, goblin)
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.goblin_talk then
				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', vector(-9.5, 0, 29))
			elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.pre_battle then
				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', vector(-10.5, 0, 8))
			else
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' then
			--music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
			--music_player:PlayStageMusic("ondemand/movie/audio:bgm_batqueen", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.cloth
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker1')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker1', 27, true, cloth)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight_with_rob, self))
		end
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' then
			--music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
			--music_player:PlayStageMusic("ondemand/movie/audio:bgm_batqueen", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.pre_battle
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker1')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker1', 27, true, vector(-10.5, 0, 8))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_battle'))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:take_off()
	--
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local cloth = get_character('staff_cloth')

	character_util.align_party(cloth.Position, "right", 0.5, "arc")

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_2', skip = true })

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s5_talk_branch_0_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s5_talk_branch_0_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.cordination_staff

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

		character_util.set_anim(cloth, { name = "eat", loop = true })
		music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, duration = 1, type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "player"})
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_equip_finish_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(cloth)

		--플레이어 캐릭터 교체
		local bank_leader = get_character('bank_leader')

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(-19, 0, 9))

		--- 파티 매니저에 파티원을 원복 하도록 요청
		party_manager:RestorePlayerParty()
		camera_util.move(vector(-10, 0, 8), 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		character_util.set_position(bank_leader, vector(-99, 0, -99))

		--character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "eat", loop = true})
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character('extra'), "enabled")
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character('staff_sub'), "enabled")

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, 'left')

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker1')

		-- BankLeader에게 붙어있던 TopHpBar UI를 기존 파티리더에게 붙임
		-- TopHpBar UI안에 DamageEvent를 구독/해제하는데 같은 프레임에서 Remove / SetUI를 할 경우 해제가 나중에 불려 제대로 구독이 되지 않음
		-- 그렇기때문에 구독할 수 있는 프레임까지 기다릴 수 있도록 함
		-- TODO: 현재까지 좋은 방법이 떠오르지 않아 이렇게 하니 나중에 좋은 방법이 떠오르면 수정해야함
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bank_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_battle'))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_guild_event'))

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cloth, { key = 'movie_2_cloth_talk_4', skip = true })
		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go3, self, cloth))

		--- 다음 섹션으로 진행
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

		--- 유저 컨트롤 되돌려줌
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	else
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:staff_go(target)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_dash_01', loop = true, duration = 4.5, type_priority = "default", player_priority = "npc"})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
	target:SetAnimation('run', true)
	if target.Position.x >= -19 then
		character_util.set_direction(target, "left")
	elseif target.Position.x < -19 then
		character_util.set_direction(target, "right")
	end
	character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-19, 0, target.Position.z), nil, 7)
	character_util.set_direction(target, "down")
	character_util.move_to_async(target, vector(-19, 0, 8), nil, 7)
	character_util.set_direction(target, "right")
	character_util.move_to(target, vector(1, 0, 8), 4, nil)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.smashed, self, user_party.Leader))
	wait_for_sec(2.1)

	character_util.set_active_state(target, "disabled")
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	local director = get_character('director')
	local staff1 = get_character('staff_1')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if user_party_leader.Position.x > 4 and
			user_party_leader.Position.x < 75 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z > 23.5 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z < 68 then
				if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker2')
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker2', 27, true, staff1)
				else
					ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker2', vector(48.5, 0, 53)) --야외
				end

		elseif user_party_leader.Position.x > -30 and
			user_party_leader.Position.x < 10 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z > -15 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z < 30 then
				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker2', vector(0.5, 0, -2)) --세트1




		elseif user_party_leader.Position.x > 70 and
			user_party_leader.Position.x < 120 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z > -15 and
			user_party_leader.Position.z < 15 then
				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker2', vector(94.5, 0, -2)) --세트3
		else
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker2')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker2', 27, true, director)
		end


		if e.Zone.Name == 'section_2_1' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.not_get_in, self, e.Target))
			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'section_2_2' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.outside_enter then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.room_enter
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.joker_run, self, e.Target))
			return true
		end
	end
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, staff1) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.outside_enter
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_in, self, e.Target))
			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker2', vector(48.5, 0, 53))
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, director) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.room_enter then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.joker_movieShoot, self, e.Target))
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_type = 'up'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_type = 'right'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_type = 'down'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_type = 'left'
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(target, number)
	for i = 1, #self.civil do
	   if self.civil[i].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
		  ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker3_'.. i, 27, true, self.civil[i])
	   end
	end
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker3')
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	while lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
	   target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	   coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	target.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	if target.Position.x > 89.5 and
		  target.Position.x < 99.5 and
		  target.Position.z > -2 and
		  target.Position.z < 8 then
	   target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	   ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker("main_marker3_" .. number)
	   character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
	   character_util.mario_jump_async(target, 'right')
	   character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	   if target.Name ~= 'civil_4' then
		  speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, { key = "movie_s7_civil_saved_2", skip = true })
	   end
	   self.cnt = self.cnt + 1
	   if self.cnt == 3 then
		  self:stop_timer()
		  coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_save, self))
	   end
	   wait_for_sec(1.0)
	   local waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	   waypoints:Add(vector(94.5, 0, target.Position.z))
	   waypoints:Add(vector(94.5, 0, -2))
	   character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, waypoints, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor')
	   character_util.set_active_state(target, "disabled")
	end
 end

function local_class:civil_run(target)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if target.Name == string.format("civil_%d", i) then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(string.format("main_marker3_%d", i))
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(target, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
	if target.Name ~= 'civil_4' then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, { key = "movie_s7_civil_saved_2", skip = true })
	end

	self.cnt = self.cnt + 1

	if self.cnt == 3 then
		--[[
		if eugene.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			eugene.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker3')
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('main_marker3', 27, true, eugene)
		end
		]]
		self:stop_timer()
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('main_marker3')
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('main_marker3', 27, true, vector(80, 0, 4))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_save, self))
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	local waypoints = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoints:Add(vector(94.5, 0, target.Position.z))
	waypoints:Add(vector(94.5, 0, -2))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(target, waypoints, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor')

	character_util.set_active_state(target, "disabled")
end

	local end_pos = vector(box.Position.x, 0, box.Position.z)
	local start_pos = end_pos + 10 * unity_class.vector3.up
	box.Position = start_pos
	-- 낙하 계산
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(-39.2, 39.2, start_pos.y, 0)
	while box.Position.y > 0 do
	   free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	   local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
	   box.Position = end_pos + vector(0, 1, 0) * dist_y
	   coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	box.Position = end_pos
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit"):Instantiate(box.Position)
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_3'

	self.pass_open_staff_name = 'pass_open_staff'
	self.cordination_staff = nil
	self.kingsman_manual_character = nil
	self.director_bale = nil
	self.kingsman_eugene = nil
	self.manner_maketh_man_in_door = nil

	self.manner_door_interactable = nil

	--입장담당 스태프가 입장 시켜 줬는가
	self.pass_open_over = false

	--입장담당 스태프가 말하는 중인가
	self.pass_open_staff_saying = false

	--옷 갈아입으라고 최초 말하기가 끝났는가
	self.bale_says_hurry_up_over = false

	--매너가 사람을 만든다가 끝나는가
	self.manner_maketh_man_over = false

	--매너가 사람을 만든다 씬에서 앉는 부분이 끝났는가
	self.manner_maketh_man_sit_over = false

	--매너 스위치 1번이 눌렸는가
	self.manner_switch_1_clicked = false

	--매너 스위치 2번이 눌렸는가
	self.manner_switch_2_clicked = false

	--매너 스위치 3번이 눌렸는가
	self.manner_switch_3_clicked = false

	--매너 메잌스 존 통과 했는가
	self.manner_maketh_man_zone_passed = false

	--베일이 가지말라고 말하는 중인가
	self.bale_saying = false

	--옷을 갈아입은 상태인가
	self.change_clothes_to_kingsman = false

	--마커 확인 용 매너 방에 들어간 상태인가?
	self.is_in_manner_maketh_man_room = false

	--팬들이 스태프 가드에 막혔는가?
	self.fan_go_guard_over = false

	--스태프 가드에 막힐 팬들의 숫자
	self.fan_go_guard_num = 8

	--매너가 사람을 만든다 씬 스태프 숫자
	self.staff_manner_num = 6

	self.is_fan_staff_crashing = true

	self.crashers_saying_fo = nil

	self.is_talking_with_pass = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	-- 의자에 앉으면 진행되도록 하기 위해서 길드 스테이트를 가져다 썼음. highschool1at3 코드 참조하여 사용함.
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self:interactable_characters_and_object_setting()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	if self.cordination_staff.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.cordination_staff.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.director_bale.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.director_bale.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	local pass_open_staff = get_character(self.pass_open_staff_name)

	if pass_open_staff.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		pass_open_staff.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.manner_maketh_man_in_door = get_field_object('manner_maketh_man_door_in')
	self.manner_door_interactable = self.manner_maketh_man_in_door.Interactable

	self.manner_maketh_man_in_door.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
	end

	--마커이동 (입장담당 스태프로)
	local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
	local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('pass_open_staff', quest_id, is_story, pass_open_staff)

end

function local_class:opening_routine()
	local fan_default_pos_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.fan_go_guard_num do
		local fan = get_character('fan_guard_1_' .. i)
		fan_default_pos_list[i] = fan.Position
		fan.Position = fan.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(fan, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fan)
		character_util.set_anim(fan, {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(fan, {name = 'love'})
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local staff = get_character('staff_guard_1_' .. i)
		character_util.set_direction(staff, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(staff, {name = 'push', loop = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(staff, {name = 'attack'})
	end

	get_character(self.pass_open_staff_name).Position = vector(9, 0, -1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fan_and_guard_crash_routine, self, fan_default_pos_list))

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(vector(0, 0, 0),
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.cordination_staff ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(self.cordination_staff.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.cordination_staff.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.is_fan_staff_crashing = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.cordination_staff = nil
	self.kingsman_manual_character = nil
	self.director_bale = nil
	self.kingsman_eugene = nil
	self.manner_maketh_man_in_door = nil

	self.manner_door_interactable = nil

	self.crashers_saying_fo = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'bale_dont_go' and not self.manner_maketh_man_over and not self.bale_saying then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_says_dont_go, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'manner_maketh_man_zone' and not self.manner_maketh_man_zone_passed and self.manner_maketh_man_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_middle, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'manner_maketh_man_room'
				and not self.is_in_manner_maketh_man_room and e.FullEnter then
			self:quest_marker_create_because_of_in()

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'pass_open' and not self.pass_open_over and not self.pass_open_staff_saying then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pass_open_staff_say_start, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.cordination_staff) and not self.change_clothes_to_kingsman then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cordination_staff_make_change_clothes, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('manner_maketh_man_door_in'))
				and not self.bale_saying then
			if not self.change_clothes_to_kingsman then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_says_dont_go, self))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.bale_says_hurry_up_special, self))
			end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.director_bale) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bale_says_hurry_up, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character(self.pass_open_staff_name))
				and not self.pass_open_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pass_open_staff_make_pass, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GuildCastleSitEvent) then --이거 이후에도 의자에 앉을 수 있도록 만들어 줄려면 스테이지 이벤트 스크립트에다가 집어 넣어야 한다.  /구현필요
		if e.IsSittingOn == true then

			local prioirity = CS.System.Convert.ToInt16 (CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom) + 1
			user_party.Leader:SetLockedDirection(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Left, prioirity))

			local sc = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil))
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, sc)

			local manner_chair = get_field_object('manner_chair')
			manner_chair.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			if (lua_helper.reference_equals(manner_chair, e.Chair)) and not self.manner_maketh_man_over then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_scene, self))
			end

		else
			local is_sitting = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState ~= nil and
				lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState)
			if is_sitting == true and self.manner_maketh_man_sit_over then
				user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:FinishSitState()
			end
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_1' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_end, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		if e.IsTurningOn and e.SwitchObject == get_field_object('manner_switch_1') and self.manner_switch_1_clicked == false and self.manner_maketh_man_over == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_switch_on_1, self))

		elseif e.IsTurningOn and e.SwitchObject == get_field_object('manner_switch_2') and self.manner_switch_1_clicked == true and self.manner_switch_2_clicked == false and self.manner_maketh_man_over == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_switch_on_2, self))

		elseif e.IsTurningOn and e.SwitchObject == get_field_object('manner_switch_3') and self.manner_switch_1_clicked == true and self.manner_switch_2_clicked == true and self.manner_switch_3_clicked == false and self.manner_maketh_man_over == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manner_maketh_man_switch_on_3, self))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'manner_maketh_man_room'
				and self.is_in_manner_maketh_man_room and not self.manner_maketh_man_over and e.FullLeave then
			self:quest_marker_remove_because_of_out()
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:fan_and_guard_crash_routine(fan_default_pos_list)
	local fan_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.fan_go_guard_num do
		fan_list[i] = get_character('fan_guard_1_' .. i)
	end

	local staff_list = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		staff_list[i] = get_character('staff_guard_1_' .. i)
	end

	local fan_attack_strings = {
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_0',
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_1'
	}

	local staff_attack_strings = {
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_4',
		'movie_main_s8_0_0_5'
	}

	for k, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		wp_util.move_way_points(v, {waypoints = fan_default_pos_list[k], speed = 4})
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fan_list[3],
			{ key = fan_attack_strings[2], bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	wait_for_sec(6 / 4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_small_01', parent = staff_list[3], loop = false, type_priority = 'default'})

	for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(v.Position + vector(-0.2, 0.4, 0))
		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil,
				2, false, false, false)
		character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.jump(v, 0.2, 0.25)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(v, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(v, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)
	end

	for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.15, 0, 0), 0.25,
			nil, false, false, false)
		character_util.jump(v, 0.2, 0.25)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	local staff_move_speed = 2

	for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
		character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil,
			staff_move_speed, true, true, false)
	end

	for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
		character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.15, 0, 0), 0.5 / staff_move_speed,
			nil, true, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5 / staff_move_speed)

	local push_dur = 2
	local r_1 = 1
	local r_str_1 = 1

	while self.is_fan_staff_crashing do
		for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					 nil, false, false, false)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
				 nil, false, true, false)
		end

		if not self.pass_open_staff_saying and not self.is_talking_with_pass then
			r_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_list)
			r_str_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #staff_attack_strings)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staff_list[r_1],
					{ key = staff_attack_strings[r_str_1], bubble_direction = 'rt' })

			self.crashers_saying_fo = staff_list[r_1]
		end

		wait_for_sec(push_dur * 1.5)

		if staff_list[r_1] ~= nil then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(staff_list[r_1])
		end
		self.crashers_saying_fo = nil

		if not self.is_fan_staff_crashing then
			break
		end

		for _, v in pairs(fan_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur,
					 nil, false, true, false)
		end

		for _, v in pairs(staff_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(v, {name = 'push', upper = true})
			character_util.set_emotion(v, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.move_to(v, v.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), push_dur, nil, false, false, false)
		end

		if not self.pass_open_staff_saying and not self.is_talking_with_pass then
			r_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #fan_list)
			r_str_1 = random_util.get_random_int(1, #fan_attack_strings)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fan_list[r_1],
					{ key = fan_attack_strings[r_str_1], bubble_direction = 'lt' })

			self.crashers_saying_fo = fan_list[r_1]
		end

		wait_for_sec(push_dur * 1.5)

		if fan_list[r_1] ~= nil then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fan_list[r_1])
		end
		self.crashers_saying_fo = nil
	end

	for i = 1, self.fan_go_guard_num do
	local fan = get_character('fan_guard_1_' .. i)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fan)
	character_util.set_anim(fan, {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(fan, {name = 'love'})
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
	local staff = get_character('staff_guard_1_' .. i)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(staff)
	character_util.set_anim(staff, {name = 'push', upper = true, loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff, {name = 'attack'})
	end
end

--분장담당 스태프에게 말을 걸어 옷을 갈아입는 장면
function local_class:cordination_staff_make_change_clothes()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	--마커 제거
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('cordination_staff')

	local userPosition = user_party.Leader.Position
	--정렬
	character_util.set_direction(self.cordination_staff, 'right')
	character_util.align_party(self.cordination_staff.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	--대화
	character_util.set_anim(self.cordination_staff, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.cordination_staff, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.cordination_staff, {key = 'movie_main_s8_5', skip = true})

	--선택지를 띄운다
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s8_talk_branch_1_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s8_talk_branch_1_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.cordination_staff

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		local sfx_changing = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player'})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'eat', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		--이펙트 들어가고

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

		sfx_changing:Stop()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equip_finish_01', loop = false, type_priority = 'default'})

		local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1
		for i = 0, loop_count do
			if i == 0 then
				user_party[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			else
				user_party[i].Position = vector(13.5 + i, 0, -7)
				character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
			end

		end

		self.controller:set_manual_character_level(self.kingsman_manual_character)

		--복장 바뀜
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = false
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(self.kingsman_manual_character, param)

		character_util.set_position(self.kingsman_manual_character, self.cordination_staff.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0))

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

		self.change_clothes_to_kingsman = true

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'})

		wait_for_sec(1.3)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		self.cordination_staff.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		self.director_bale.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_23'
		self.cordination_staff.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_29'

		--마커이동 (베일 감독으로)
		local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('director_bale', quest_id, is_story, self.director_bale)

	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.cordination_staff, {key = 'movie_main_s8_6', skip = true})
		--마커이동 (분장담당 스태프로)
		local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('cordination_staff', quest_id, is_story, self.cordination_staff)
	end
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	--마커 제거
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('manner_maketh_man_scene')

	self.manner_maketh_man_zone_passed = true

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-0.5, 0, -32), 1, {use_unscaledtime = false, ignorecameragrids = true})

	local hulk_jerk_1 = get_character('hulk_jerk_1')
	local hulk_jerk_2 = get_character('hulk_jerk_2')
	local hulk_jerk_3 = get_character('hulk_jerk_3')

	--던전왕국에나 가보지 그래
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_3, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_jerk_3, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{name = 'ondemand/movie/audio:bgm_queensman_01', state = 'event', mix = 0})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_jerk_3, {key = 'movie_main_s8_15', skip = true})

	--낄낄낄
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_die_fat_ogre_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(hulk_jerk_1, {name = 'cast', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_anim(hulk_jerk_2, {name = 'cast', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_anim(hulk_jerk_3, {name = 'release', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_jerk_1, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_jerk_2, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_jerk_3, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_jerk_3, {key = 'movie_main_s8_15_6', skip = true})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_3)

	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_2, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_1, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_3, 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_1)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 1, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	--마커 이동 (스위치1로)
	local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
	local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('manner_maketh_man_scene', quest_id, is_story, get_field_object('manner_switch_1'))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

--매너가 사람을 만든다 중 매너가 부분
function local_class:manner_maketh_man_switch_on_1()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local hulk_jerk_1 = get_character('hulk_jerk_1')
	local hulk_jerk_2 = get_character('hulk_jerk_2')
	local hulk_jerk_3 = get_character('hulk_jerk_3')

	--마커 제거
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('manner_maketh_man_scene')

	self.manner_switch_1_clicked = true

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, vector(2, 0, -37), nil, 3, true, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('manner_door_1', false))

	--선택지 매너가
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s8_talk_branch_2_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = hulk_jerk_1
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_queensman_01'})

	camera_util.move_async(hulk_jerk_2.Position, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_jerk_3, 'down')

	character_util.set_anim(hulk_jerk_2, {name = 'question', loop = false, scale = 1})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_jerk_2, {key = 'movie_main_s8_15_1', skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_2)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	--마커 이동 (스위치 2로)
	local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
	local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('manner_maketh_man_scene', quest_id, is_story, get_field_object('manner_switch_2'))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_jerk_1, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2.0})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_jerk_1, {key = 'movie_main_s8_15_5', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hulk_jerk_1)

	hulk_jerk_2.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(hulk_jerk_1, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(hulk_jerk_2, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
