--매너가 사람을 만든다 씬 종료 부분
function local_class:manner_maketh_man_end()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = "bgm_battle_normal", state = 'combat' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--컷!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_movie_end_01'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s10_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-100, 100), scale = 1.5})

	--닫은 문 다시 열기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('manner_door_2', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('manner_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('manner_door_3', false))

	--베일이 걸어 나오는 장면 + 베일 따라다니는 스태프
	local bale_staff_special = get_character('bale_staff_special')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-0.5, 0, -33.5), 1)

	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, -33.5), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(bale_staff_special, vector(-1, 0, -33), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.director_bale, vector(-1, 0, -34), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go_around_player_guard_staff, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go_around_player_left_top_staff, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go_around_player_right_top_staff, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go_around_player_right_bottom_staff, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.staff_go_around_player_other_staff, self))

	--아주 멋진 액션이었어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_01', duration = 6.4, fade_out_time = 1})
	character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'success', loop = true, scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_jump_01'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s8_16', skip = true})

	--베일 스태프 표현
	character_util.set_anim(bale_staff_special, {name = 'success', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(bale_staff_special, {name = 'smile', loop = true})

	--대단해
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_clap_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'clap', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s8_17', skip = true})

	--플레이어 반응
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false, scale = 1})
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	camera_util.move_async(self.kingsman_eugene.Position, 1, {end_target = self.kingsman_eugene})

	--유진이 스태프에 둘러싸인 주인공을 바라보며 : ...
	character_util.set_emotion(self.kingsman_eugene, {name = 'tired', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kingsman_eugene, {key = 'movie_main_s8_18_0', skip = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_jump_01'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.kingsman_eugene, {name = 'get', loop = true, scale = 1})
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_all(
		self.kingsman_eugene.SpineController:MarioJump(self.kingsman_eugene.Direction),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, self.kingsman_eugene, unity_class.vector3(-2, 0, -30)  + unity_class.vector3.back, 0.25)
	))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bale_staff_special)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.kingsman_eugene)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.kingsman_eugene, vector(-2, 0, -38), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.kingsman_eugene, vector(-0.5, 0, -38), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.kingsman_eugene, 'down')

	camera_util.move(self.kingsman_eugene.Position, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	--되돌아 보는 유진
	character_util.set_direction(self.kingsman_eugene, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(self.kingsman_eugene, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	character_util.set_direction(self.kingsman_eugene, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	--감독님! 잠시 얘기 좀 해요.
	character_util.set_anim(self.kingsman_eugene, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.kingsman_eugene, {name = 'attack', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.kingsman_eugene, {key = 'movie_main_s8_18', skip = true})

	--유진 퇴장
	character_util.move_to_async(self.kingsman_eugene, vector(-0.5, 0, -45), nil, 5, true, true, true)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-0.5, 0, -33.5), 1)

	--어 유진! 같이 가!
	character_util.set_direction(self.director_bale, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.director_bale, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.director_bale, {name = 'surprise', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.director_bale, {key = 'movie_main_s8_19', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)

	--베일 + 스태프도 유진을 따라간다.
	character_util.move_to(self.director_bale, vector(-0.5, 0, -45), nil, 5, true, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(bale_staff_special, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(bale_staff_special, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(bale_staff_special, {name = 'surprise', loop = true})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(bale_staff_special, vector(-0.5, 0, -45), nil, 6, true, true, true)

	character_util.set_position(self.kingsman_eugene, vector(30, 0, 4))
	character_util.set_position(self.director_bale, vector(31, 0, 4))
	character_util.set_position(bale_staff_special, vector(32, 0, 4))

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.kingsman_eugene)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.director_bale)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bale_staff_special)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

--스태프들이 들고 있던 것들을 내려놓고 주인공을 둘러싼다
function local_class:staff_go_around_player_guard_staff()

	--길막던 스태프들 처리
	local people_guard_on_air_1 = get_character('people_guard_on_air_1')
	local people_guard_on_air_2 = get_character('people_guard_on_air_2')

	character_util.set_position(people_guard_on_air_1, vector(0, 0, -41))
	character_util.set_position(people_guard_on_air_2, vector(1, 0, -41))
	character_util.set_direction(people_guard_on_air_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(people_guard_on_air_2, 'left')

	--스태프들의 대화를 바꿔 놓는다. : 수고하셨습니다!
	people_guard_on_air_1.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_26'
	people_guard_on_air_2.Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_26'
	get_character('bale_staff_firstdoor_1').Interactable.Talk = 'movie_main_s8_26'

	character_util.set_anim(people_guard_on_air_1, {name = 'sing', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(people_guard_on_air_1, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(people_guard_on_air_2, {name = 'sing', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(people_guard_on_air_2, {name = 'smile', loop = true})

	--가드들 이동
	character_util.move_to_async(people_guard_on_air_1, vector(0, 0, -34.5), nil, 5, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(people_guard_on_air_2, vector(1, 0, -34.5), nil, 5, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(people_guard_on_air_1, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(people_guard_on_air_2, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(people_guard_on_air_1, {name = 'clap', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_anim(people_guard_on_air_2, {name = 'clap', loop = true, scale = 1})

end

--
function local_class:staff_go_around_player_left_top_staff()
	local bale_staff_manner_1 = get_character('bale_staff_manner_1')
	local bale_staff_manner_3 = get_character('bale_staff_manner_3')

	bale_staff_manner_3.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	--스태프들 들고 있던 거 내려놓는다
	character_util.release_hold_object(bale_staff_manner_1, bale_staff_manner_1.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	bale_staff_manner_3.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable()
	character_util.move_to_async(bale_staff_manner_3, bale_staff_manner_1.Position - vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 6, true, true)
	bale_staff_manner_3.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'movie_1_3'

	self.director_bale = nil
	self.kingsman_eugene = nil
	self.icecream_guy = nil

	self.icecream_buy_start = false
	self.icecream_buy_over = false
	self.eugene_bale_talk_over = false
	self.eugene_saying = false

	self.have_chocochip_icecream = false
	self.have_strawberry_icecream = false
	self.have_cheesecake_icecream = false

	self.is_marker_on_eugene = false
	self.have_to_marker_on_eugene = false

	self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = false
	self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy = false

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self:interactable_characters_and_object_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
	if self.icecream_guy.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.icecream_guy.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)-- RemoveRelatedEvent
	end

	if self.kingsman_eugene.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.kingsman_eugene.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)-- RemoveRelatedEvent
	end


	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 8 then
		--마커이동 (유진으로)
		local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('kingsman_eugene', quest_id, is_story, self.kingsman_eugene)
		self.is_marker_on_eugene = true

		self.controller:stage3_disable_mmm_staffs()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
	else
		self.have_to_marker_on_eugene = true
		--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
		local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('manner_maketh_man_door_out', quest_id, is_story,
				get_field_object('manner_maketh_man_door_out'))
	end
end

function local_class:opening_routine()
	local manual_kingsman = get_character('kingsman_manual_character')
	--복장 바뀌는 부분
	--이펙트 들어가고 / 구현필요
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, manual_kingsman) == false then
		--screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))
		local loop_count = user_party.Count - 1
		for i = 0, loop_count do
			if i == 0 then
				user_party[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			else
				user_party[i].Position = vector(13.5 + i, 0, -7)
				character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
			end

		end

		self.controller:set_manual_character_level(manual_kingsman)

		--복장 바뀜 /구현필요
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = false
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToManualCharacter(manual_kingsman, param)
		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(1.34, 0, 0.5))

		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(vector(0, 0, 0),
				CS.Oak.Direction.Right, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))
	end

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.icecream_guy ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(self.icecream_guy.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.icecream_guy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	if self.kingsman_eugene ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(self.kingsman_eugene.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.kingsman_eugene.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.director_bale = nil
	self.kingsman_eugene = nil
	self.icecream_guy = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'eugene_dont_go' and not self.icecream_buy_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_says_dont_go, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'eugene_icecream' and not self.icecream_buy_start then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_says_hey, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'eugene_bale_talk' and not self.eugene_bale_talk_over then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_bale_talk, self))

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'coffee_shop' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('coffee_shop_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'sleeping_shop' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('sleeping_shop_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_1' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_1_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'empty_room_2' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('empty_room_2_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'burywood_got_talent_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('burywood_got_talent_out_door', true)

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'inception_room' and e.FullEnter then
			self:change_marker('inception_room_out_door', true)

			if self.have_chocochip_icecream then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_says_very_bad, self))

			end

		--아이스크림 사오기 시작도 안했고 아이스크림도 안 사온 경우

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eugene_says_buy_icecream, self))

			--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

		elseif self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('icecream_guy')
			self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = false
			self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy = true

			--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))

		elseif fo_name == 'second_floor_room_out_door' then
			if self.have_to_marker_on_eugene or self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
				local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))
			end

		elseif fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
			if self.have_to_marker_on_eugene or self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy then
				--마커이동 (문/계단으로)
				local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
				local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(fo_name, quest_id, is_story, get_field_object(fo_name))
			end

		end

	else
		if fo_name == 'second_floor_room_out_door' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

		elseif self.have_to_marker_on_eugene then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

			if fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
				if user_party.Leader.Position.z > 31 then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)
					return
				end

			end

			--마커이동 (유진으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('kingsman_eugene', quest_id, is_story, self.kingsman_eugene)

			self.have_to_marker_on_eugene = false
			self.is_marker_on_eugene = true

		elseif self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)

			if fo_name == 'sleeping_shop_out_door' or fo_name == 'coffee_shop_out_door' then
				if user_party.Leader.Position.z > 31 then
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(fo_name)
					return
				end

			end

			--마커이동 (아이스크림 상점으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('icecream_guy', quest_id, is_story, self.icecream_guy)

			self.have_to_marker_on_icecream_guy = false
			self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = true
		end

	end

--아이스크림 상점이랑 말 걸면 작동되는 함수
function local_class:icecream_guy_interact()

	--마커 제거
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('icecream_guy')

	self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = false

	--임시로 무조건 아이스크림 산 걸로 처리하도록 만들었다
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.align_party(self.icecream_guy.Position - vector(0, 0, 1), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	--어서오세요! 맛있는 아이스크림 하나 어떠세요?
	character_util.set_anim(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.icecream_guy, {key = 'movie_main_s9_17', skip = true,
																	bubble_direction = 'cb'})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.icecream_guy)

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s9_talk_branch_1_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s9_talk_branch_1_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.icecream_guy

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		--어떤 맛으로 드릴까요?
		character_util.set_anim(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.icecream_guy, {key = 'movie_main_s9_18', skip = true})
	else
		--다음에 또 오세요!
		character_util.set_anim(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'idle', loop = true, scale = 1})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.icecream_guy, {name = 'smile', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.icecream_guy, {key = 'movie_main_s9_18_0', skip = true})

		--유진에게 얘기를 한 뒤에 말을 걸 때만 아이스크림 상점에 마커가 생긴다.(어떤 섹션에서 진입하던, 아이스크림 살 수 있게 해줘야 할 지는 의문. 만약 필요하다면 스테이지 이벤트 컨트롤러로 넘겨야 할 것 같다)
		if self.icecream_buy_start then
			--마커이동 (아이스크림 상점으로)
			local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
			local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('icecream_guy', quest_id, is_story, self.icecream_guy)

			self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = true
		end
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	branches:Clear()
	wait_for_branch = true
	choice = 0
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s9_talk_branch_2_0'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s9_talk_branch_2_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('movie_main_s9_talk_branch_2_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 2
		end
	})
	choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = self.icecream_guy
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		--올바르게 아이스크림을 구매하는 경우
		--여기 있습니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.icecream_guy, {key = 'movie_main_s9_19', skip = true})

		--아이스크림 전달
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_throw_01'})
		local icecream_dropped_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = self.icecream_guy.Position,
			target = user_party.Leader.Position,
			itemid = 20163,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})

		icecream_dropped_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--유진에게 얘기를 한 뒤에 아이스크림을 구매할 때만 유진에게 마커가 생긴다.
		if self.icecream_buy_start then
			if self.have_chocochip_icecream == false then
				--쿠키 제거 미니 게임(이것도 유진에게 얘기를 한 뒤에만 미니게임 실행되도록 하자)
				local wait = true
				local is_success = false
				local callback = function(success)
					is_success = success
					wait = false
				end

				local mini_game_state = CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCreamState()
				mini_game_state.TimeLimit = 8
				mini_game_state.CloseCb = callback
				ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCream.Instance, mini_game_state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameIceCream))

				while wait do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				if is_success then

					--성공적으로 완수했다.
					field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'movie_main_s9_12_4', mintotalduration = 1.0})

					--마커이동 (유진으로)
					local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
					local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('kingsman_eugene', quest_id, is_story, self.kingsman_eugene)

					self.is_marker_on_eugene = true

					self.have_chocochip_icecream = true

				else
					-- 실패했다... 아이스크림을 다시 사야할 것 같다.
					field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'movie_main_s9_12_5', mintotalduration = 1.0})

					self.have_chocochip_icecream = false

					--마커이동 (아이스크림 가게로)
					local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
					local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
					if not self.have_chocochip_icecream then
						ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('icecream_guy', quest_id, is_story, self.icecream_guy)

						self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = true

					end
				end
			end
		else
			self.have_chocochip_icecream = true
		end

	else
		--잘못 아이스크림을 구매하는 경우
		--여기 있습니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.icecream_guy, {key = 'movie_main_s9_19', skip = true})

		--아이스크림 전달
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_throw_01'})
		local icecream_dropped_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = self.icecream_guy.Position,
			target = user_party.Leader.Position,
			itemid = 20163,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})

		icecream_dropped_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		if choice == 1 then
			self.have_strawberry_icecream = true
		else
			self.have_cheesecake_icecream = true
		end

		local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
		local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest
		if not self.have_chocochip_icecream and self.icecream_buy_start then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('icecream_guy', quest_id, is_story, self.icecream_guy)

			self.is_marker_on_icecream_guy = true

		end
	end

    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

local local_class = newclass('NecroDancerMerchantPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = NecrodancerMerchant @
		Comment = 상인 아이템 훔치기 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.merchant_items = {}

	self.potion_key = 'ate_potion'
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return end

	-- 상인 아이템 세팅
	if self.controller.starting_grade >= 0 then
		local sp_handler = get_field_object('merchant_starpiece_interactable')
		if stage_progress:HasStarPiece('merchant_starpiece') then
			sp_handler.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			sp_handler.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		else
			self.controller.starpiece_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('star_piece'):Instantiate(sp_handler.Position)
			table.insert(self.merchant_items, sp_handler)
		end

		local awaken_stone_handler = get_field_object('merchant_evolve_stone_interactable')
		if stage_progress:HasItem('merchant_awaken_stone') then
			awaken_stone_handler.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			awaken_stone_handler.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		else
			self.controller.awaken_stone = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = awaken_stone_handler.Position, itemid = 60016, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
			table.insert(self.merchant_items, awaken_stone_handler)
		end

		local potion_handler = get_field_object('merchant_potion_interactable')
		if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.potion_key) == 1 then
			potion_handler.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			potion_handler.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		else
			self.controller.potion = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = potion_handler.Position, itemid = 20195, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
			table.insert(self.merchant_items, potion_handler)
		end
	else
		self.merchant_items = {
			get_field_object('merchant_starpiece_interactable'),
			get_field_object('merchant_evolve_stone_interactable'),
			get_field_object('merchant_potion_interactable')
		}
	end

	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	merchant.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.merchant_items = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:get_item(item_name)
	if item_name == 'merchant_starpiece' then
		self.controller.starpiece_effect:Dispose()
		self.controller.starpiece_effect = nil

		-- 스타피스에게 충돌이벤트를 보내 바로 먹어지게 한다.
		local starpiece = get_field_object('merchant_starpiece')
		message_system:Send(starpiece.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))
	elseif item_name == 'merchant_evolve_stone' then
		self.controller.awaken_stone.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		self.controller.awaken_stone:Fly()
	elseif item_name == 'merchant_potion' then
		self.controller.potion.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		self.controller.potion:Fly()
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.merchant_items) then
		e.Target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		e.Target.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		local item_name = string.sub(e.Target.Name, 1, -14)
		self:get_item(item_name)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	local awaken_stone = get_field_object('merchant_awaken_stone')
	local potion = self.controller.potion

	if awaken_stone ~= nil and e.Item.ItemId == awaken_stone.FieldObjectBehaviour.Item.ItemId and
			not stage_progress:HasItem(awaken_stone.Name) then
		stage:SendPickStageItem(awaken_stone.Name, nil, function(data)

			local has_value, value = data:TryGetValue('AddedItem')
			local added_item = value

			if added_item ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.StageProgress.Current:AddItem(awaken_stone.KeyIndex)

				has_value, value = added_item:TryGetValue('Id')
				local item_id = value

				has_value, value = user.Items:TryGetValue(item_id)
				if has_value then
					CS.Oak.AddItemStageLogic.Execute(value, user_party.Leader)
				end
			end
		end)

		self.controller.awaken_stone = nil
	elseif potion ~= nil and e.Item.ItemId == potion.ItemPlaceholder.ItemId then
		local target = user_party.Leader
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = target
		heal_info.target = target
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.5)
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(quest_util.set_custom_state,
				self.controller.quest_progress, self.potion_key, 1))

		self.controller.potion = nil
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NecrodancerMerchantSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NecrodancerMerchant @
		Comment = 악덕상인 혼내주기 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.merchant_state = {
		none = 1,
		chase = 2,
		back = 3,
		caught = 4,
		dead = 5,
		talking = 6
	}
	self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.none

	self.merchant_hit_count = 0

	-- 자자, 마음에 드는 걸로 골라보라고.
	self.merchant_oneline_key = 'necrodancer_merchant_0'

	self.run_team_combination = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeamCombinationGaugeChangeEvent),
			'on_team_combination_gauge_change_event')

	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	merchant.Interactable.Talk = self.merchant_oneline_key

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeamCombinationGaugeChangeEvent))

	self.progress = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	local awakening_stone_pos = get_field_object('merchant_evolve_stone_interactable').Position
	self.controller.awaken_stone = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = awakening_stone_pos, itemid = 60016, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	local potion_pos = get_field_object('merchant_potion_interactable').Position
	self.controller.potion = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = potion_pos, itemid = 20195, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	local star_piece_pos = get_field_object('merchant_starpiece_interactable').Position
	self.controller.starpiece_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('star_piece'):Instantiate(star_piece_pos)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'return_to_base_pos' and self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.merchant_return, self))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'caught_target' and self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase then
		self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.caught
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.merchant_caught_player, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 플레이어가 죽었는데 상인이 따라가고 있었으면 초기화
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.merchant_return, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
	local zone_bound = field:GetZone('merchant_chase_area').Bounds
	local damageable = (self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.none or self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase) and
			zone_bound:Intersects(user_party.Leader.Bounds)
	local player_alive = not user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, merchant) and
			e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type and damageable and player_alive then

		-- 자신의 최대 체력의 60%데미지 적용
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.target = merchant
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(damage_info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.6)
		merchant.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Damage(damage_info)

		-- 상인이 가만히있다가 공격당한 상태라면 플레이어 쫒아가기
		if self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.none then
			self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.chase
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.merchant_chase_player, self))
		end

		self.merchant_hit_count = self.merchant_hit_count + 1
		if self.merchant_hit_count >= 2 then
			self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.dead
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.on_dead_merchant, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local merchandises = {
		get_field_object('merchant_starpiece_interactable'),
		get_field_object('merchant_evolve_stone_interactable'),
		get_field_object('merchant_potion_interactable')
	}

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, merchandises) and self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.none then
		self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.talking
		local item_name = string.sub(e.Target.Name, 1, -14)
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_item, self, item_name)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_team_combination_gauge_change_event(e)
	if e.ChangeAmount < 0 and self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase then
		self.run_team_combination = true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:merchant_dead_shout()
	-- 상인이 죽을때 바로 speech_bubble을 클리어해줘서 1프레임 기다린 후에 비명 대사 출력
	coroutine.yield()

	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'necrodancer_merchant_dead_talk'}) -- 으아아악!!!
end

function local_class:merchant_return()
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	local target_pos = field:GetMarker('merchant_base').position

	self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.back

	-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	-- 파티들 비전투 플래그를 해제해준다.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	end

	character_util.convert_to_npc(merchant)
	character_util.stop(merchant)

	local plan_path_done = false
	local plan_path
	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(merchant, target_pos, 100, merchant, 0,
			nil,
			function(path, req_key)
				if req_key == 0 then
					plan_path_done = true
					plan_path = path
				end
			end)

	while not plan_path_done do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local dash_speed = merchant.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.DashSpeed
	if plan_path.Count <= 1 then
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(merchant, { waypoints = target_pos, speed = dash_speed, run = true, play_sfx = true })
	else
		local wp = {}
		for i = 0, plan_path.Count - 1 do
			wp[i + 1] = plan_path[i]
		end
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(merchant, { waypoints = wp, speed = 4.5, run = true, play_sfx = true })
	end

	self:reset_merchant()
end

function local_class:reset_merchant()
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	merchant.Position = field:GetMarker('merchant_base').position
	merchant.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
	merchant:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	merchant:SetAnimation('sing', true)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(merchant)
	merchant.Interactable.Talk = self.merchant_oneline_key

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = merchant
	heal_info.target = merchant
	heal_info.heal = merchant.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	--stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true

	self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.none
	self.merchant_hit_count = 0
end

function local_class:merchant_caught_player()
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')

	character_util.stop(merchant)
	character_util.look_at(merchant, user_party.Leader)
	merchant:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	character_util.set_anim(merchant, {name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})

	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, merchant)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
	user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true

	-- 상인이 유저를 찰때까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 유저가 맞는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(user_party.Leader)
	damage_util.show_damage_number(user_party.Leader, 99999, unity_class.color.red, user_party.Leader.Position)

	user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

	-- 조금 기다려주고 대사침.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 후후, 상대를 잘못 골랐어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	merchant:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
	merchant:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'necrodancer_merchant_caught_player_1', skip = true })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black)

	self:reset_merchant()

	local reset_marker = field:GetMarker('merchant_reset')
	party_util.position_party(reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, 'arc')
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Immortal = false

	-- 파티들 비전투 플래그를 해제해준다.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat' })
end

function local_class:merchant_chase_player()
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')

	merchant.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	merchant:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	merchant:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
	merchant.Interactable.Talk = ''
	character_util.normal_jump(merchant)
	character_util.move_to_async(merchant, merchant.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5, 0.25)

	merchant:Shake(0.05, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, user_party.Leader)
	merchant:SetEmotion('mad', true)
	merchant:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.normal_jump_async(merchant, true)

	-- 연출도중에 플레이어가 존 밖으로 나가는 경우가 있어 여기서 더블체크
	local zone_bound = field:GetZone('merchant_chase_area').Bounds
	if not zone_bound:Intersects(user_party.Leader.Bounds) then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(merchant, {'return_to_base_pos'}))
		return
	end

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	end

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_red_hood', state = 'combat' })

	character_util.convert_to_monster(merchant)
	merchant.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(merchant, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	-- 상인이 쫒을떄 대사 출력
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.merchant_chase_talking, self))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.collide_tick, self))
end

function local_class:interact_to_item(item_name)
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')

	camera_util.move_async(merchant.Position, 1)

	-- 오, 안목이 좋네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	merchant:SetEmotion('greed', true)
	merchant:RemoveAnimation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_1', skip = true})

	-- 그거라면 X퍼플 컵이야
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	merchant:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	merchant:SetAnimation('release', true)
	local price_text = game_string:GetString('necrodancer_' .. item_name .. '_price')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
			{ key = game_string:Format('necrodancer_merchant_2', price_text), skip = true })

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'necrodancer_merchant_3', 'brutal' }, { 'necrodancer_merchant_4', 'mercy' } })

	local purchase = result == 1
	if purchase then
		-- 한참 부족하잖아?
		merchant:SetEmotion('mad', true)
		merchant:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.normal_double_jump(merchant, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_5', skip = true})

		-- 어디 거지같은 게 날로 먹으려고…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_6', skip = true})

		-- 당장 꺼져!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		merchant:SetAnimation('release', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_7', skip = true})
		merchant:RemoveAnimation()
	else
		-- 저기 둥둥 떠다니는 보라색 컵이 퍼플 컵이야.
		merchant:RemoveEmotion()
		merchant:SetAnimation('release', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_8', skip = true})

		-- 부족하면 좀 더 모아오지 그래?
		merchant:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_9', skip = true})

		-- 넌 못 할거 같지만 말야.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
		merchant:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = 'necrodancer_merchant_10', skip = true})
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader()

	self.current_merchant_state = self.merchant_state.none
end

function local_class:merchant_chase_talking()
	-- 이 망할 강도 놈! / 감히 상점에서 폭탄을 써?!
	local text_keys = { 'necrodancer_merchant_chase_talk_1', 'necrodancer_merchant_chase_talk_2' }
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')
	local current_idx = 1
	local talking = false
	local process = function()
		talking = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, {key = text_keys[current_idx]})
		current_idx = current_idx + 1 > #text_keys and 1 or current_idx + 1
		talking = false
	end

	while self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase do
		-- 협동기 사용 중 speech_bubble 출력되지 않도록 수정
		if not self.run_team_combination then
			if not talking then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(process))
			end
		else
			if user_party.TeamCombination.IsActive == false then
				self.run_team_combination = false
				character_util.set_emotion(merchant, { name = 'mad' })
				character_util.convert_to_npc(merchant)

				character_util.convert_to_monster(merchant)
				command_util.execute_monster_notice(merchant, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(merchant)
end

function local_class:on_dead_merchant()
	local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	-- 파티들 비전투 플래그를 해제해준다.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	end

	character_util.air_spin(merchant, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 6, play_deathsfx = true })
	self:merchant_dead_shout()

	-- 폭탄을 싫어하는 상인을 날려 보냈다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'necrodancer_merchant_dead_narration'})

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat' })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:collide_tick()
	while self.current_merchant_state == self.merchant_state.chase do
		-- 바운드가 겹쳐졌으면 잡았다는 이벤트를 발행
		-- 원래 AI측에서 검출해줘야하지만 AI측에서 제대로 검출해주지 못하는 문제가 발생해서 틱 루틴을 하나 만듬.
		-- AI 수정되면 해당 루틴은 삭제되도 무방
		local merchant = get_character('necrodancer_merchant')

		-- 무언가를 들고 있다면 탐지 범위를 늘리는 것으로 임시 처리
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
			if CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceBetween(merchant.Bounds, user_party.Leader.Bounds) < 0.7 then
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(merchant, { 'caught_target' }))
			end
		elseif CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(merchant.Bounds, user_party.Leader.Bounds) then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(merchant, { 'caught_target' }))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareBlueKnightSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareBlueKnight @
		Comment = 청기사 코스튬을 착용하고 오면 비켜주는 고블린 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.ifo_util = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions

	self.is_talking = false
end

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retreat_leader, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.ifo_util = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
		if zone_name == 'near_goblin' and not self.is_talking then
			self:near_goblin()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 고블린 근처에 갔을 때
function local_class:near_goblin()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		-- 파티원에 기사 있는지 체크
		local origin_id = user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId
		if CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.IsDefaultCharacter(origin_id) then
			-- 코스튬 착용했는지 체크
			if user_party[i].Costume ~= nil then
				-- 청기사 코스튬 착용했는지 체크
				local costume_id = user_party[i].Costume.CostumeSpec.Id
				if costume_id == 10003 or costume_id == 10001 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pass_goblin, self))
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.block_goblin, self))
end

-- 청기사 코스튬을 입은 파티원이 없을 때
function local_class:block_goblin()
	self.is_talking = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 플레이어의 위치에 따라 고블린이 보는 방향 변경
	local goblin = get_character('goblin')
	local direction = (user_party_leader.Position - goblin.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(goblin, direction)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_goblin_hit_01', parent = goblin
	})

	character_util.set_emotion(goblin, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.jump(goblin, 0.5, 0.3)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.remove_emotion(goblin)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(goblin, { name = 'release', remove_after = 0.267 * 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_2', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(goblin)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_3', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(goblin, { name = 'mad' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(goblin)

	coroutine.yield(self:retreat_leader())

	self.is_talking = false
end

-- 청기사 코스튬을 입은 파티원이 있을 때
function local_class:pass_goblin()
	self.is_talking = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local goblin = get_character('goblin')
	local pos = goblin.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
	user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 1, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.set_direction(goblin, 'left')
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = goblin
	})

	character_util.jump(goblin, 0.5, 0.3)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_5', skip = true })

	coroutine.yield(self.ifo_util.MoveTo(
		goblin, goblin.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, nil, 3, true, true))

	character_util.set_direction(goblin, 'up')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(goblin, { key = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_6', skip = true })

	goblin.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_forest_2_goblin_6'

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, true, false))
end

-- 플레이어가 뒤로 물러남
function local_class:retreat_leader()
	local goblin = get_character('goblin')
	local direction = (user_party_leader.Position - goblin.Position):ToDirection()

	local pos
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		pos = user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
		user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, 0.3, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear)
	else
		pos = user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
		user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Right, 0.3, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear)
	end
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.set_direction(goblin, 'right')

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareRequestDeliverymanSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareRequestDeliveryman @
		Comment = 폭탄 배달부의 부탁 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		begin = 0,
		--- 대기 상태
		idle = 1,
		--- 배달부 이동 진행 상태
		move = 2,
		--- 배송장소 도착
		finish = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = nil
	self.explosion_effect_name = 'FX_explosion_boss'
	self.delivery_man_name = 'bomb_deliveryman'
	self.delivery_move_coroutine = nil
	self.trap_detect_coroutine = nil

	self.skip_first = false

	self.trap_list = nil

	self.saw_delivery_man = false

	self.bomb_package_coroutine = nil
	self.bomb_sprite = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece('nightmare_delivery_star_piece') then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

		local delivery_man = get_character(self.delivery_man_name)
		delivery_man.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		character_util.set_emotion(delivery_man, { name = 'hurt' })
		character_util.set_anim(delivery_man, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_direction(delivery_man, 'left')

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.begin
		-- 택배 아이템
		self.bomb_package_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bomb_package, self))

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.explosion_effect_name)

		for i = 1, 5 do
			get_field_object('trap_' .. i).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	else
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	get_character(self.delivery_man_name).Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local banana = get_field_object('trap_' .. i)
		banana.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.saw_delivery_man then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character(self.delivery_man_name)) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.begin then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_deliveryman, self, false)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_deliveryman, self, true)
				return true
			end
		end

		for i = 1, 5 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('trap_' .. i)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.erase_banana, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'trap_zone_' .. i and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.move and
					e.FieldObject == get_character(self.delivery_man_name) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.appear_robber, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end

		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'getout_zone' and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.finish and
				e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.getout, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:erase_banana(i)

	local banana = get_field_object('trap_' .. i)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
			vector_util.to_direction(banana.Position - user_party_leader.Position)))

	local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(banana, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	local time_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(50)
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, 0.5)
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)
	time_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0.5, 0.5)
	time_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	time_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(banana, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

-- 바나나 함정 감지
function local_class:trap_detect()
	local deliveryman = get_character(self.delivery_man_name)

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.move do
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local banana = get_field_object('trap_' .. i)

			if banana.ActiveState ~= active_state("disabled") then

				-- 배달부가 바나나에 걸렸을 경우
				local dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((banana.Position - deliveryman.Position).magnitude)
				if dist < 1 then
					self.trap_list[i].ConsumeTarget = deliveryman
					banana.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_small_01')
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bomb_explosion, self))
					return
				end

				-- 유저가 밟았을 때
				dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((banana.Position - user_party_leader.Position).magnitude)
				if dist < 0.85 then
					self.trap_list[i].ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
					banana.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

					field_ui_manager:Hide()
					user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
					local dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
							vector_util.to_direction(banana.Position - user_party_leader.Position))
					character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, dir)

					if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
						character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2)
					else
						character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2)
					end

					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
					character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'hurt' })
					character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
					wait_for_sec(1)
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
					character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.04, 0.5)
					wait_for_sec(0.5)
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
					character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Direction, 0.3, 0.5)

					character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
					character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

					field_ui_manager:Show()
					user_party:ResetControllers()
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_robber(robber, speed)
	local deliveryman = get_character(self.delivery_man_name)

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.move and robber.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP > 0 do
		character_util.move_to(robber, deliveryman.Position, nil, speed, true)
		character_util.set_anim(robber, { name = 'run' })
		dist = unity_class.mathf.Abs((deliveryman.Position - robber.Position).magnitude)
		if dist < 1 then
			for i = 1, 5 do
				local temp = get_character('robber_' .. i)
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(temp, robber) then
					temp.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bomb_explosion, self))
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.move_to(robber, robber.Position, 2)
end

function local_class:throw_meat(thrower, duration)

			{ pos = thrower.Position,
			  itemid = 20032, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.7, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	local duration = duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = thrower.Position
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker('ending_party_2').position + vector(1, 0.1, 0)
	local shadow_offset = vector(-0.05, 0, -0.05)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local chalk_position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		meat.SpriteTransform.position = chalk_position
		meat.ShadowTransform.position = chalk_position + shadow_offset
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_dust(duration, dust)
	local duration = duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = dust.transform.position
	local end_pos = dust.transform.position + vector(10, 0, 0)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		dust.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dust:Dispose()
end

function local_class:make_dust(dust, duration)
	local duration = duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	local end_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2.2

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		dust.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:make_smoke(target)
	local cleaner = target

	while true do

		local rand_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1.0, 1.0)
		local rand_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-1.0, 1.0)
		local rand_duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.2, 1.0)

		stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(cleaner.Position + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
		wait_for_sec(rand_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	self.controller = controller

	self.donkey_coroutine = nil

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dodgeball_sprite')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_china_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))
	self.donkey_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.donkey_reaction, self))
	self.trainings[1] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boy_training, self))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.effect_list do
			self.effect_list[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.effect_list = nil
	end

	if self.ball ~= nil then
		self.ball:Dispose()
	end
end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 's6_exit' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.donkey_block, self)
	elseif zone_name == 's6_training' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.training_fire_shoot, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.qte_success[1] == false and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then

		self.qte_success[1] = true

		return true
	elseif self.qte_success[1] == true and self.qte_success[2] == false and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1

		if self.touch_count > 10 then
			self.qte_success[2] = true
		end

		return true
	elseif self.qte_success[1] == true and self.qte_success[2] == true and self.qte_success[3] == false and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then

		self.qte_success[3] = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:effect_resize(dust, scale, duration)
	local duration = duration
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_scale = dust.transform.localScale
	local end_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		dust.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:fire_shoot_qte()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	local donkey = get_character('donkey')

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = { 0.5, 0.8, 0.5 }
	while self.qte_success[3] == false do

		for i = 1, #self.qte_success do
			self.qte_success[i] = false
		end

		time_passed = 0
		self.touch_count = 0

		field:Darken('qte', 0.5, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		time_util.mod('china_main', 0.3)

		for i = 1, 3 do

			time_passed = 0

			self:show_qte_spine(i)

			if i == 2 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_laser_build_up_01')
			end

			while time_passed <= duration[i] do

				if self.qte_success[i] == true then
					break
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

			if self.qte_success[i] == false then
				break
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_reaction, self, i))
			end

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_util.unmod('china_main')
		field:Undarken('qte', 0.3)

		if self.qte_success[3] == false then
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

			if self.qte_success[1] == true then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.controller.move_effect, self, self.ball.transform,
								self.ball.transform.position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.5))

function local_class:jump_ball(ball_transform, char_list)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	local start_pos = ball_transform.position
	local end_pos = ball_transform.position + vector(0, 2, 0)

	local char_pos = {
		{start_pos = nil, end_pos = nil},
		{start_pos = nil, end_pos = nil}
	}

	for i = 1, #char_list do
		character_util.set_anim(char_list[i], {name = 'get'})
		char_pos[i].start_pos = char_list[i].Position
		char_pos[i].end_pos = char_list[i].Position + vector(0, 2, 0)
	end

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		ball_transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		for i = 1, #char_list do
			character_util.set_position(char_list[i],
					unity_class.vector3.Lerp(char_pos[i].start_pos, char_pos[i].end_pos, progress), true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:wait_qte(dir)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.qte_success = false
	self.qte_wait_time = 0
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(dir)

	while not self.qte_success do
		self.qte_wait_time = self.qte_wait_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.qte_success = nil
	self.progress_enum = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.qte_success[1] == false and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then

		self.qte_success[1] = true

		return true
	elseif self.qte_success[1] == true and self.qte_success[2] == false and
		e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1

		if self.touch_count > 10 then
			self.qte_success[2] = true
		end

		return true
	elseif self.qte_success[1] == true and self.qte_success[2] == true and self.qte_success[3] == false and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then

		self.qte_success[3] = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nightmare_hero, {key = 'nightmare_china_s10_5_1',

		--틴틴님! 아맹님!

		character_util.set_emotion(executive[2], {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(executive[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(executive[1],
				{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_6', skip = true})
		--이 세상에 힘의 원천이 남아 있는 이상…
		character_util.remove_anim(executive[1])

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim(executive[2], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(executive[2],
				{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_7', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
		--두령님은 언제고 돌아오신다, 이 멍청이들!
		character_util.remove_anim(executive[2])

		camera_util.move_async(npc_data[2].npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5)

		character_util.set_emotion(nightmare_hero, {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_direction(nightmare_hero, 'up')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nightmare_hero, {key = 'nightmare_china_s10_8',
																	 skip = true, portraitname = nightmare_hero_data.portrait_name})
		--힘… 힘의 원천…? 설마…!

		camera_util.move_async(boss.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_male_evil_laugh_03')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
				{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_9', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
		--후후… 멍청하게 피구 따위에 진심이라니…

		character_util.set_emotion(boss, {name = 'attack'})

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
				{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_10', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
		--이 모두 단지 나를 위한 제물들이 모인 만찬이거늘!

		character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'attack2', loop = false})

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_02')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_earthquake'):Instantiate(boss.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))

		local soul_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3)

		local crowd_soul = {}
		for i = 1, 15 do
			local crowd = nil
			crowd = get_character('dodgeball_crowd_' .. i)
			local soul = get_character('dodgeball_crowd_' .. i .. '_2')

			if i == 15 then
				crowd = get_character('dodgeball_judgement')
				soul = get_character('dodgeball_judgement_2')
			end

			table.insert(crowd_soul, soul)
			character_util.set_position(soul, crowd.Position)

			character_util.set_active_shadow(soul, false)
			character_util.set_direction(soul, 'down')
			character_util.set_emotion(soul, {name = 'scared'})
			character_util.set_anim(soul, {name = 'embarrassed'})

			soul.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
			soul.SpineController:AddColor(soul.Name, soul_color, 1, 0)
			soul.SpineController:AddFadeColor(soul.Name, soul_color, soul_color.a, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local time_passed = 0
		local fly_time = 0.5
		local fly_height = 0.7

		for i = 1, #crowd_soul do
			crowd_soul[i].SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, fly_time)
		end

		while time_passed < fly_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local curY = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, fly_height, fly_time);

			for i = 1, #crowd_soul do
				character_util.set_position(crowd_soul[i], vector(crowd_soul[i].Position.x, curY, crowd_soul[i].Position.z))
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(boss)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		local absorb_time = 1.5
		time_passed = 0

		local start_pos = {}
		local target_pos = {executive[1].Bounds.center, executive[2].Bounds.center, boss.Bounds.center}

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_prologue_wind_01')

		for i = 1, #crowd_soul do
			crowd_soul[i].SpineController:Scale(vector(0, 0, 0), absorb_time)
			crowd_soul[i].SpineController:Rotate(720, absorb_time)
			start_pos[i] = crowd_soul[i].Position
		end

		while time_passed < absorb_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, #crowd_soul do
				local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, start_pos[i].x, target_pos[i % 3 + 1].x - start_pos[i].x, absorb_time)
				local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, start_pos[i].y, target_pos[i % 3 + 1].y - start_pos[i].y, absorb_time)
				local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, start_pos[i].z, target_pos[i % 3 + 1].z - start_pos[i].z, absorb_time)
				character_util.set_position(crowd_soul[i], vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z))
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		for i = 1, 15 do
			local crowd  = get_character('dodgeball_crowd_' .. i)
			character_util.set_side_direction(crowd)
			character_util.set_emotion(crowd, {name = 'empty'})
			character_util.set_anim(crowd, {name = 'frustration', loop = false})
		end

		character_util.set_side_direction(judgement)
		character_util.set_emotion(judgement, {name = 'empty'})
		character_util.set_anim(judgement, {name = 'frustration', loop = false})

		for i = 1, #crowd_soul do
			character_util.remove_emotion(crowd_soul[i])
			character_util.set_active_state(crowd_soul[i], 'disabled')
		end
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
			{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_11', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
	--자 그럼…

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_male_evil_laugh_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(boss, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
			{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_12', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
	--스승도 문파도 없는 떠돌이들을 마저 꿀꺽해볼까!

	camera_util.move_async(npc_data[2].marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(boss)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nightmare_hero, {key = 'nightmare_china_s10_13',
																 skip = true, portraitname = nightmare_hero_data.portrait_name})
	--여전히 자기 욕망에 눈이 먼 두령…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nightmare_hero, {key = 'nightmare_china_s10_14' .. nightmare_hero_data.suffix,
																 skip = true, portraitname = nightmare_hero_data.portrait_name})
	--선산권의 이름으로 절대… 가만두지 않겠소!
	--선산권의 이름으로 절대… 가만두지 않겠어…!

	screen_util.show_boss_title('nightmare_china_boss_title', 'nightmare_china_boss_desc', 2)
	--돌아온 사파 두령
	--꽤나 드라마틱하게 귀환했습니다.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, {end_target = user_party_leader})

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, 'boss', 'boss')
	character_util.set_death_type(boss, 'none')

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local sapa = get_character('dodgeball_sapa_' .. i)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(sapa, 'boss', 'boss')
		character_util.set_death_type(sapa, 'prostrate')
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(boss))

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat' })

	local cmd = CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(boss, user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

	for i = 1, 10 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('boss_battlegate_' .. i))
	end

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(nightmare_hero, user_party, true)

	-- 주인공 무기 잠시 해제
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	if instance == true then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
