end

function local_class:fire_and_ice_blast()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event'})

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 주인공 무기 잠시 해제
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	local nightmare_hero_data = self.controller.hero_data[self.controller.nightmare_idx]
	local nightmare_hero = get_character(nightmare_hero_data.character_name)

	local origin_hero_data = self.controller.hero_data[self.controller.my_idx]
	local origin_hero = get_character(origin_hero_data.character_name)

	local heroes = {
		{
			npc = nightmare_hero,
			pos = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_team_4').position + vector(0,0, 4)
		},
		{
			npc = origin_hero,
			pos = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_hero').position
		},
		{
			npc = get_character('donkey'),
			pos = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_donkey').position + vector(0,0, 1.5)
		},
		{
			npc = user_party_leader,
			pos = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_team_3').position + vector(0,0, 5)
		}
	}

	local merchant = get_character('team_2')
	character_util.set_position(merchant, merchant.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))

	local donkey = heroes[3].npc
	local judgement = get_character('dodgeball_judgement')

	local boss = get_character('dodgeball_sapa_boss')
	local boss_marker = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_sapa_boss')
	local boss_rt_offset = vector(2.3, 4.5, 0)

	character_util.set_position(boss, boss_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -2.5))
	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'down')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(nightmare_hero)

	character_util.align_party(heroes[4].pos, 'down', 0.1)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.set_position(heroes[i].npc, heroes[i].pos)
		character_util.set_direction(heroes[i].npc, 'up')
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local sapa = get_character('dodgeball_sapa_' .. i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('dodgeball_sapa_' .. i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(sapa)
		character_util.set_position(sapa, marker.position)
		character_util.set_emotion(sapa, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.set_anim(sapa, {name = 'prostrate'})

		sapa.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	character_util.set_direction(donkey, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(donkey, {name = 'prostrate'})
	character_util.set_emotion(donkey, {name = 'damaged'})

	camera_util.move(boss.Position, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'jingak', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_instant_heal_stomp_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce'):Instantiate(nightmare_hero.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local dir = (party_member.Position - boss.Position)

		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, dir,
				13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(party_member, knockback_info)

		party_member.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(party_member, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(party_member, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 1)
	end

	local my_heros = {user_party_leader, nightmare_hero}
	for i = 1, #my_heros do
		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, {0, 0, -0.5},
				10000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(my_heros[i], knockback_info)

		my_heros[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(my_heros[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(my_heros[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)
	end

	camera_util.move(boss.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		local dir = 'right'

		if i % 2 == 1 then
			dir = 'left'
		end

		character_util.set_direction(party_member, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(party_member, {name = 'prostrate'})
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
			{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_17', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
	--나는 강해져 돌아왔건만…

	local creat_pos = boss.Position + vector(0, 5.5, 0)

	field:Tint('china_main', unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.5 }), 0.4)

	local sprit_bomb = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Chapter6_Sapa_energyball'):Instantiate(creat_pos)
	sprit_bomb.transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)

	local cast = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Chapter6_Sapa_energyball_cast'):Instantiate(creat_pos)

	music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '02_cast_magic_01', duration = 4, fade_in_time = 0.5, fade_out_time = 0.5 })
	music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '02_laser_build_up_01', delayed_time = 1, duration = 2.2, fade_out_time = 0.5 })

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'SpritBomb_ready', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'SpritBomb_loop'})

	local sprit_gather = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.change_effect_size, self, sprit_bomb.transform, 0.2, 1, 5))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_male_evil_laugh_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(boss, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
			{key = 'nightmare_china_s10_18', skip = true, offset = boss_rt_offset})
	--나약한 너희들은 한 명이 줄어 볼품도 없구나!

	character_util.remove_emotion(boss)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_china_event', state = 'event'})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(origin_hero, {name = 'gauntlet_kick2', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(origin_hero, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(origin_hero, {key = 'nightmare_china_s10_19' .. origin_hero_data.suffix,
		 skip = true, portraitname = origin_hero_data.portrait_name, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-50, -150) })
	--줄긴 누가 줄었다는 것이오!
	--줄긴 누가 줄어!

	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(origin_hero.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 4.5), 12, true, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, false)

	local duration = info:GetDuration(origin_hero.Position)

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(origin_hero, info)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 2 / 3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_slowmotion_01')

	time_util.mod('main_china', 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(duration / 3)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_ice_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash'):Instantiate(origin_hero.Position)

	camera_util.shake(1, 0.5)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(origin_hero.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(origin_hero.Position)

	local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, vector(0, 0, 1),
			15000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(boss, knockback_info)

	boss.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	character_util.remove_anim(boss)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_boss_sapa_breath_01')
	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'damage2'})

	stop_coroutine(sprit_gather)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_effect_size,
			self, sprit_bomb.transform, sprit_bomb.transform.localScale.x, 0, 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_effect_size,
			self, cast.transform, 1, 0, 0.5))

	character_util.shake(boss, 0.04, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(boss, vector(0, 0, -1), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(boss, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(boss, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	time_util.unmod('main_china')

	local fall_time = 0.5

	camera_util.resize_to_default(fall_time)

	field:RemoveTint('china_main', fall_time)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = origin_hero.Position
	local target_pos = nightmare_hero.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	local height = origin_hero.Position.y
	local calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, origin_hero.Position.y, 0);

	character_util.spine_rotate(origin_hero, 360, fall_time)
	character_util.set_direction(origin_hero, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(origin_hero, {name = 'cast'})

	while time_passed <= fall_time do
		local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.x, target_pos.x - start_pos.x, fall_time)
		local y = math.max(0, calculator:GetDistance() + height)
		local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.z, target_pos.z - start_pos.z, fall_time)

		character_util.set_position(origin_hero, vector(x, y, z), true)

		calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(origin_hero, target_pos)

	cast:Dispose()
	sprit_bomb:Dispose()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_land_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldAITaxiSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldAITaxiSection2 @
		Comment = 택시 찾는중 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- stage name
	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_demonworld_2'

	-- fx
	self.get_hit_effect = controller.get_hit_effect
	self.get_fx_black_smoke = controller.get_fx_black_smoke
	self.get_fx_smokescreen = controller.get_fx_smokescreen
	self.get_fx_last_hit = controller.get_fx_last_hit

	self.smoke_effect = nil

	-- npc
	self.get_hulk_female = controller.get_hulk_female
	self.get_burningskull = controller.get_burningskull
	self.get_oldman = controller.get_oldman
	self.get_punk_male = controller.get_punk_male
	self.get_looker = function(num) return get_character('taxi_looker_'..num) end
	self.get_street_sweeper = function(num) return get_character('taxi_street_sweeper_'..num) end

	-- object
	self.get_ai_taxi = controller.get_ai_taxi
	self.get_normal_taxi = controller.get_normal_taxi

	-- 퀘스트 진행 체크
	self.normal_taxi_event = {
		{
			sppech_bubble_loop = false,
			show = false,
			req_count = 0
		},
		{
			sppech_bubble_loop = false,
			show = false,
			req_count = 0
		}
	}

	-- 미화원 대사가 다 끝났는지
	self.saw_street_sweeper = false

	-- AI 택시한테 한번 말 걸었는지
	self.saw_taxi_event = false

	-- 헐크 여성 시작 이벤트를 봤는지
	self.saw_hulk_female = false

	-- 헐크 여성이 따라오는지
	self.follow_hulk_female = false
	self.req_count = 0
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_fx_black_smoke()
	self.get_fx_smokescreen()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	-- subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	-- 차 세팅
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local cur_car = self.get_normal_taxi(i)
		local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_'..i).position
		cur_car.Position = marker_pos
		cur_car.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.controller:stop_car(cur_car)
	end

	local ai_taxi = self.get_ai_taxi()
	ai_taxi.Position = field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_8').position
	ai_taxi.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.controller:stop_car(ai_taxi)
	self.car_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_car_loop_01', parent = ai_taxi,
									   loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	-- npc 세팅
	local street_sweeper_1 = self.get_street_sweeper(1)
	local street_sweeper_2 = self.get_street_sweeper(2)
	local sweeper_1_pos = field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_2').position + vector(-1.8,0,3)
	local sweeper_2_pos = field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_2').position + vector(0,0,1.5)
	character_util.set_position(street_sweeper_1, sweeper_1_pos)
	character_util.set_position(street_sweeper_2, sweeper_2_pos)

	character_util.set_direction(street_sweeper_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(street_sweeper_2, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(street_sweeper_1, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_anim(street_sweeper_2, { name = 'eat' })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	-- 이벤트 동선 중에 돌아다니는 차가 지나다니는 경로가 있어 제거
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'pause_car_logic', 'battle_end_pause' }))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_hulk_female(), self.controller)

	self.normal_taxi_event = nil

	-- fx
	if self.smoke_effect ~= nil then
		self.smoke_effect:Dispose()
		self.smoke_effect = nil
	end

	if self.car_sfx ~= nil then
		self.car_sfx:Stop()
		self.car_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'taxi_zone_'..i) and
			not self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop and not self.normal_taxi_event[i].show then
			self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop = true
			self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count = self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sppech_normal_taxi, self, i))
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'taxi_hulk_out_zone') and
			self.follow_hulk_female then
		self.follow_hulk_female = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_hulk_female, self, true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'taxi_zone_'..i) and
				self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop and not self.normal_taxi_event[i].show then
			self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop = false
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'taxi_hulk_zone') and
			self.follow_hulk_female then
		self.follow_hulk_female = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_hulk_female, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_normal_taxi(i)) then
			if not self.normal_taxi_event[i].show then
				self.normal_taxi_event[i].show = true
				self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop = false
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_normal_taxi_event, self, i)
			else
				if i == 1 then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
						--연기가 빠지고 나니 까맣게 타버린 가죽 시트가 보이는 택시다.
						field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_34'})
					end)
				elseif i == 2 then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
						--앞 범퍼가 완전히 박살난 택시다.
						field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_40'})
					end)
				end
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hulk_female()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_hulk_female, self)

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_ai_taxi()) then
		if self.follow_hulk_female then
			self.follow_hulk_female = false
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ai_taxi_talk_success, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ai_taxi_talk_fail, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 일반 택시 존 이벤트
function local_class:sppech_normal_taxi(i)
	local req_count = self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count
	local taxi = self.get_normal_taxi(i)

	if i == 1 then
		while self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop and self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count == req_count do
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			if self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count ~= req_count then
				return
			end
			-- 택시 쪽 말풍선 [shout] : 아… 열받게 진짜!
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01',
										 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = taxi })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(taxi,
					{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_29', bubble_type = 'shout' })

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end
	else
		local start_pos = field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_'..i).position
		local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0,0,1)
		local street_sweeper_1 = self.get_street_sweeper(1)
		local street_sweeper_2 = self.get_street_sweeper(2)
		if self.normal_taxi_event[i].sppech_bubble_loop and self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count == 1 then
			-- 한번만 실행하도록 변경
			self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count = self.normal_taxi_event[i].req_count + 1

			local duration = 0.15
			local time_passed = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_rush_01')
			self.controller:drive_car(taxi)
			while time_passed <= duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2
				local curpos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)
				taxi.Position = curpos
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.controller.collision_npc, self, street_sweeper_2, vector(0,0,2)))

			character_util.remove_anim(street_sweeper_1)
			character_util.set_direction(street_sweeper_1, 'down')
			character_util.set_emotion(street_sweeper_1, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(street_sweeper_1, true)

			self.controller:shake_3d_object(taxi, 0.5, 1)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self.controller:drive_car(taxi, true)
			while time_passed >= 0 do
				time_passed = time_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime * 0.5
				local curpos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)
				taxi.Position = curpos
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			taxi.Position = start_pos
			self.controller:stop_car(taxi)
			-- 택시 쪽 말풍선 [shout] : 망할! 제기랄! 젠장!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

			if lua_helper.type_compare(
					user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(taxi,
						{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_36', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(taxi,
						{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_36', bubble_type = 'shout' })
			end

			--야 인마, 미쳤어? 눈 똑바로 안떠?!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.set_emotion(street_sweeper_1, { name = 'mad' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(street_sweeper_1,
					{ name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

			if lua_helper.type_compare(
					user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(street_sweeper_1,
						{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_77', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(street_sweeper_1,
						{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_77', bubble_type = 'shout' })
			end

			street_sweeper_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_77'
			street_sweeper_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_80'

			self.saw_street_sweeper = true
		end
	end
end

-- 일반 택시 이벤트

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(taxi,
				{ key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_29', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		--택시 운전석 쪽에서 택시 기사가 내림. 차 안에서 캐릭터가 알파 페이드 인 하면서 나오도록

				1, nil, true,true)

				{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'mad' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(old_man, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_30', skip = true })

		--이후, 택시 뒷 좌석 쪽에서 버닝 스컬이 내림.

-- 헐크 여성과 대화
function local_class:talk_hulk_female()
	local hulk_female = self.get_hulk_female()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	party_util.align_party(hulk_female, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.look_at(hulk_female, leader)

	if not self.saw_hulk_female then
		self.saw_hulk_female = true

		-- 헐크 여성 (tired, idle) : 저 차랑 살짝 콩! 했더니 허리가 너무 아프지 뭐야…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_49', skip = true })

		-- 헐크 여성 (smile, sing) : 혹시 매력적인 자기가 한번 호~! 해줄래? 그럼 금세 나을 거 같은데…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hulk_female, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_50', skip = true })

		-- 리리스 (scared, idle) : 어… 뭐라고…? 그… 그게…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'scared' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_51', skip = true })
	else
		-- 헐크 여성 : 우웅~ 자기, 역시 나한테 호~! 해주고 싶었던 거지?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hulk_female, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_55', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(hulk_female)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(hulk_female, self.controller)

	-- 헐크 여성이 따라오도록
	self.req_count = self.req_count + 1
	self.follow_hulk_female = true
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(hulk_female, user_party, true,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone, 2)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.follow_talk_hulk_female, self))
end

-- 헐크 여성이 따라오면서 대사
function local_class:follow_talk_hulk_female()
	local hulk_female = self.get_hulk_female()
	local req_count = self.req_count

	while self.follow_hulk_female and self.req_count == req_count do
		--헐크 여성 : 우웅~ 그러지 말고 자기야~ 한번 만 호~! 해줘
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_52' })

		if not self.follow_hulk_female or self.req_count ~= req_count then break end

		--헐크 여성 : 우훗~ 튕기긴… 자기도 좋으면서~
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_53' })
	end
end

-- 헐크 여성 존 밖으로 나갈 경우
function local_class:leave_hulk_female(down)
	local down_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(down, false)

	local hulk_female = self.get_hulk_female()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local taxi = self.get_normal_taxi(3)

	character_util.look_at(leader, hulk_female)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(hulk_female)
	character_util.set_emotion(hulk_female, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(hulk_female)

	--칫, 재미없게 굴긴… 나도 빈정 상했어, 흥!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hulk_female, { key = 'nightmare_demon_ai_taxi_54', skip = true })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hulk_female, 0, 1.5)

	local x = taxi.Position.x - hulk_female.Position.x
	local z = taxi.Position.z - hulk_female.Position.z

	if math.abs(x) < math.abs(z) or down_dir then
		character_util.move_to_async(hulk_female, hulk_female.Position + vector(0,0,z).normalized * 6,
				1.5, nil, true, true)
	else
		character_util.move_to_async(hulk_female, hulk_female.Position + vector(x,0,0).normalized * 6,
				1.5, nil, true, true)
	end

	character_util.set_position(hulk_female, field:GetMarker('taxi_pos_2_3').position + vector(1,0,-0.5))
	character_util.set_direction(hulk_female, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hulk_female, 1, 1)
	character_util.add_listener(hulk_female, self.controller)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldLaviFaviSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldBartender @
		Comment = 마계 악몽 라비 파비 후일담 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 라비 (누나)
	self.lavi = nil

	-- 파비 (남동생)
	self.favi = nil

	-- 양아치들
	self.punks = {}

	-- 구경꾼들
	self.civils = {}

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.zone_name = 'favi_lavi_zone'

	self.on_dispose = false

	-- 진행도
	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		defeat_punk = 3,
		punk_event_end = 4,
		interact_start = 5,
	}

	-- 현재 진행도
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none

	self.shake_routine_on = true

	-- 라비 공격 이팩트
	self.get_lavi_attack_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_nightmare_demon_pachycephalo_explosion_small')
	end

	-- 파비 힐링 필드 이팩트
	self.get_healing_field_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_circle_effect')
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_lavi_attack_fx()
	self.get_healing_field_fx()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.lavi = get_character('favi_lavi_sister')
	self.lavi.Interactable.Talk = nil
	character_util.set_direction(self.lavi, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lavi, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.lavi, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop', loop = true })

	self.favi = get_character('favi_lavi_brother')
	self.favi.Interactable.Talk = nil
	character_util.set_position(self.favi, field:GetMarker('favi_lavi_brother_s1_start').position)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.favi, { name = 'tired' })

	local idx = 1
	while true do
		local punk = get_character('favi_lavi_punk_' .. idx)
		if punk ~= nil then
			table.insert(self.punks, punk)
		end

		local civil = get_character('favi_lavi_civil_' .. idx)
		if civil ~= nil then
			table.insert(self.civils, civil)
		end

		if punk == nil and civil == nil then
			break
		end

		idx = idx + 1
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.favi_shaking, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.on_dispose = true

	if self.shake_routine_on then
		self.shake_routine_on = false
	end

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.punk_event_end then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lavi, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.favi, self.controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local targets = { self.favi, self.lavi }
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(targets) do
		local target = targets[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, target) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lilith_talk_favi_lavi, self, target)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name) and self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starting_event, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:lilith_talk_favi_lavi(target)
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.interact_start
	local lavi = self.lavi
	local favi = self.favi
	local civils = self.civils
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.controller ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(lavi, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(favi, self.controller)
	end

	local align_duration = target == lavi and 0.5 or 1
	party_util.align_party(lavi.Position, 'right', align_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(lavi, 'right')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lavi)
	character_util.show_emoticon(lavi, nil, 'question')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(favi, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'scared' })
	self:custom_normal_jump(favi, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.move_to_async(favi, lavi.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.05), nil, 7, true, true)

	-- 누구세요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lavi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_17', skip = true })

	-- 방금 박치기…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_18', skip = true })

	-- 격투 마법이었지?
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_19', skip = true })

	-- 네. 그런데요?
	character_util.set_emotion(lavi, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lavi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_20', skip = true })

	-- 거기, 네 뒤에 숨어 있는 마족 꼬마는 회복 마법을 썼고 말이야.
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_21', skip = true })

	-- 네. 제 동생은 회복 마법을 써요. 그래서 뭐요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lavi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_22', skip = true })

	-- 서툴긴 하지만… 잘만 배우면 꽤 훌륭한 마법을 구사하겠어.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_23', skip = true })

	-- 얘들아, 리리스 재단에서 진행하는 재능 교류 프로그램 들어봤니?
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_24', skip = true })

	-- 내가 보기엔 너희 둘 다 재능이 있어 보이는데, 신청해보지 않을래?
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_25', skip = true })

	-- 아니, 아까부터 자꾸… 대체 누구시냐고요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lavi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_26', skip = true })

	-- 음… 장학금 주는 사람?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_27', skip = true })

	-- 아무튼, 둘 다 잘 생각해보고 꼭 지원해보렴.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_28', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lavi)
	character_util.set_direction(lavi, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(favi, lavi.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(favi, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(favi)
	character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 뭔 소리래… 뭐라고, 파비? 관심이 있다고?
	lavi.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_oneline_1'

	-- 우으… 응…!
	favi.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_oneline_2'

	-- 정말 단단한 머리야!
	civils[1].Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_oneline_3'

	-- 단순 무식하지만 마법을 섞어 멋진 공격이 됐어!
	civils[2].Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_oneline_4'

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

	character_util.set_anim(punks[2], { name = 'sword_attack_dash', loop = true, sfx_name = '02_sword_short_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(punks[2], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_1' })

	end))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(punks[3], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_2' })

	-- 어디 할 수 있나 보자고!
	character_util.set_anim(punks[2], { name = 'sword_idle' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', parent = lavi })
	character_util.set_anim(lavi, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack2', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lavi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_3' })

	-- 한꺼번에 덤벼!

	-- 얘들아, 덮쳐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = punks[2] })
	character_util.set_emotion(punks[2], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(punks[2], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_lavi_favi_6' })

	character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion(punks, { name = 'sword_walk' }, { name = 'doyagao' })

		character_util.remove_anim(punk)
		character_util.set_emotion(punk, { name = 'damaged' })

	end
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.defeat_punk

function local_class:civil_walk_away()
	local civils = self.civils
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(civils)

	-- 마커를 따라 구경꾼들 이동 시작
	local waypoints = {}
	local markers = field:GetAllMarkers()
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(civils) do
		local civil = civils[i]
		if civil ~= nil then
			local temp_waypoints = {}
			civil.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			local idx = 1
			while true do
				local marker_name = ('civil_' .. i .. '_waypoint_' .. idx)
				local has_value, marker = markers:TryGetValue(marker_name)
				if not has_value then
					break
				end

				idx = idx + 1
				table.insert(temp_waypoints, marker.position)
			end
			table.insert(waypoints, temp_waypoints)
			character_util.move_waypoint(civil, temp_waypoints, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor')
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			if self.on_dispose then
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- 구경꾼들 마지막 마커 근처에 도달하면 서서히 사라짐
	local end_count = 0
	local check = 0
	while true do
		if end_count == table_util.get_size(civils) then
			break
		end

		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(civils) do
			local civil = civils[i]

			if self.on_dispose then
				character_util.stop(civil)
				return
			end

			if check & (1 << i) == 0 then
				if (waypoints[i][table_util.get_size(waypoints[i])] - civil.Position).magnitude < 1 then
					field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(civil, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(civil, 0, 0.5)

					end_count = end_count + 1
					check = check | (1 << i)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(civils) do
		character_util.set_active_state(civils[i], 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:favi_shaking()
	while self.shake_routine_on do
		if self.cur_progress >= self.progress.defeat_punk then
			self.shake_routine_on = false
			break
		end

		else

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_manager()) then

				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talking_with_manager
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_manager, self))
				return true

				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talking_with_manager
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_to_retry, self))

			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_trouble
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_manager_and_bullies, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.update_promoting_zone) then
		self.player_in_promoting_zone = true

		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_talk
				or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_retry then
			-- 끝나지 않은 경우엔 어차피 루틴 내에서 빠져나오지 못했을 것임
			self:start_promoting_routine()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.update_promoting_zone) then
		self.player_in_promoting_zone = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.minigame_name and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_minigame then
		if self.main_quest_has_marker then
			local main_quest_id = 272
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_demon_world_main', main_quest_id,
					true, get_field_object('exit_nightmare_demonworld_6'))
		end

		if e.Success then
			self.current_event_state = self.event_state.done
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_success, self))
		else

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_fail, self))

-- 아이템 먹을 때 SFX가 OneShot으로 재생돼서 먹는걸 따로 만듦
function local_class:item_consume_to_target_routine(item, target, delay, duration)
	wait_for_sec(delay)

	local start_pos = item.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	local force_quit = function()
		return self.current_event_state == self.event_state.done
	end

	while time_passed < duration and force_quit() == false do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		item.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target.Position * progress

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if force_quit() then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_get_drop_item_01', parent = target,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'})
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(target.Bounds.center)

	item:ConsumeComplete()

	self.bully_get_item_count = self.bully_get_item_count + 1
end

function local_class:items_fade_routine(items, duration, start_delay)
	if start_delay then
		wait_for_sec(start_delay)
	end

	local item_sprites = {}
	local shadow_sprites = {}
	local shadow_start_alphas = {}
	local item_start_colors = {}

	for _, item in pairs(items) do
		-- 기존에 섹션 3에서 사용하던 것과 호환되도록

		local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		table.insert(item_sprites, item_sprite)
		table.insert(shadow_sprites, shadow_sprite)
		table.insert(shadow_start_alphas, shadow_sprite.Alpha)
		table.insert(item_start_colors, item_sprite.TintColor)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		for i = 1, #item_sprites do
			item_sprites[i].TintColor = item_start_colors[i] * (1 - progress)
			shadow_sprites[i].Alpha = shadow_start_alphas[i] * (1 - progress)
			item_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
			shadow_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 1, #item_sprites do
		item_sprites[i].TintColor = item_start_colors[i]
		shadow_sprites[i].Alpha = shadow_start_alphas[i]
		item_sprites[i]:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprites[i]:Rebuild()

		items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

-- 특정 존을 벗어나면 업데이트 안되도록 루틴 종료시킴
function local_class:manager_promoting_routine()
	local manager = self.get_manager()
	character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'handgun_attack'})
	self:show_hand_leaflet()

	while self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.talking_with_manager and self.player_in_promoting_zone do
		--<b>어떤 레스토랑<b>입니다…! 많이 방문해주세요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_6')

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.talking_with_manager
				or self.player_in_promoting_zone == false then
			break
		end

		--좌, 우 두리번 거리며
		manager.Direction = manager.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left
				and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	self.manager_routine_on = false
end

function local_class:start_promoting_routine()
	if self.manager_routine_on then
		return
	end

	self.manager_routine_on = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.manager_promoting_routine, self))
end

function local_class:talk_with_manager()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local manager = self.get_manager()

	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})
	party_util.align_to_target(manager, 'left', 0.8, 'linear')

	while self.manager_routine_on do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if manager.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	self:hide_hand_leaflet()
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.talked_once == false then
		self.talked_once = true

		--레스토랑 주인 : 안녕하세요, 베드 타운의 <b>‘어떤 레스토랑’<b> 입니다. 많이 방문해 주세요.
		self:show_hand_leaflet()
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'handgun_attack'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_7', skip = true})

		self:hide_hand_leaflet()
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)

		--레스토랑 주인, 전단지 아이템 리리스에게 건네줌.
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'eat'})
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
		local leaflet_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{itemid = self.leaflet_item_id, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.45,
				 pos = manager.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0),
				 target = manager.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				 lootstate = 'FixLooter', showoncharacter = true})

		leaflet_item.ConsumeTarget = lilith

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(manager)

		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		--리리스 : 베드 타운…? 그 먼 곳에서 와서 전단지를 나눠주고 계신 거예요??
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(lilith, {name = 'question', loop = false},
				nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_8')

		--레스토랑 주인 (tired, idle) : 어쩔 수 없어요… 이렇게라도 하지 않으면…
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'cast'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_9', skip = true})

		--레스토랑 주인 (cry, release 2회) : 저희 가게는 곧 폐업할 지도 모른다구요…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'cry'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_10', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)

		--레스토랑 주인 (cry) : 돌려야 할 전단지가 아직 산더미인데…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_11', skip = true})

		-- 대충 눈물 그침
		character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'tired'})
	end

	--레스토랑 주인 : (tired, sing) 혹시 홍보 전단지 돌리는 걸 도와주실 수 있을까요?
	character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'sing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_12', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_12_1')

	--플레이어 선택지
	--도와준다.
	--거절한다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_13', 'mercy'},
		{'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_14', 'brutal'}
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--리리스 (tired, idle) : 잠깐 도와드리죠, 뭐.
		character_util.play_speech_action(lilith, 'bomb_idle',
				nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_15')

		--레스토랑 주인(surprise, 점프 1회) : 정… 정말요…?
		character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.play_speech_action(manager, 'cast',
				nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_16')

		--레스토랑 주인(smile, sing) : 정말 감사합니다…!!
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'sing'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_17', skip = true})

		--화면 페이드 아웃 후
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.remove_anim(manager)

		--미니 게임 진행.
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.tutorial
		self:play_tutorial()

		self:play_minigame()

	else
		--리리스 : 죄송해요. 지금은 좀 바빠서요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_18', skip = true})

		--레스토랑 주인 (tired, idle) : 그렇군요… 어쩔 수 없죠…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager,
				{key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_19', skip = true})

		character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)

		--이벤트 종료.
		manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_talk
		self:start_promoting_routine()

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:talk_to_retry()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local manager = self.get_manager()

	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})
	party_util.align_to_target(manager, 'left', 0.8, 'linear')

	while self.manager_routine_on do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if manager.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	self:hide_hand_leaflet()
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)
	character_util.remove_emotion(manager)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레스토랑 주인 : 한 번 더 해보시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_27', skip = true})

	--플레이어 선택지
	--도와 준다.
	--그냥 간다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_13', 'mercy'},
		{'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_14', 'brutal'}
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--레스토랑 주인 (smile, release 2회) : 그럼 다시 한 번, 부탁드립니다!
		character_util.set_emotion(manager)
		character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_27_1')

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		--미니 게임 재 진행.
		self:play_minigame()
	else
		--이벤트 종료.
		character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'tired'})
		manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)

		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_retry
		self:start_promoting_routine()

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:play_tutorial()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_fat_tutorial(1),
		self.get_fat_tutorial(2),
		self.get_bully_tutorial(1),
		self.get_bully_tutorial(2),
	}

	local npc_infos = {
		{
			emotion = 'smile',
		},
		{
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'cast'
		},
		{
			emotion = 'attack',
			anim = 'release'
		},
		{
			emotion = 'attack',
			anim = 'cast2'
		}
	}

	local manager = self.get_manager()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local camera_center = field:GetMarker('leaflet_minigame_center').position

	--뚱보 시민(demon_civilian_hulk_female / demon_civilian_business_male), 위/아래로 서로 마주 보고 있음.
	--양아치들(demon_punk_male / female_b), 위/아래로 서로 마주 보고 있음.
	for index, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('leaflet_tutorial_npc_' .. index)
		local info = npc_infos[index]
		npc.Position = marker.position
		npc.Direction = marker.direction

		npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		if info.anim then
			character_util.set_anim(npc, {name = info.anim})
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = info.emotion})
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'smile'})
	manager.Position = camera_center + vector(-0.7, 0, 0)
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	lilith.Position = camera_center + vector(0.7, 0, 0)
	lilith.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	camera_util.move_async(camera_center, 0)
	coroutine.yield()

	local sfx_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_amb_city_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, nodx2) : 돌아다니는 마족들에게 전단지를 나눠주세요.
	character_util.nod_twice(manager)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_20', skip = true})

	--레스토랑 주인 (tired, question) : 몇 가지 팁이 있다면…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			'tired', 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_21')

	--레스토랑 주인 (left 방향, release 2회) : 저기 덩치 큰 마족들은 꼭 2인분씩 주문해서 매출에 큰 도움이 됩니다.
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'smile', 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_22')

	--레스토랑 주인 (right 방향, damaged, release 2회) : 하지만 저 불량한 녀석들은 근처만 가도 화를 내니 주의하세요.
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'scared', 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_23')

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, idle) : 오늘 목표는 방문객 20명을 확보하는 거예요. 그럼 부탁드립니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_24', skip = true})

	--리리스. nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(lilith)

	--화면, 페이드 아웃. 이후 미니 게임 진행
	sfx_loop:FadeOut(2)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(manager)
	manager.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:play_minigame()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_minigame
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.minigame_name)

	if ui_quest_marker:IsActiveMarker('nightmare_demon_world_main') then
		self.main_quest_has_marker = true
		quest_marker_util.remove('nightmare_demon_world_main')
	end
end

function local_class:after_fail()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local manager = self.get_manager()

	manager.Position = field:GetMarker('leaflet_center').position + vector(-5, 0, 0)
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	manager.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'tired'})

	stage_camera:SetTarget()
	party_util.align_party(manager, 'left', 0, 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})

	coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--레스토랑 주인(tired, release 2회) : 오늘 목표 손님을 모으지 못했네요…
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, 'cast',
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_25')

	--레스토랑 주인(tired, cross_arm) : 애써주셔서 감사하지만… 당장 다음달 임대료가 걱정이네요…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_26')

	character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_retry

	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self:start_promoting_routine()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:after_success()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local manager = self.get_manager()

	self.get_bully_npc(1).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.get_bully_npc(2).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	--레스토랑 주인, (left, smile, rifle_idle) 상태로 maiden_phone을 손에 들고 있음.
	manager.Position = field:GetMarker('leaflet_center').position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	manager.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_emotion(manager, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'twohand_idle'})
	manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'maiden_phone')

	stage_camera:SetTarget()
	party_util.position_party(manager.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 'left', 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--레스토랑 주인 : 네네! 화요일 2시에 4명이요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_28', skip = true})

	--레스토랑 주인 : 그 때 뵙겠습니다, 감사합니다~!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_29', skip = true})

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	--레스토랑 주인, 플레이어 쪽으로 다가옴.
	manager.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, cast) : 이게 몇 주만에 받는 예약 전화인지…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_phone_call_fail_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, 'cast',
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_30')

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, clap) : 감사합니다! 모두 홍보를 잘 해주신 덕분이에요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, 'clap',
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_31')

	--레스토랑 주인, 스타피스 드랍.
	character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'cast2'})
	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('leaflet_star_piece'),
			manager.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0))
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(manager)

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, idle) : 언젠가 저희 식당에 한 번 방문해주세요! 특별히 대접해 드리겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_32', skip = true})

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, release 2회) : 기대하셔도 좋아요. 저희 캔터베리안 파스타가 그렇게 맛있거든요!
	character_util.play_speech_action(manager, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_33')

	--리리스 (smile, nodx2) : 기대하고 있을게요.
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.nod_twice(lilith)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_34', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})

	--레스토랑 주인 (smile, idle) : 그럼 저는 이만 가보도록 하겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, {key = 'nightmare_demonworld_leaflet_35', skip = true})

	--레스토랑 주인, 좌측길로 떠나 사라짐.
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(manager, {waypoints = {
		manager.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0),
	}, speed = 4})

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(manager, 0, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(manager, {waypoints = {
		manager.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
	}, speed = 4})

	manager.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)

	--이벤트 종료.
	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldMadeleineSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldMadeleine @
		Comment = 마들렌을 먹어보는 리리스 후일담 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.madeleine_item_spec_name = 'lilithtower_cookie'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.madeleine_seller_event_zone_name = 'madeleine_seller_event'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_madeleine_seller = function() return get_character('madeleine_seller') end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local madeleine_seller = self.get_madeleine_seller()

	character_util.set_emotion(madeleine_seller, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.add_listener(madeleine_seller, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local madeleine_seller = self.get_madeleine_seller()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(madeleine_seller, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local madeleine_seller = self.get_madeleine_seller()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, madeleine_seller) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_madeleine_seller, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.madeleine_seller_event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.speech_madeleine_seller, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:speech_madeleine_seller()
	local madeleine_seller = self.get_madeleine_seller()

	-- 판매자 : 달콤 바삭 마들렌이에요!
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(madeleine_seller)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(madeleine_seller, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_madeleine_1' })
end

function local_class:interact_madeleine_seller()
	local madeleine_seller = self.get_madeleine_seller()

	-- 판매자 인터랙션 시 이벤트
	-- 파티, 판매자 우측으로 한칸 띄어서 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(madeleine_seller, 'right', 1)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_demonworld_madeleine_1_1', 'mercy' }, { 'nightmare_demonworld_madeleine_1_2', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- [ 마들렌을 구매한다. ] 선택 시 대화 이벤트
		-- 리리스 (smile, release 2회) : 음, 냄새가 엄청 좋네요~ 마들렌 하나 주시겠어요?
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_madeleine_2', skip = true })

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldMainSection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldMain @
		Comment = 비키와의 보스전 @
		Index = 9 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		enter = 2,
		two_floor = 3,
		boss = 4
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_demonworld_6'

	-- 리소스 홀더
	self.resholder = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_swordslash_light')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_dying_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_demon_world_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('main_tower_enter'))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	local marker_target = {get_field_object('main_tower_enter'), get_field_object('main_tower_1_a'),
						   get_field_object('main_tower_2_b'), get_field_object('boss_door')}

	if zone_name == 'section_9_enter' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.viki_call_1, self)

		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'section_9_2f' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.two_floor
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.viki_call_2, self)

		return true
	else
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if zone_name == 'main_marker_' .. i then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_demon_world_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_target[i])

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('boss_door')) then--and
			--self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.two_floor then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.boss

		--test
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_boss_event, self)
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.quest_clear, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_dying_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, get_character('cyborg_erina')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.quest_clear, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'muted', mix = 0})
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:viki_call_1()
	local lilith = user_party.Leader

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(lilith, field:GetMarker('main_tower_enter').position,
			2, false, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, {name = 'tired'})
	local txt = game_string:GetString('nightmare_demonworld_s9_1')
	local sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create('secretary_vicky', 'demon_android_small', txt, true)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj))
	--언제 오세요, 여왕님?? 비키가 기다리고 있어요!

	local sns_popped = false

	local event_receiver = {}
	event_receiver.on_sns_poped = function(e)
		sns_popped = true
		return false

function local_class:city_parallax_scrolling(city_back_table, start_pos, end_pos, time)
	local time_passed = 0
	local increment = 0.3
	local start_positions = {}

	for i, back in ipairs(city_back_table) do
		table.insert(start_positions, back.localPosition)

	end

	while time_passed < time do
		for i, back in ipairs(city_back_table) do

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[i], end_pos[i], time_passed / time)
			back.localPosition = cur_pos
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	for i, back in ipairs(city_back_table) do
		-- table.insert(start_positions, back.localPosition)
		back.localPosition = end_pos[i]
	end

end

return local_class

	self.main_quest_marker_name = 'nightmare_demon_world_main'
	self.main_quest_marker_target = nil

	self.saw_check = {false, false, false}

	self.phone = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('police_station_entrance'))
	self.main_quest_marker_target = get_field_object('police_station_entrance')

end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.phone ~= nil then
		self.phone:ConsumeComplete()
		self.phone = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('odile'), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end


function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	for i = 1, 3 do
		if zone_name == 'section_2_event_' .. i and self.saw_check[i] == false then
			self.saw_check[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.section_2_event, self, i))
		end
	end

	local marker_target = {get_field_object('police_station_entrance'), get_character('odile')}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if zone_name == 'main_marker_' .. i then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, marker_target[i])
			self.main_quest_marker_target = marker_target[i]
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('odile') ) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.police_odile, self, false)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	local interact_handle_name = e.ExitHandleName

	local object_name = self.controller:get_outside_exit_interact_object_name(interact_handle_name)
	if object_name ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, object_name)
	else
		object_name = self.controller:get_inside_exit_interact_object_name(interact_handle_name)
		if object_name ~= nil then
			start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.main_quest_marker_target)
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:section_2_event(number)
	local demon = {}
	if number == 1 then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			demon[i] = get_character('demon_' .. i)
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[1], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_1' })
		--뉴스 봤어? 벌써 다섯 번째 살인이래…

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[2], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_2' })
		--이번에 죽은 사람은 오디션 프로그램 세실 경쟁자였다며? 사실 세실이 사주한 거 아냐?

		character_util.shake(demon[3], 0.04, 99999)
		character_util.set_emotion(demon[3], {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[3], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_3' })
		--내일 세실 팬 사인회 가려고 했는데… 잘못 갔다가 나도 죽는 거 아냐…?

	elseif number == 2 then
		for i = 4, 6 do
			demon[i] = get_character('demon_' .. i)
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(demon[4], {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[4], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_4' })
		--두 번째인가 세 번째 피해자는 세실 따라해서 유명해진 신인이었대…

		character_util.set_emotion(demon[5], {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[5], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_5' })
		--이쯤 되면 세실이 방치한다고 봐야 하는 거 아냐? 자기 때문에 마족이 죽어나가는데…

		character_util.set_emotion(demon[6], {name = 'mad'})
		character_util.set_anim(demon[6], {name = 'release'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[6], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_6' })
		--세실 언니가 죽인 것도 아닌데 무슨 말을 그렇게 해?!
		character_util.remove_anim(demon[6])
	elseif number == 3 then
		for i = 7, 8 do
			demon[i] = get_character('demon_' .. i)
		end

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(demon[7], {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[7], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_7' })
		--동네가 뒤숭숭해서야… 경호 안드로이드라도 장만해야 하나…

		character_util.set_emotion(demon[8], {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon[8], { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s2_8' })
		--요새는 직장이나 구청에서 대량 구매해서 지급도 해준다던데, 한 번 알아봐.
	end

	local odile = get_character('odile')
	character_util.set_with_marker(odile, field:GetMarker('odile'))

	character_util.set_anim(odile, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.add_listener(odile, self.controller.cs_controller)

	local gremory = get_character('gremory')
	character_util.set_with_marker(gremory, field:GetMarker('gremory'))
	character_util.set_direction(odile, 'left')
	character_util.spine_rotate(gremory, 5, 0)
	gremory.SpineController:AddFadeColor(gremory.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)

	self.phone = drop_item_util.create_item( { pos = field:GetMarker('phone').position + vector(-0.1, 0, 0), itemid = 20017,

		success = 3,

function local_class:on_pre_load()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_demonceo_support_fire')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		self.controller:set_default_quest_marker()
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, field:GetMarker('manager').position)
	self.main_quest_marker_target = field:GetMarker('manager').position
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('odile'), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end


function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_4_manager' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none  then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.meet_manager
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_manager, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_4_hide' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.stoker  then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.hide
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hide_behind_manager, self)
	else
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if zone_name == 'section_4_talk_' .. i and self.check_talk[i] == false then
				self.check_talk[i] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.just_talk, self, i))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'touch_down'
		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	local interact_handle_name = e.ExitHandleName

	local object_name = self.controller:get_outside_exit_interact_object_name(interact_handle_name)
	if object_name ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, object_name)
	else
		object_name = self.controller:get_inside_exit_interact_object_name(interact_handle_name)
		if object_name ~= nil then
			start_coroutine(self.change_main_quest_marker, self, self.main_quest_marker_target)
		end
	end
	return false
end
