function local_class:follow_routine()
	local manager = get_character('manager')
	local lilith = user_party.Leader
	local odile = get_character('odile')

	self.manager_check = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_system, self))

	local move_offset = manager.Position

	self.move_info = {
		{pos = move_offset + vector(0, 0, -2), speed = 2},
		{pos = move_offset + vector(10, 0, -2), speed = 2},
		{pos = move_offset + vector(10, 0, 18), speed = 3},
		{pos = move_offset + vector(18, 0, 18), speed = 3},
		{pos = nil, dir = 'left'},
		{pos = move_offset + vector(32, 0, 18), speed = 3},
		{pos = nil, dir = 'left'},
		{pos = move_offset + vector(40, 0, 18), speed = 3},
	}

	self.move_index = 1

	while self.move_index <= #self.move_info and self.current_end_state == self.end_state.none do
		if self.move_info[self.move_index].pos ~= nil then

			if self.move_index < 3 then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_demon_world_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.move_info[2].pos)
				self.main_quest_marker_target = self.move_info[2].pos
			elseif self.move_index < 4 then
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_demon_world_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.move_info[3].pos)
				self.main_quest_marker_target = self.move_info[3].pos
			else
				CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_demon_world_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.move_info[8].pos)
				self.main_quest_marker_target = self.move_info[8].pos
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(manager, self.move_info[self.move_index].pos,
					self.move_info[self.move_index].speed, self.move_info[self.move_index].speed >= 4 and true or false)

			while manager.Position ~= self.move_info[self.move_index].pos do
				if self.current_end_state ~= self.end_state.none then
					break
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		else
			wait_for_sec(1)
			self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.silence
			character_util.set_direction(manager, self.move_info[self.move_index].dir)
			wait_for_sec(3)
		end

		self.move_index = self.move_index + 1
	end

	self.manager_check = true

	if self.current_end_state == self.end_state.none then

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(manager, { manager.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
													  manager.Position + vector(3, 0, 3) },
				3, false)

		character_util.set_direction(manager, 'right')
		character_util.set_locked_dir(manager, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'jump', loop = false})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump_move(manager, manager.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 0), 2, 0.5, true, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'hurt'})

		self.manager_seat = true
	else
		screenplay_operations.disable_control(true)
		screenplay_operations.hide_fieldUI(true)

		if self.current_end_state == self.end_state.detected then
			camera_util.move_async(manager.Position, 0.5)
			character_util.look_at(manager, lilith)

			character_util.look_at(lilith, manager)
			character_util.look_at(odile, manager)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lilith, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(odile, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(manager,
					{name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, {name = 'attack'})
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_12', skip = true })
			--뭐야, 당신들!?

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_13' })
			--타겟에게 들켰다…

		elseif self.current_end_state == self.end_state.failed then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			character_util.set_side_direction(lilith)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lilith,
					{name = 'dead1', sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', loop = false}, {name = 'damaged'})
			wait_for_sec(2)
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_16' })
			--타겟을 놓쳤다…
		end

		self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.idle
		self.current_end_state = self.end_state.none

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.set_position(manager, field:GetMarker('manager').position)
		character_util.set_direction(manager, 'down')

		character_util.set_position(odile, field:GetMarker('hide').position)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		character_util.set_position(lilith, odile.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_direction(odile, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'right')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(odile)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lilith)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(manager)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(odile, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_9', skip = true })
		--조용히 따라가며 지켜보도록 하지.

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(lilith)

		character_util.set_direction(odile, 'right')

		local manager_pos = field:GetMarker('manager').position + vector(0, 0, 1)
		camera_util.move_async(manager_pos, 1)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(manager, 'down')

		manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'soylent_red_can')
		manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'soylent_red_can')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'bomb_idle'})

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_10', skip = true })
		--누나들이 사오라고 했던 게 이거 맞겠지…?

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manager, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_s4_11', skip = true })
		--누나들 요새 스케줄 많아서 힘들 텐데… 나라도 열심히 챙겨줘야지…

		character_util.set_direction(manager, 'right')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
		manager.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
		local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(manager, {name = 'eat'})
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(manager)
		equip_sfx:Stop()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.stoker
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.follow_routine, self))

		screenplay_operations.disable_control(false)
		screenplay_operations.hide_fieldUI(false)
	end
end

function local_class:check_system()
	local manager = get_character('manager')
	local lilith = user_party.Leader

	local emoticon_infos = {
		emoticon_time = {0.5, 1.3, 0.2},
		duration = 2
	}

	local current_emoticon = nil
	local notice_cooltime = 2
	local notice_time_passed = 0

	local view_unit_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(vector(0, 0, 0), unity_class.vector3.one * 0.05)

	while self.manager_check == false and self.current_end_state == self.end_state.none do

		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local dist_target = manager
		local to_leader_vec = lilith.transform.position - dist_target.transform.position
		local dist_to_player = to_leader_vec.magnitude

		local wall_blocking = false
		view_unit_bounds.center = dist_target.transform.position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(view_unit_bounds, to_leader_vec)
		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) == false then
				wall_blocking = true
				break
			end
		end
		obj_list:Dispose()

		-- 타겟이 플레이어를 인식한 경우
		if self.current_notice_state ~= self.notice_state.idle and self.current_notice_state ~= self.notice_state.cooldown then
			if self.current_notice_state == self.notice_state.question then
				if notice_time_passed == 0 then
					character_util.stop(dist_target)
					current_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(dist_target,nil,
							'question', nil, {emoticon_time = emoticon_infos.emoticon_time})
					notice_time_passed = notice_time_passed + delta_time

				elseif notice_time_passed > emoticon_infos.duration then
					self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.silence
					notice_time_passed = 0
					current_emoticon = nil
					music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = dist_target,
												type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
				else
					notice_time_passed = notice_time_passed + delta_time
				end

			elseif self.current_notice_state == self.notice_state.silence then
				-- 서로 눈이 마주쳤을 때
				if wall_blocking == false then
					character_util.look_at(dist_target, lilith)
				end

				if dist_to_player < 3 and wall_blocking == false then
					-- 실패
					self.current_end_state = self.end_state.detected

				else
					if notice_time_passed == 0 then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
						current_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(dist_target,
								nil, 'silence', nil,
								{emoticon_time = emoticon_infos.emoticon_time})
						notice_time_passed = notice_time_passed + delta_time
						character_util.look_at(dist_target, lilith)

					elseif notice_time_passed > emoticon_infos.duration then
						current_emoticon = nil
						self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.cooldown
						notice_time_passed = 0
					else
						notice_time_passed = notice_time_passed + delta_time
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- 다시 인식하기 전까지 쿨타임 부여
			if self.current_notice_state == self.notice_state.cooldown then
				if notice_time_passed < notice_cooltime then
					notice_time_passed = notice_time_passed + delta_time
				else
					notice_time_passed = 0
					self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.idle

					if self.current_end_state == self.end_state.none then
						if self.move_info[self.move_index].pos == nil then
							self.move_index = self.move_index + 1
						end
						character_util.move_waypoint(manager, self.move_info[self.move_index].pos,
								self.move_info[self.move_index].speed, self.move_info[self.move_index].speed >= 4 and true or false)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- 거리 체크
		if self.current_end_state == self.end_state.none then
			-- 남편 중심으로 거리 체크

			if dist_to_player < 1.5 and wall_blocking == false then
				-- 너무 가까이 있는 경우 즉시 걸림
				self.current_end_state = self.end_state.detected

			elseif dist_to_player < 3 and wall_blocking == false then
				-- 의심 단계
				if self.current_notice_state == self.notice_state.idle then
					self.current_notice_state = self.notice_state.question
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dist_target)
					notice_time_passed = 0
				end

			elseif dist_to_player > 10 then
				self.current_end_state = self.end_state.failed
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type, count, time)
	self.touch_count = 0
	local default_count = lua_helper.get_or_default(count, 0)

	local time_passed = 0
	local check_type = nil

	local check_func = {
		function ()
			return self.touch_count < default_count and time_passed <= time
		end,
		function ()
			return self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed <= time
		end,
	}

	if type == 'touch_down' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
		check_type = 1
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
		check_type = 2
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	while check_func[check_type]() do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if time_passed > time then
		self.qte_success = false
	else
		self.qte_success = true
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:change_main_quest_marker(quest_marker_point)
	local marker_point = nil
	if lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_point, CS.Oak.FieldObject) or lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_point, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3) then
		marker_point = quest_marker_point
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(quest_marker_point) then
		marker_point = get_field_object(quest_marker_point)
	end


	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if marker_point ~= nil then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
				self.main_quest_marker_name,
				marker_point, true)
	end
end

end

function local_class:city_parallax_scrolling(city_back_table, start_pos, end_pos, time)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_positions = {}

	for i, back in ipairs(city_back_table) do
		table.insert(start_positions, back.localPosition)

	end

	while time_passed < time do
		for i, back in ipairs(city_back_table) do

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[i], end_pos[i], time_passed / time)
			back.localPosition = cur_pos
		end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldPaparazziPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldPaparazzi @
		Comment = 파파라치 퀘스트 완료 이후 에필로그 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이벤트 진행도
	self.event_progress = {
		event_start = 1,
		show_invader_shout = 2,
		hide_invader = 3,
		ending = 4,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.event_start

	-- stage name
	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_demonworld_6'

	-- effect
	self.get_invader_beam_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Event_InvaderBeam') end

	-- npc
	self.get_paparazzi = function() return get_character('paparazzi') end
	self.get_invader_reporter = function() return get_character('paparazzi_invader') end

	-- zone
	self.epilogue_zone_name = 'paparazzi_epilogue_'

	-- marker
	self.epilogue_invader_marker = 'paparazzi_epoilogue_invader'

	-- 스트링 키
	self.first_string_key = 'nightmare_demonworld_paparazzi_'

	-- 에필로그 보았는지 여부 커스텀 키
	self.show_epilogue_key = 'show_epilogue'

	-- 에필로그를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_epilogue = false

	-- 인베이더가 소리치는 이벤트를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_shout_invader = false

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_invader_beam_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	self.is_show_epilogue = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.show_epilogue_key)
	if self.is_show_epilogue >= 0 then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 파파라치 초기 좌표 세팅
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi)
	character_util.set_active_state(paparazzi, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'left')
	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.epilogue_invader_marker).position
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, pos)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.is_show_epilogue >= 0 then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_show_epilogue >= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local lilith = user_party.Leader
	local invader = self.get_paparazzi()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, self.epilogue_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.event_start then
		-- 휴… 내가 이딴 일이나 하려고 기자가 됐나…
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.show_invader_shout
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader, { key = self.first_string_key .. 34
		, world_pos = vector(-41, 0, -59) })
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, self.epilogue_zone_name .. 2)
			and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.show_invader_shout then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.epilogue, self)
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 에필로그
function local_class:epilogue()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	local invader_reporter = self.get_invader_reporter()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(paparazzi)

	-- 리리스 앞쪽으로 이동
	character_util.move_waypoint(lilith, vector(-48.5, 0, -58.5), 2, false
	, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	-- 카메라가 파파라치 쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-50, 0, -58.5), 0.5)

	-- 사진 작가 (tired, idle) : 어우, 갑갑해 죽겠네. 아무도 없으니까…
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(paparazzi, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(paparazzi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 35, skip = true })

	-- 사진 작가, eat 상태로 뒤척이다가 펑 터지면서 인베이더 기자(invader_reporter)로 캐릭터 변경.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(paparazzi, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(paparazzi.Position)

	character_util.set_active_state(invader_reporter, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(invader_reporter, paparazzi.Position)
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_reporter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi)
	character_util.set_active_state(paparazzi, 'disabled')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')

	-- 리리스: (surprise, 점프) 이, 인베이더…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(lilith, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = self.first_string_key .. 36, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(lilith)
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 인베이더 기자 (tired, idle) : 젠장, 언제까지 이런 잡스러운 기사만 써야 하는 거야…
	character_util.set_emotion(invader_reporter, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_reporter, { key = self.first_string_key .. 37, skip = true })

	-- 인베이더 기자 (tired, idle) : 별 것도 아닌 마족한테 욕이나 먹고, 건진 사진도 없고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_reporter, { key = self.first_string_key .. 38, skip = true })

	-- 인베이더 기자 attack 표정으로 바뀌고 0.5초 후 대사
	character_util.set_emotion(invader_reporter, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 인베이더 기자 (attack 표정, idle) : 두고 봐…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_reporter, { key = self.first_string_key .. 39, skip = true })

	-- 인베이더 기자 (attack 표정, victory_get) : 언젠가는 꼭… 인류 역사에 길이 남을 최고의 기사를 쓰겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_reporter, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_reporter, { key = self.first_string_key .. 40, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_reporter)

	-- 인베이더 기자, FX_Event_InvaderBeam와 함께 사라짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_invader_beam_01')
	self.get_invader_beam_effect():Instantiate(invader_reporter.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.set_active_state(invader_reporter, 'disabled')

	-- 카메라 돌아옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 리리스 : (tired, cross_arm) 마계에 인베이더가 숨어들다니…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lilith, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = self.first_string_key .. 41, skip = true })

	-- 리리스 : (tired, nod x2) 별 영향력은 없어 보이는 녀석이었지만… 사진은 없애길 잘했어.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(lilith, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = self.first_string_key .. 42, skip = true })

	-- 리리스, 이벤트 종료. 컨트롤 돌아옴.
	self.is_show_epilogue = 1
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.show_epilogue_key, 1)

	-- 리리스 이모션 애니메이션 리셋
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lilith)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldPaparazziSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldPaparazzi @
		Comment = 리리스를 뒤쫓는 사진작가 섹션 1 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이벤트 진행도
	self.event_progress = {
		event_start = 1,
		first = 2,
		second = 3,
		interact_paparazzi = 4,
		puzzle_start = 5,
		puzzle_end = 6,
		ending = 7,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.event_start

	-- field object
	self.get_puzzle_switch = function() return get_field_object('paparazzi_reset_switch') end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('paparazzi_star_piece') end
	self.get_spike = function(i) return get_field_object('paparazzi_spike_' .. i) end

	-- Zone Name
	self.first_event_zone_name = 'paparazzi_first_event'
	self.second_event_zone_name = 'paparazzi_second_event'
	self.run_paparazzi_zone_name = 'run_paparazzi'

	-- Marker
	self.first_paparazzi_marker_name = 'first_paparazzi_point'
	self.second_paparazzi_marker_name = 'second_paparazzi_point'
	self.run_paparazzi_marker_name = 'run_paparazzi_point'
	self.puzzle_marker_name = 'paparazzi_puzzle_'

	-- string_key
	self.first_string_key = 'nightmare_demonworld_paparazzi_'

	-- 파파라치가 주변을 살피고 있는지 여부
	self.is_look_around_paparazzi = false

	-- 루틴이 퍼즈 상태인지?
	self.is_pause_routine = false

	-- 퍼즐 진행 중인지?
	self.is_play_puzzle = false

	-- 청홍벽이 청색 벽 상태인지?
	self.is_blue_wall = true

	-- 블록 막힘 여부 체크용
	self.puzzle_block_state = { false, false, false }

	-- 퍼즐 진행중 일때 위치해 있는 마커 index
	self.marker_index = nil

	-- 파파라치 뛰는 속도
	self.paparazzi_run_speed = 9.5

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_fx_hit()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent), 'on_convert_wall_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 파파라치 초기 좌표 세팅
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.first_paparazzi_marker_name)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(paparazzi, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	character_util.set_active_state(paparazzi, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, marker.position + unity_class.vector3.down * 1.3)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	self.is_exit = true

	-- 파파라치 구독해제
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(paparazzi, self.controller)

	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.puzzle_start then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.is_look_around_paparazzi = false
	self.is_play_puzzle = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, paparazzi) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.second then
			-- 사진을 찍은 파파라치에게 말거는 이벤트
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.interact_paparazzi
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_paparazzi, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.puzzle_end then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local lilith = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, self.first_event_zone_name)
			and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.event_start then
		-- 시작했을 때 첫번째 이벤트 존에 입장했을 때
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.first
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.photo_talking_first, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, self.second_event_zone_name)
			and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.first then
		-- 한번 사진 찍인 후 두번째 이벤트 존에 입장했을 때
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.second
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.photo_talking_second, self))
		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.interact_paparazzi then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, 'run_paparazzi_show_zone') then
			self.is_pause_routine = false
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, self.run_paparazzi_zone_name) then
			-- 사진 두번 찍인 후 파파라치에게 인터렉트 한 뒤에 이벤트 존에 입장했을 때
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.puzzle_start
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.run_paparazzi, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.puzzle_start then
		-- 퍼즐 진행 중일 때 블록 밀림 체크
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local fo_name = 'paparazzi_push_block_' .. i
			local block = get_field_object(fo_name)
			if e.Zone.Name == fo_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, block) then
				self.puzzle_block_state[i] = true
				return true
			end
		end

		-- 퍼즐 구역에 왔을 때 퍼즐 퍼즐 해제
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, lilith, 'paparazzi_puzzle_zone') then
			self.is_pause_routine = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local lilith = user_party.Leader
	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.interact_paparazzi
			and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, lilith, 'run_paparazzi_show_zone') then
		self.is_pause_routine = true
		return true
	elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.puzzle_start
			and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, lilith, 'paparazzi_puzzle_zone') then
		self.is_pause_routine = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.puzzle_start then
		return false
	end

	local puzzle_switch = self.get_puzzle_switch()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, puzzle_switch) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			for i = 1, #self.puzzle_block_state do
				self.puzzle_block_state[i] = false
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_convert_wall_changed_event(e)
	self.is_blue_wall = e.State ~= CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE
	return true
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.puzzle_start then
		return false
	end

	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local spike = self.get_spike(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, spike) then
			-- 스파이크와 충돌하면 게임 오버
			if not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(paparazzi.Bounds, spike.Bounds)) < constants.epsilon) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attack_paparazzi, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_overlapped_xz_area(bounds1, bounds2)
	local min_x = math.max(bounds1.min.x, bounds2.min.x)
	local min_z = math.max(bounds1.min.z, bounds2.min.z)
	local max_x = math.min(bounds1.max.x, bounds2.max.x)
	local max_z = math.min(bounds1.max.z, bounds2.max.z)

	return math.max(0, max_x - min_x) * math.max(0, max_z - min_z);
end

-- 사진 찍는 연출
function local_class:take_picture(paparazzi, is_in_screen)
	-- 하나, 둘, 치즈~
	local cur_screen_pos = nil
	if not is_in_screen then
		cur_screen_pos = vector(-125, 450)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(paparazzi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_02')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.14, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

-- 파파라치에게 최초로 사진 찍힐 때
function local_class:photo_talking_first()
	-- 잠시 컨트롤 뺏고
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	-- 사진 작가, 오브젝트 뒤에서 unique/take_picture 자세로 고개를 빼꼼 내밀며 등장
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_hit_01')
	local target_pos = field:GetMarker(self.first_paparazzi_marker_name).position
	character_util.move_to(paparazzi, target_pos + vector(0, 0.26, 0)
	, 0.3, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	character_util.set_anim(paparazzi, { name = 'unique/take_picture', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 이후, 스크린 잠시 하얗게 틴트를 줘서 사진 찍는 연출 진행.
	self:take_picture(paparazzi, screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(vector_util.get_x0z(paparazzi.Position)))

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(paparazzi)
	character_util.move_to(paparazzi, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.down * 1.3
	, 0.1, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 리리스가 up 방향으로 emoticon_bubble_question 띄우면 사진 작가는 다시 오브젝트 아래로 숨어버림.
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'up')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lilith, nil, 'question')

	-- 파파라치 다음 좌표로 이동
	target_pos = field:GetMarker(self.second_paparazzi_marker_name).position + unity_class.vector3.down * 1.3
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi)
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, target_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'left')

	-- 컨트롤 돌아옴.
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 파파라치에게 두번째 사진 찍힐 때
function local_class:photo_talking_second()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	local target_pos = field:GetMarker(self.second_paparazzi_marker_name).position

	-- 사진 작가, left, unique/take_picture(루프 X) 자세로 오브젝트 뒤에서 고개를 빼꼼 내밀며 등장. 이후 카메라 셔터 터지는 연출

end

-- 사진찍힌 후 파파라치 상호작용
function local_class:interact_paparazzi()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(paparazzi, self.controller)
	paparazzi.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))

	-- 파파라치 앞으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(vector(-14, 0, -48), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 선택지) 너 방금 내 사진 찍었지?! / 예쁘게 찍혔어?
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.first_string_key .. 2, 'brutal' }
	, { self.first_string_key .. 3, 'forced' } })

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(paparazzi)

	local string_key = choose_result == 1 and self.first_string_key .. 2 or self.first_string_key .. 3
	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(lilith, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lilith, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	end
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	-- 사진 작가, scared, embarrassed 이후 아래 쪽으로 빠르게 도주. 카메라 밖으로 사라짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(paparazzi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 43, life_time = 0.75 })
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	-- 파파라치 도주
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'down')
	character_util.jump_move(paparazzi, paparazzi.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2, 5, 1,
			true, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.move_to_async(paparazzi, paparazzi.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	, nil, 5, false, false)
	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lilith)
	end
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(paparazzi, paparazzi.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 5
	, nil, 5, false, false)

	-- 파파라치 다음 포지션으로 이동
	character_util.remove_anim(paparazzi)
	character_util.shake(paparazzi, 0.03, 9999)
	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.run_paparazzi_marker_name).position
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, pos)
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'right')

	-- 리리스 (attack 표정, down, 점프x2) : 뭐야, 저 자식?! 내 사진 찍은 거 맞지?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'attack' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, lilith, true))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = self.first_string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 리리스 (attack 표정, down) : 저 사진… 저대로 두면 안 돼…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lilith, { key = self.first_string_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lilith)

	-- 파파라치 캐릭터 쉐이크 좌우 방향 둘러보는 루틴 시작
	self.is_pause_routine = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.look_around_paparazzi_routine, self))
end

function local_class:look_around_paparazzi_routine()
	local is_right = true
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	self.is_look_around_paparazzi = true
	self.is_pause_routine = false
	while self.is_look_around_paparazzi do
		if not self.is_pause_routine then
			local dir = is_right and 'right' or 'left'
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = paparazzi
			, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', loop = false })
			character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, dir)
			is_right = is_right == false
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 파파라치가 리리스를 보고 도망가는 이벤트
function local_class:run_paparazzi()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	-- 사진 작가, (surprise, jump 1회) [shout] : 죄송해요!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	self.is_look_around_paparazzi = false
	paparazzi.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.stop_shake(paparazzi)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi)
	character_util.set_emotion(paparazzi, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'right')
	character_util.normal_jump(paparazzi, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(paparazzi, { key = self.first_string_key .. 6, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 사진 작가, (damaged, embarrassed) 상태로 플레이어가 못 따라오는 속도로 빠르게 도주
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(paparazzi
	, { vector(-34.5, 0, -60.5), vector(-34.5, 0, -69) }
	, 10, true, nil, nil, 'left')
	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.puzzle_marker_name .. 1).position
	character_util.set_position(paparazzi, pos)

	-- MoveFieldObjectEvent 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')

	-- 파파라치 이동 연출 루틴 시작 플레이어가 도착하기 전까지는 pause
	self.is_play_puzzle = true
	self.is_pause_routine = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.paparazzi_puzzle_routine, self))
end

-- 퍼즐방 파파라치 움직이는 로직
function local_class:paparazzi_puzzle_routine()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	-- 현재 캐릭터가 위치하고 있는 마커 인덱스
	self.marker_index = 1

	-- 파파라치가 움직이고 있는 중인가?
	local is_move = false

	-- 파파라치 z축 히트박스 크기 조정
	paparazzi.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 0.6))

	-- 퍼즐이 끝날 때까지 (파파라치가 벽에 박을 때까지) 도는 루틴
	while self.is_play_puzzle do
		if not is_move and not self.is_pause_routine then
			-- 리리스와 거리 체크 / 거리가 4보다 가까울 때 다른 마커로 이동한다.
			character_util.look_at(paparazzi, lilith)
			local distance = vector_util.get_x0z(paparazzi.Position - lilith.Position).magnitude
			if distance < 3 then
				is_move = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_paparazzi
				, self, paparazzi, lilith, function() is_move = false end))
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 파파라치 히트박스 원복
	paparazzi.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))
end

function local_class:move_paparazzi(paparazzi, lilith, call_back)
	-- 죄… 죄송해요…! 너무 예쁘셔서 그만…! / 하, 한 번만 봐주세요!
	local rnd_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(paparazzi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_paparazzi_1_' .. rnd_index
	, life_time = 1 })

	if self.marker_index == 1 then
		-- [ 1에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = lilith.Position.z > paparazzi.Position.z and 5
				or (lilith.Position.x > paparazzi.Position.x and 2 or 3)
	elseif self.marker_index == 2 then
		-- [ 2에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = math.abs(lilith.Position.x - paparazzi.Position.x) < 2 and 1 or 4
	elseif self.marker_index == 3 then
		-- [ 3에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = math.abs(lilith.Position.x - paparazzi.Position.x) < 2 and 1 or 6
	elseif self.marker_index == 4 then
		-- [ 4에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = math.abs(lilith.Position.x - paparazzi.Position.x) < 2 and 5 or 2
	elseif self.marker_index == 5 then
		-- [ 5에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = lilith.Position.z < paparazzi.Position.z and 1
				or (lilith.Position.x > paparazzi.Position.x and 4 or 6)
	elseif self.marker_index == 6 then
		-- [ 6에서 시작했을 때 ]
		self.marker_index = math.abs(lilith.Position.x - paparazzi.Position.x) < 2 and 5 or 3
	end

	local way_point = field:GetMarker(self.puzzle_marker_name .. self.marker_index).position
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(paparazzi, way_point,
			self.paparazzi_run_speed, true, nil, nil, 'left', true)
	if call_back then
		call_back()
	end
end

-- 스파이크에 맞고 날라가는 사진작가
function local_class:attack_paparazzi()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()
	character_util.stop(paparazzi)

	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.puzzle_end
	self.is_play_puzzle = false

	-- 으악
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(paparazzi.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.1))
	character_util.set_direction(paparazzi, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(paparazzi, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.jump(paparazzi, 1, 0.4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_victim_girl_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(paparazzi, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_paparazzi_1_3', life_time = 1 })
	character_util.move_to(paparazzi, vector(-34, 0, -78), 0.4, nil, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 리스너 구독
	paparazzi.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.add_listener(paparazzi, self.controller)

	-- MoveFieldObjectEvent 구독해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
end

-- 쓰러져있는 사진 작가 상호작용 후 엔딩 이벤트
function local_class:ending()
	local lilith = get_party_leader()
	local paparazzi = self.get_paparazzi()

	party_util.align_party(paparazzi.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 사진 작가, 부들부들 떨다가 마리오 점프로 기상.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldRescusWyvernPreSeciton')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldRescusWyvern @
		Comment = 새끼 와이번 구하기 퀘스트 수락 전 @
		Index = -1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.mother_wyvern = nil

	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		talked = 2
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	self.mother_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_mother')
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.mother_wyvern)

	character_util.set_position(self.mother_wyvern, self.mother_wyvern.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.add_listener(self.mother_wyvern, self)

	local item_pos = field:GetMarker('milk_bucket_marker').position
	self.controller.milk_bucket_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = item_pos, itemid = self.controller.milk_bucket_item_id,
														lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.mother_wyvern, self)

	self.controller.is_interacting = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.controller.is_interacting and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.mother_wyvern) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_mother_wyvern, self))
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDemonWorldRescueWyvernSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDemonWorldRescueWyvern @
		Comment = 새끼 와이번 구하기 퀘스트 수락 후 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.game_name = 'RoadCrossingGame'

	self.road_crossing_game = nil
	self.is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	self.mother_wyvern = nil

	self.progress = {
		-- 초기
		none = 1,
		-- 미니게임 실패
		fail = 2,
		-- 미니게임 성공
		success = 3
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none

	-- 스타피스 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'rescue_wyvern_star_piece'

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.main_quest_id = 272
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.controller.milk_bucket_item == nil then
		local item_pos = field:GetMarker('milk_bucket_marker').position
		self.controller.milk_bucket_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = item_pos, itemid = self.controller.milk_bucket_item_id,
																		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
	end

	self.mother_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_mother')

	if self.controller.should_play_minigame then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_minigame, self))
	else
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.mother_wyvern, { name = 'hurt', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.add_listener(self.mother_wyvern, self)
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.mother_wyvern)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.mother_wyvern, self)

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.mother_wyvern) then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.mother_wyvern, self)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_mother_wyvern, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		ui_quest_marker:Show(self.main_quest_id, true)

		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.activity_success, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.activity_fail, self)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:play_minigame()
	mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, 'nightmare_demonworld_1', function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end)
	else
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local baby_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_cub_minigame_' .. i)
		baby_wyvern.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	end

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	ui_quest_marker:Show(self.main_quest_id, false)

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.game_name)
end

function local_class:interact_mother_wyvern()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local mother_wyvern = self.mother_wyvern
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(mother_wyvern)
	party_util.align_party(mother_wyvern.Position, 'left', 1)

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		screen_util.quest_accept_event()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 새끼들 상태가 심상치 않으니까, 어서 데려와야겠어!
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_12', skip = true })

		-- 캬릉!
		character_util.remove_emotion(mother_wyvern)
		character_util.set_anim(mother_wyvern, { name = 'happy', loop = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_04')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_wyvern, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_13', skip = true })

		self:play_minigame()
	else
		screen_util.quest_decline_Event()
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(mother_wyvern)
		character_util.add_listener(mother_wyvern, self)

		self.controller.is_interacting = false

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end
end

function local_class:activity_success()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.success

	-- 길 잃은 아기 와이번 지우기
	local lost_baby_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_lost_baby_wyvern')
	if lost_baby_wyvern ~= nil then
		character_util.set_active_state(lost_baby_wyvern, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 구경꾼 지우기
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local audience = get_character('wyvern_audience_' .. i)
		if audience ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(audience, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local mother_wyvern = self.mother_wyvern
	local eat_sfx_holder = nil

	local len = 2
	local baby_wyverns = {
		get_character('wyvern_cub_1'),
		get_character('wyvern_cub_2')
	}

	for i = 1, len do
		local adorable_baby_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_cub_target_' .. i)
		table.insert(baby_wyverns, adorable_baby_wyvern)

		character_util.set_emotion(adorable_baby_wyvern, { name = 'blush' })

		character_util.set_position(adorable_baby_wyvern, mother_wyvern.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction) * 0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_03')

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(adorable_baby_wyvern, self.controller.get_baby_wyvern_pos(i + 2),
				1.5, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

		if eat_sfx_holder == nil then
			eat_sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true })
		end

		character_util.remove_emotion(adorable_baby_wyvern)
		character_util.set_anim(adorable_baby_wyvern, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(mother_wyvern, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, mother_wyvern.Position.z), nil, 1.5, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mother_wyvern, { name = 'happy', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_04')

	if eat_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		eat_sfx_holder:Stop()
		eat_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(baby_wyverns) do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(baby_wyverns[i], { name = 'happy', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.show_emoticon(baby_wyverns[i], nil, 'heart')
	end

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mother_wyvern, { name = 'happy', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(mother_wyvern, nil, 'heart')

	-- 어미 와이번 플레이어에게 이동하는 경로
	local waypoint = {
		vector(leader.Position.x + 0.75, 0, mother_wyvern.Position.z),
		leader.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0)
	}

	character_util.remove_anim(mother_wyvern)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mother_wyvern, waypoint, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	character_util.look_at(leader, mother_wyvern)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mother_wyvern, { name = 'happy', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	-- 고마워할 거 없어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_15', skip = true })

	-- 캬릉!
	character_util.set_anim(mother_wyvern, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_wyvern, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_13', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, mother_wyvern.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0),
			leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local call_baby_pos = field:GetMarker('wyvern_call_baby_pos').position
	local jump_pos = field:GetMarker('wyvern_jump_pos').position

	waypoint = nil
	waypoint = {
		vector(call_baby_pos.x, 0, mother_wyvern.Position.z),
		-- 어미 와이번 아기들 처다보는 위치
		call_baby_pos
	}

	local speed = 3
	character_util.remove_anim(mother_wyvern)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mother_wyvern, waypoint, speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_03')
	character_util.set_direction(mother_wyvern, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(mother_wyvern, { name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mother_wyvern)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mother_wyvern, jump_pos, speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(mother_wyvern, mother_wyvern.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), speed, 0.8, true)

	character_util.move_to(mother_wyvern, jump_pos + vector(0, 0, -5), nil, speed, true, true)

	-- 얘들아, 엄마 말씀 잘 듣고~ 행복하렴!
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_16', skip = true })
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 아기 와이번 이동 경로
	waypoint = nil
	waypoint = {
		jump_pos,
		jump_pos + vector(0, 0, -5)
	}

	local last_idx = table_util.get_size(baby_wyverns)
	local idx = last_idx

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_wolves_running_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_04')

	while true do
		character_util.remove_anim(baby_wyverns[idx])
		if idx == 1 then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(baby_wyverns[idx], waypoint, speed, false, 'stop', 'floor')
			break
		else
			character_util.move_waypoint(baby_wyverns[idx], waypoint, speed, false, 'stop', 'floor')
			idx = idx - 1
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(baby_wyverns) do
		character_util.set_active_state(baby_wyverns[i], 'disabled')
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(mother_wyvern, 'disabled')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false)
end

function local_class:activity_fail()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.fail

	local mother_wyvern = self.mother_wyvern

	-- 끼잉
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_hurt_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_wyvern, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_10', skip = true })

	character_util.add_listener(mother_wyvern, self)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDesertMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDesertMain @
		Comment = 괴물과 마주치는 사냥꾼들. @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_desert_1'
	self.fake_hold_up_coroutine = nil

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	-- preload the stuff
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.fake_hold_up_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:opening()
	local tint_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8)

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local drift_sand = get_field_object('drift_sand_' .. i)
		local renderer = drift_sand:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

		local mat = renderer.material
		mat.shader = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.Find('Unlit/Texture Tint')
		mat.color = tint_color
	end

	field:Tint(nil, tint_color, 0.1)

	local worm = get_character('desert_bull_worm')
	character_util.set_position(worm, field:GetMarker('section_1_worm').position + vector(0, -2, 0))
	worm.SpineController:AddFadeColor('worm', unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)

	local worm_sand = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown')
			   :Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(worm.Position), unity_class.quaternion.identity, worm.Transform)
	self:set_sanddown_color(worm_sand, false)

	worm_sand.transform.localScale = vector(0.9, 1, 1)

	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('section_1_start').position
	local hunters_pos = {start_pos, start_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0.5), start_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5)}
	local hunters = {get_character('valentino'), get_character('carl'), get_character('ronnie')}

	character_util.set_emotion(hunters[1], {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(hunters[2], {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(hunters[3], {name = 'tired'})

	for i = 1, #hunters do
		character_util.set_position(hunters[i], hunters_pos[i])
		character_util.set_direction(hunters[i], 'right')
	end

	local bomb = get_field_object('bomb_1')
	-- 폭탄에 안맞게 Ethereal
	bomb.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	command_util.execute_holdup(hunters[2], bomb, hunters[2].Position, 0, false)

	stage_camera:Move(start_pos, 0, hunters[1])

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event'})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_dash_06')

	local sink_sand = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_sink_sand_01', loop = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.hunter_jump, self, hunters[1]))

	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.hunter_jump, self, hunters[2], true))

	wait_for_sec(0.02)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.hunter_jump, self, hunters[3]))

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hunters[1],
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s1_0', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(worm.Position + vector(25, 0, 0), 7.2, false)
	local worm_duration = info:GetDuration(worm.Position)
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(worm, info)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hunters[3],
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s1_0_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'lb'})

	wait_for_sec(worm_duration - 1.2)

	local waypoints = {}

	for i = 1, 8 do
		local pos = field:GetMarker('section_1_worm_waypoint_' .. i).position
		pos.y = -2
		waypoints[i] = pos
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint(worm, waypoints, 5,
			false, 'loop', nil, nil, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #hunters do
		character_util.set_direction(hunters[i], 'left')
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hunters[2],
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s1_1', skip = true })
	--못 생긴 자식…

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(hunters[3], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hunters[3],
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s1_2', skip = true })
	--어서, 폭탄을 던져!
	character_util.remove_anim(hunters[3])

	character_util.stop(worm)
	character_util.move_to(worm, worm.Position + vector(0, -4, 0), 0.5, nil, nil, nil, false)

	stop_coroutine(self.fake_hold_up_coroutine)
	character_util.remove_anim(hunters[2], true)
	command_util.execute_holdup(hunters[2], bomb, hunters[2].Position, 0, false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	command_util.execute_throw(hunters[2], bomb, vector(-1, 0, 0),
			hunters[2].Position, 8, true)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	character_util.set_position(worm, vector(-65.8, -6, 28.75))
	character_util.move_to(worm, worm.Position + vector(0, 4, 0), 1, nil, nil, nil, false)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

function local_class:fake_hold_up(character, fo)

	command_util.execute_throw(character, fo, vector(1, 0, 0),

function local_class:set_sanddown_color(sand_down, is_origin)
	local renderer = sand_down.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	if renderer == nil then
		return
	end

	local mat = renderer.material

	local color = unity_class.color(0.3, 0.25, 0.25, 0.4)

	--if is_origin then
	--	color = unity_class.color(0.5188679, 0.4288867, 0.2129316, 0.5019608)
	--end

	mat:SetColor("_TintColor", color)
end

function local_class:reset_drift_sand()
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local tint_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.6, 0.8)

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(tint_color, unity_class.color.white, progress);

		for i = 1, 12 do
			local drift_sand = get_field_object('drift_sand_' .. i)
			local renderer = drift_sand:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

			local mat = renderer.material
			mat.color = color
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	--- progress setup
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	quest_icon:PreLoad()

	return true

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_character('desert_elf_villager_1'))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if sponge_bob ~= nil then
		if sponge_bob.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			sponge_bob.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	local hunters = {get_character('valentino'), get_character('carl'), get_character('ronnie')}
	for i = 1, #hunters do
		if hunters[i] ~= nil then
			hunters[i].Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.food = nil

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 마빈과 이야기 함
		talk_marvin = 1,
		--- 광신도들을 팸
		beat_zealot = 2
	}

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_desert_3'
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	--- progress setup
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))
		return
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('cave_entrance'))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
end

function local_class:exit()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_desert_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:sand_storm(target)
	-- 원둘레에 생성될 이펙트의 상대 위치를 미리 계산한다.
	local amount = 8
	local unit_angle = 360 / amount

	local storm_sound = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_cyclone_02', loop = true, fadeInTime = 2 })
	local effect_direction = {}
	local sand_storms = {}
	for i = 1, amount do
		local add_angle = unit_angle * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, add_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward

		local pos_diff = dir * 2
		effect_direction[i] = pos_diff

		local storm = self.storm_effect:Instantiate(target + pos_diff)
		storm.transform.localScale = vector (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)

		self.out_effect:Instantiate(target + pos_diff).transform.localScale = vector (0.6, 0.6, 0.6)

		sand_storms[i] = storm
	end

	local marvin = get_character('marvin')

	character_util.set_emotion(marvin, {name = 'attack'})

	party_util.set_emotion({name = 'surprise'})
	party_util.set_anim({name = 'embarrassed'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local dir
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			dir = 'left'
		else
			dir = 'right'
		end

		party_util.set_direction(dir)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	storm_sound:FadeOut(2)

	local duration = 1.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local show_damage = false

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)

		for i = 1, amount do
			sand_storms[i].transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(target + effect_direction[i], target - effect_direction[i], progress)
		end

		if progress > 0.4 and not show_damage then
			show_damage = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sand_storm_damage, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	duration = 0.5
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)
		local cur_scale_value = 0.55 * (1 - progress)

		for i = 1, amount do
			sand_storms[i].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * cur_scale_value
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, amount do
		sand_storms[i]:Dispose()
	end

function local_class:catch(target)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local down_time = 0.5

	local start_y = -5.5

	local attach_y = -4
	local is_attach = false

	local tentacle = get_character('tentacle_1')

	character_util.set_position(tentacle, vector(target.Position.x, start_y, target.Position.z))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sink_sand_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, down_time)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < down_time do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, 0, 1, down_time))
		local cur_y = start_y * (1 - progress)

		character_util.set_position(tentacle, vector(tentacle.Position.x, cur_y, tentacle.Position.z))

		if not is_attach and cur_y > attach_y then
			is_attach = true
			target.SpineController:Rotate(180, 0.5)
			target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

			character_util.set_anim(target, {name = 'embarrassed'})

			local bone_follower = target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
			bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
			bone_follower:SetBone(self.tentacle_bone_name)

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		punch = 1,
		motorcycle = 2,
		rush = 3,
		ending = 4
	}

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_desert_5'

	self.punch = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	--- progress setup
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))
		return
	end

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_sneak_blood')
end

function local_class:exit()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_desert_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	local marvin = get_character('marvin')
	if marvin ~= nil then
		if marvin.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			marvin.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end
	end

	self.punch = nil
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDesertMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDesertMain @
		Comment = 그라보이드와의 전투 승리 후 엔딩 @
		Index = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 그라보이드를 폭탄으로 유인
		bomb = 1,
		--- 그라보이드와 배틀
		battle = 2,
		--- 그라보이드 전투 승리 후
		victory = 3
	}

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_desert_6'

	self.bomb_count = 0

	self.dying_end = false

	self.nag = nil

	self.tentacle_effect = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_dying_end_event')

	--- progress setup
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Out')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Ready')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_sneak_blood')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('exit_1'))
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('nightmare_desert_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, field:GetMarker('section_7_graboid').position)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_desert_main')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))

	if self.tentacle_effect ~= nil then

		for i = 1, #self.tentacle_effect do
			self.tentacle_effect[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.tentacle_effect = nil
	end

	self.nag = nil
end

function local_class:before_bomb()
	local marvin = get_character('marvin')
	local sponge_bob = get_character('sponge_bob')
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local reset_holdable_object = function(holdable_object)
		message_system:SendSync(holdable_object, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object'):Instantiate(holdable_object.Position)
		-- 해당 시점부터 베틀게이트 밖으로 나갈 수 없고, 보스 연출 후 바로 로비로 이동
		holdable_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	-- 화로를 들고 존으로 들어온 경우
	if leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(leader))
		reset_holdable_object(hold_target)
	else
		-- 존 밖에서 화로를 던지고 들어온 경우
		local zone = field:GetZone('section_7_boss')
		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = obj_list[i]
			if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour) then
				reset_holdable_object(fo)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.nag then
		stop_coroutine(self.nag)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sponge_bob)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(marvin)
	local marvin_marker = field:GetMarker('section_7_marvin')
	local marvin_moved = false

	character_util.move_waypoint(marvin, marvin_marker.position, 6, false,
			nil, nil, 'right', true, 0, function()
				marvin_moved = true
			end)

	character_util.align_party(marvin_marker.position, 'right', 1.5)

	while not marvin_moved do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(marvin, {name = 'question', loop = false})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin,
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s7_1', skip = true, portraitname = 'desert_slave' })
	--진동을 느끼면 온다고 했었나?

	character_util.remove_anim(marvin)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marvin,
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s7_2', skip = true, portraitname = 'desert_slave' })
	--폭탄을 바닥에 터뜨리면 되겠군.

	character_util.set_direction(marvin, 'right')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(sponge_bob, {name = 'cast2'})
	character_util.set_emotion(sponge_bob, {name = 'surprise'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sponge_bob,
			{ key = 'nightmare_desert_s7_3', skip = true })
	--네?? 일부러 폭탄을 터뜨려서 이 쪽으로 부르려고요?!

	character_util.remove_anim(sponge_bob)

function local_class:tentacle_down(tentacle, effect_index)
	local effect_pos = self.tentacle_effect[effect_index].transform.position

	self.tentacle_effect[effect_index]:Dispose()

	local temp_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown'):Instantiate(effect_pos)

	local burrow = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Ready'):Instantiate(tentacle.Position)

	character_util.move_to_async(tentacle, vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position) + vector(0, -6, 0), 0.667, nil, false, false)

	burrow:Dispose()
	temp_effect:Dispose()
end

function local_class:tentacle_up(tentacle, effect_index)
	local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position) + vector(0, 0.09, -0.05)

	local temp_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown')
			:Instantiate(effect_pos)

	character_util.set_anim(tentacle, { name = 'out', loop = false })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Out'):Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position))

	character_util.move_to_async(tentacle, tentacle.Position + vector(0, 5.7, 0), 0.667, nil, false, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(tentacle)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	effect_pos = temp_effect.transform.position

	temp_effect:Dispose()

	self.tentacle_effect[effect_index] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sanddown')
			:Instantiate(effect_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, tentacle.Transform)
end

function local_class:nagging()
	local sponge_bob = get_character('sponge_bob')

	local index = 1
	while true do
		wait_for_sec(1)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sponge_bob, { key = 'nightmare_desert_s5_' .. index })

		index = index + 1

		if index > 3 then
			break
		end
	end

	self.nag = nil
end

function local_class:sand_storm(target)
	local graboid = get_character('boss_graboid')

	-- 원둘레에 생성될 이펙트의 상대 위치를 미리 계산한다.
	local amount = 8
	local unit_angle = 360 / amount

	local storm_sound = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_cyclone_02', loop = true, fadeInTime = 2 })
	local effect_direction = {}
	local sand_storms = {}
	for i = 1, amount do
		local add_angle = unit_angle * i
		local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, add_angle, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward

		local pos_diff = dir * 2.5
		effect_direction[i] = pos_diff

		local storm = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Sandwind_proj'):Instantiate(target + pos_diff)
		storm.transform.localScale = vector (0.55, 0.55, 0.55)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Out'):Instantiate(target + pos_diff).transform.localScale = vector (0.6, 0.6, 0.6)

		sand_storms[i] = storm
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_sink_sand_02')
	character_util.set_anim(graboid, { name = 'in', loop = false, scale = 1.3 })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Sandmonster_Out'):Instantiate(graboid.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local duration = 2.5

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)

		for i = 1, amount do
			sand_storms[i].transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(target + effect_direction[i], target - effect_direction[i], progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	duration = 0.5
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	storm_sound:FadeOut(2)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)
		local cur_scale_value = 0.55 * (1 - progress)

		for i = 1, amount do
			sand_storms[i].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * cur_scale_value
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, amount do
		sand_storms[i]:Dispose()
	end

	sand_storms = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDesertMerchantSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
