		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.ifo_util = CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions
	self.current_item_index = -1
	self.satisfied_index = 99
	self.dissatisfied_index = 100
end

function local_class:enter()

end

function local_class:start()
	local merchant = get_character('merchant')
	merchant.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_selling, self, true))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.guest_tables ~= nil then
		self.guest_tables:Clear()
		self.guest_tables = nil
	end

	if self.guests ~= nil then
		for i = 0, 8 do
			if self.guests[i]["coroutine"] ~= nil then
				stop_coroutine(self.guests[i]["coroutine"])
			end
		end
		self.guests = nil
	end

	local merchant = get_character('merchant')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(merchant.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		merchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	if self.selling_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.selling_coroutine)
		self.selling_coroutine = nil
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.ifo_util = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	local merchant = get_character('merchant')

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, merchant) then
			self.selling_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_selling, self, false))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.item_tables[0]) then
			if self.current_item_index == 0 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
			else
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_holdup_01')
			end
			self:interact_table(0)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.item_tables[1]) then
			if self.current_item_index == 1 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
			else
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_holdup_01')
			end
			self:interact_table(1)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.item_tables[2]) then
			if self.current_item_index == 2 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
			else
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_holdup_01')
			end
			self:interact_table(2)
		elseif self.guest_tables:Contains(e.Target) then
			local table_index  = self.guest_tables:IndexOf(e.Target)
			if self.current_item_index >= 0 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
				if self.waiting_item[table_index] == self.current_item_index then
					self.waiting_item[table_index] = self.satisfied_index
				else
					self.waiting_item[table_index] = self.dissatisfied_index
				end
				self:interact_table(self.current_item_index)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and self.current_item_index >= 0 then
			self:sync_holding()
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:start_selling(do_tutorial)
	local merchant = get_character('merchant')
	local merchant_pos = merchant.Position

	if do_tutorial then
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "clap", loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'nightmare_desert_merchant_start_4', skip = true })
	else
		character_util.align_party(merchant, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "question", loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'nightmare_desert_merchant_retry', skip = true })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black)

	user_party_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	user_party_leader.Position = vector(-68.5, 0, 18.5)

	local removed_members = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.ICharacter))

	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		for i = 1, user_party.Count -1 do
			removed_members:Add(user_party[i])
		end
	end

	if removed_members.Count > 0 then
		for i  = 0, removed_members.Count - 1 do
			removed_members[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			character_util.convert_to_npc(removed_members[i])
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.controller.item_tables.Count - 1 do
		self.controller.item_tables[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	if self.guest_tables == nil then
		self.guest_tables = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObject))
		for i = 0, 7 do
			self.guest_tables:Add(get_field_object(string.format("guest_table_%d", i + 1)))
			self.guest_tables[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end

		self.assigned = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
		self.waiting_item = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
		for i = 0, self.guest_tables.Count - 1 do
			self.assigned:Add(0)
			self.waiting_item:Add(-1)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.assigned.Count -1 do
		self.assigned[i] = 0
		self.waiting_item[i] = -1
	end

	if self.guests == nil then
		self.guests = {}
		for i = 0, 2 do
			local guest = {}
			guest["character"] = get_character(string.format("guest_fast_%d", i + 1))
			guest["active"] = false
			guest["speed"] = 2
			guest["character"].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			guest["coroutine"] = nil
			self.guests[i] = guest
		end

		for i = 0, 2 do
			local guest = {}
			guest["character"] = get_character(string.format("guest_normal_%d", i + 1))
			guest["active"] = false
			guest["speed"] = 1.5
			guest["character"].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			guest["coroutine"] = nil
			self.guests[i + 3] = guest
		end

		for i = 0, 2 do
			local guest = {}
			guest["character"] = get_character(string.format("guest_slow_%d", i + 1))
			guest["active"] = false
			guest["speed"] = 1
			guest["character"].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			guest["coroutine"] = nil
			self.guests[i + 6] = guest
		end
	else
		for i = 0, 8 do
			self.guests[i]["active"] = false
			self.guests[i]["character"].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			self.guests[i]["coroutine"] = nil
		end
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	if do_tutorial then
		local pos = self.controller.item_tables[1].Position
		pos.z = self.guest_tables[3].Position.z
		merchant.Position = pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		merchant.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "idle", loop = true})
		camera_util.move(merchant.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0)
	else
		merchant.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 튜토리얼 시작

	if do_tutorial then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_1", skip = true})

		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "release", loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_2", skip = true})
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "idle", loop = true})

		user_party_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		camera_util.move(self.controller.item_tables[1].Position, 1.0)
		wait_for_sec(2)
		camera_util.move(merchant.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1.0)
		wait_for_sec(1.0)

		user_party_leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_3", skip = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_4", skip = true})
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "question", loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_5", skip = true})
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "release", loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_6", skip = true})
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "idle", loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_tutorial_7", skip = true})

		character_util.move_to(merchant, merchant.Position + vector(0, 0, 6), 1.5, nil, true, true, false)
		camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 1.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		merchant.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	-- 튜토리얼 종료

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_activity_clear_01')
	if self.retry == nil then
		self.retry = 0
	end
	if self.retry % 2 == 1 then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(string.format("%s ", game_string:GetString("nightmare_desert_merchant_sell_start"), self.retry))
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("nightmare_desert_merchant_sell_start"))
	end
	self.retry = self.retry + 1

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2.5
	})
	wait_for_sec(2.0)

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.sell_time_passed = 0
	local sell_phase_1_time = 15
	local sell_phase_2_time = 30
	self.sell_wrongs = 0

	local num_spawns = 0
	local phase_1_spawn_time = 5
	local phase_2_spawn_time = 3.75
	local phase_3_spawn_time = 3

	local manual_touch_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		local controls_to_disable = CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super
		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(user_party.Leader, controls_to_disable)
	end

	local failed = false
	while self.sell_time_passed < 45 do
		if self.sell_wrongs >= 3 then
			failed = true
			break
		end

		local to_spawn = 1
		if self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_1_time then
			to_spawn = to_spawn + math.floor(sell_phase_1_time / phase_1_spawn_time)
		else
			to_spawn = to_spawn + math.floor(self.sell_time_passed / phase_1_spawn_time)
		end

		if self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_2_time then
			to_spawn = to_spawn + math.floor((sell_phase_2_time - sell_phase_1_time) / phase_2_spawn_time)
		elseif self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_1_time then
			to_spawn = to_spawn + math.floor((self.sell_time_passed - sell_phase_1_time) / phase_2_spawn_time)
		end

		if self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_2_time then
			to_spawn = to_spawn + math.floor((self.sell_time_passed - sell_phase_2_time) / phase_3_spawn_time)
		end

		local free_count = 0
		for i = 0, self.assigned.Count - 1 do
			if self.assigned[i] == 0 then
				free_count = free_count + 1
			end
		end

		if free_count == 0 then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Insufficient table")
		end

		if to_spawn > num_spawns and free_count > 0 then
			num_spawns = num_spawns + 1
			local table_index = -1
			local table_pick_index = math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, free_count)) % free_count
			for i = 0, self.assigned.Count - 1 do
				if self.assigned[i] == 0 then
					if table_pick_index > 0 then
						table_pick_index = table_pick_index - 1
					else
						self.assigned[i] = 1
						table_index = i
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if table_index < 0 then
				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Table index wrong")
				table_index = 0
			end

			-- 손님 스폰
			local fast_roll = 0
			local normal_roll = 0.1

			if self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_2_time then
				fast_roll = 0.5
				normal_roll = 1.0
			elseif self.sell_time_passed >= sell_phase_1_time then
				fast_roll = 0.25
				normal_roll = 1.0
			end

			local roll = CS.UnityEngine.Random.value
			local spawned_guest = nil

			if roll < fast_roll then
				for i = 0, 2 do
					if self.guests[i]["active"] == false then
						spawned_guest = self.guests[i]
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if roll < normal_roll and spawned_guest == nil then
				for i = 3, 5 do
					if self.guests[i]["active"] == false then
						spawned_guest = self.guests[i]
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if spawned_guest == nil then
				for i = 6, 8 do
					if self.guests[i]["active"] == false then
						spawned_guest = self.guests[i]
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if spawned_guest ~= nil then
				if spawned_guest["coroutine"] ~= nil then
					CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Guest coroutine duplicate")
				end
				spawned_guest["active"] = true
				spawned_guest["coroutine"] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guest_routine, self, spawned_guest, table_index))
			end
		end

		self.sell_time_passed = self.sell_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field', mix = 1.5
	})

	-- 종료
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader, true)
	self.current_item_index = -1

	if removed_members.Count > 0 then
		for i = 0, removed_members.Count -1 do
			removed_members[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			-- 마빈한테는 무적을 걸어준다
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(removed_members[i], get_character('marvin')) then
				character_util.convert_to_party_member(removed_members[i], user_party, true)
			else
				character_util.convert_to_party_member(removed_members[i], user_party, false)
			end
		end
	end

		if coroutine ~= nil then
			-- FIXME: 이모티콘 반환, AttackQueue 반환
			stop_coroutine(coroutine)
			self.guests[i]["coroutine"] = nil
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(c))
			c:CancelShake()
		end

	merchant.Position = merchant_pos
	merchant.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	if failed then
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "release", loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(merchant, { name = "attack" })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "clap", loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(merchant, { name = "happy" })
	end

	character_util.align_party(merchant, 'right', 0)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black)

	if failed then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.15)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_failed_1", skip = true })
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clap_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_success_1", skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_success_2", skip = true })
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "question", loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_success_3", skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_success_4", skip = true })
		character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = "get", loop = false})

		local star_piece = get_field_object("nightmare_merchant_star_piece")
		message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(star_piece.Position))

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = "nightmare_desert_merchant_success_5", skip = true })

function local_class:interact_table(table_index)
	if self.current_item_index >= 0 then
		self.controller.items[self.current_item_index].Position = self.controller.item_positions[self.current_item_index]
		--unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_reset_object"):Instantiate(self.controller.item_positions[self.current_item_index])
	end

	if table_index == self.current_item_index then
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader, true)
		self.current_item_index = -1
	else
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "hold", upper = true, loop = false })
		if user_party_leader:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.Character) then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_get"):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, user_party_leader.Transform)
		end
		self.current_item_index = table_index
		self:sync_holding()
	end
end

function local_class:sync_holding()
	if self.current_item_index >= 0 then
		self.controller.items[self.current_item_index].Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 1.25, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:guest_routine(guest, table_index)
	local duration = 6.0 / guest["speed"]
	local table_pos = self.guest_tables[table_index].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	local out_pos = self.guest_tables[table_index].Position + vector(0, 0, 5)
	local move_duration = 2.0
	local character = guest["character"]
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 입장
	character.Position = out_pos
	character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "walk", loop = true })

	while time_passed < move_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local prog = time_passed / move_duration
		if prog >= 1 then
			character.Position = table_pos
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "idle", loop = true})
			break
		else
			character.Position = table_pos * prog + out_pos * (1 - prog)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림
	local item_index = math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, self.controller.item_names.Count)) % self.controller.item_names.Count
	self.waiting_item[table_index] = item_index

	local go = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("emoticon"):Instantiate(character.Position)
	local emoticon = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	emoticon:Init()

	local emo = CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Drink
	if item_index == 1 then
		emo = CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Meat
	elseif item_index == 2 then
		emo = CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Heart
	end

	emoticon:ShowOn(character, vector(1, 1, 1), emo, nil, 1, { 0.1, duration, 0.1 })

	self.guest_tables[table_index].Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(character, duration))
	time_passed = 0
	local shake_started = false
	local satisfied = false
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= duration * 0.5 and shake_started == false then
			shake_started = true
			character:Shake(0.05, 100000)
			character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "cast", loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = "attack" })
		end

		if self.waiting_item[table_index] == self.satisfied_index then
			emoticon:Dispose()
			satisfied = true
			break
		elseif 	self.waiting_item[table_index] == self.dissatisfied_index then
			emoticon:Dispose()
			satisfied = false
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 퇴장
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(character))
	character:CancelShake()

	self.guest_tables[table_index].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if satisfied then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_get"):Instantiate(character.Bounds.center, unity_class.quaternion.identity, character.Transform)
		character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = "happy"})
		character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "success", loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.25)
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		self.sell_wrongs = self.sell_wrongs + 1
		local fail_text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("nightmare_desert_merchant_customer_fail", self.sell_wrongs, 3)
		local fail_color = unity_class.color.red
		fail_color.a = 0.7
		CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(character):ActivateForText(fail_text, 0, unity_class.color.white, fail_color)
		camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.15)
		character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "release", loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
	end

	character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = "walk", loop = true })
	time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < move_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local prog = time_passed / move_duration
		if prog >= 1 then
			character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			break
		else
			character.Position = out_pos * prog + table_pos * (1 - prog)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(character)
	guest["active"] = false
	guest["coroutine"] = nil
	self.assigned[table_index] = 0
	self.waiting_item[table_index] = -1
end


return local_class

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dowon_pot) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_dowon, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dosa) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request, self)
		return true
	end

-- 도사와 내기 수락/거절
function local_class:request()
	local dosa = self.get_dosa()

	party_util.align_to_target(dosa, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 허허허. 오래 살다보니 이 곳에 손님이 올 때도 있구만.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_1', skip = true })

	-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 이 곳은 이 노구가 머무는 작은 집이네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_2', skip = true })

	-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 자네가 좋아할 만한 것을 내가 가지고 있는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_3', skip = true })

	-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 이 노구와 재미있는 내기 한 번 해보는게 어떠시겠나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_4', skip = true })

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if is_accepted then
		-- 수락한 경우
		-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 고맙네. 그럼 이 노구가 생각한 내기를 말해주겠네!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_7', skip = true })

		-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 아주 간단하네. 나를 항아리 밖 속세로 나오게하면 된다네!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_8', skip = true })

		-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 그럼 내기 시작일세. 잘 가게나!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_9', skip = true })

		yield_return_func(self.exit_dowon, self)

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		-- 거절한 경우
		-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 허허허. 이 노옹과 내기할 생각이 든다면 다시 오시게!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_5', skip = true })

		-- 신선, idle, seat, down, 이 곳에서 내보내 주겠네!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dosa, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_6', skip = true })

		yield_return_func(self.exit_dowon, self)
	end
end

-- 도원 안으로 이동
function local_class:enter_dowon()
	local dowon_in_marker = self.get_dowon_in_marker()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	party_util.position_party(dowon_in_marker, 'up', 'arc')
	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	party_util.position_party(dowon_out_marker, 'up', 'arc')
	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDosaBettingSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDosaBetting @
		Comment = 신선을 속세로 나오게 하기 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_dosa = controller.get_dosa
	self.get_sifu = controller.get_sifu
	self.get_merchant = controller.get_merchant
	self.get_guest = controller.get_guest
	self.get_male = controller.get_male
	self.get_female = controller.get_female

	self.get_dowon_pot = controller.get_dowon_pot
	self.get_iron_sand_pot = controller.get_iron_sand_pot
	self.get_diamond = controller.get_diamond
	self.get_campfire = controller.get_campfire
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	self.get_fire_effect_pool = controller.get_fire_effect_pool
	self.get_explosion_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss') end

	self.dowon_pot_reset_event_zone_name = 'dowon_pot_reset'

	self.is_pot_into_iron_sand_pot = false
	self.is_saw_buldojang_female = false
	self.listening_touch_event = false
	self.time_since_last_tap_count = 999

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		iron_sand_pot = 1,
		diamond = 2,
		buldojang = 4,
		all = 7
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 항아리를 들고 다닐 수 있다.
	local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()
	dowon_pot.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	dowon_pot.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '02_hit_projectile_01'
	dowon_pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.get_explosion_effect_pool()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	if self.listening_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		return self:on_throw_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, iron_sand_pot) and self.is_pot_into_iron_sand_pot then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intract_iron_sand_pot, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()

	if self.current_progress & self.progress.iron_sand_pot ~= self.progress.iron_sand_pot and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dowon_pot) then
		local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()
		local direction = ((iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)) - user_party_leader.Position):ToDirection()
		local distance = (dowon_pot.Position - (iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5))).magnitude

		-- 플레이어가 항아리를 던졌을 때, 방향이 솥 쪽이면서
		-- 솥과의 거리가 2.5 이하면, 항아리는 솥 안으로 궤적을 그리며 이동한다.
		if user_party_leader.Direction == direction and distance <= 2.5 then
			message_system:Send(dowon_pot, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_pot_into_iron_sand_pot, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, dowon_pot) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.dowon_pot_reset_event_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dowon_pot_reset, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local diamond = self.get_diamond()
	local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()

	if self.current_progress & self.progress.diamond ~= self.progress.diamond and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, diamond) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, dowon_pot) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.crash_diamond, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_progress & self.progress.buldojang ~= self.progress.buldojang and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, dowon_pot) then
		local distance = (dowon_pot.Position - vector(83.5,0.5,-18.5)).magnitude

		if distance <= 2 then
			local campfire = self.get_campfire()
			if not campfire.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.front_of_buldojang, self)
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.smell_good, self))
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
		--연타 QTE 중 클릭했을 때 솥이 흔들리는 연출
		local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()
		local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, iron_sand_pot, 0.1, 2))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, dowon_pot, 0.1, 2))

		self.time_since_last_tap_count = 0

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
		return true
	end

-- 철사장 솥 상호작용
-- 솥에 항아리가 있는 경우
function local_class:intract_iron_sand_pot()
	local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()

	party_util.align_to_target(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 있을 때
	local dowon_pot = self.get_dowon_pot()
	local sifu = self.get_sifu()
	local fire_effect_list = {}

	-- 온도를 올린다.
	-- FX_fire 1개, 적은 흔들림
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dosa_betting_12' } })
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = user_party_leader, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, iron_sand_pot, 1))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, dowon_pot, 1))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	-- 온도를 더 올린다.
	-- FX_fire 2개, 중간 흔들림
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dosa_betting_13' } })
	equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = user_party_leader, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
	fire_effect_list[1].transform.position = iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.75, 0, -0.5)
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5)))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, iron_sand_pot, 1, 2))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, dowon_pot, 1, 2))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	-- 계속 올린다.
	-- FX_fire 3개, 중간 흔들림
	-- 연타 QTE
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dosa_betting_14' } })
	equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = user_party_leader, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_fire_activate_01')
	local fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_03', loop = true, parent = iron_sand_pot, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'})
	fire_effect_list[1].transform.position = iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	fire_effect_list[2].transform.position = iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
	table.insert(fire_effect_list, self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5)))
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, iron_sand_pot, 5, 3))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.shake_3d_object, self, dowon_pot, 5, 3))

	-- 계속 흔들리다가 boss_death 이펙트와 함께 폭발
	local boss_die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', loop = true, parent = iron_sand_pot, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'})
	self.get_explosion_effect_pool():Instantiate(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
	character_util.look_at(sifu, dowon_pot)
	character_util.set_emotion(sifu, { name = 'surprise' })

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	field:Darken('qte', 0.5, 0.3)
	self.listening_touch_event = true

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= 5 do
		self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	field:Undarken('qte', 0.3)
	self.listening_touch_event = false

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	fire_sfx:Stop()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_02')

	-- 터지면서 솥은 사라지고, 항아리는 바닥에 남는다.
	for i = 1, #fire_effect_list do
		fire_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
		fire_effect_list[i] = nil
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(iron_sand_pot, 'disabled')
	character_util.move_to(dowon_pot, vector_util.get_x0z(dowon_pot.Position), nil, 4, false, false)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	boss_die_sfx:Stop()

	-- 허허허. 따뜻하구만.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_male_evil_laugh_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dowon_pot, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_15', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	if lua_helper.type_compare(sifu.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		sifu.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	-- Surprise, idle, right, 소… 솥이
	sifu.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_16'

	self.is_pot_into_iron_sand_pot = false
	self.current_progress = self.current_progress | self.progress.iron_sand_pot
end

-- 필드 오브젝트를 해당 지점으로 포물선을 그리며 이동
function local_class:fo_move_curve(fo, end_position, height, duration)
	local start_position = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = end_position
end

	end

	-- 플레이어 파티, 아래로 방향 전환 후 ‘용의 발톱단’ QTE: 실패 없음

	character_util.set_anim(bear, { name = 'dance_voodoo', loop = false })

	for i = 1, 3 do
		yield_return_func(self.dragon_talon_qte, self, dongtae, i)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- QTE 끝나면 다시 플레이어 파티 위로 방향 전환.
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.set_direction('up')
	character_util.remove_anim(dongtae)
	character_util.remove_anim(bear)

	-- 동태, smile, idle, “하하하! 오랜만에 즐거웠어, 부단장.”
	character_util.set_emotion(dongtae, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dongtae, { key = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_29', skip = true })

	-- 동태, left, blush, sing, “그치만 상사를 이렇게 부려먹다니… 죄책감이 들면서도 짜릿한 이 느낌…!”
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_direction(dongtae, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(dongtae, { name = 'blush' })
	character_util.set_anim(dongtae, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dongtae, { key = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_30', skip = true })

	-- 다빈치, 동태를 때려서 동태 쓰러진다.
	character_util.look_at(bear, dongtae)
	character_util.set_anim(bear, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name):Instantiate((dongtae.Position + bear.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(dongtae)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(dongtae)
	dongtae.Direction = (dongtae.Position - bear.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_emotion(dongtae, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(dongtae, { name = 'prostrate' })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.remove_anim(bear)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 다빈치, down, idle, release, “도와준 대신 선물을 주겠다!”
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
	character_util.set_direction(bear, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(bear, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bear, { key = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_31', skip = true })

	-- 다빈치, 스타피스를 드랍.
	character_util.set_anim(bear, { name = 'get', loop = false })

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(bear.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 다빈치, idle, idle, “박사가 연구해 봤지만 아무 가치도 없었다. 가져라!”
	character_util.remove_anim(bear)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bear, { key = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_32', skip = true })

	if lua_helper.type_compare(dongtae.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		dongtae.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(bear.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		bear.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	dongtae.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_35'
	bear.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dragon_talon_36'

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:dragon_talon_qte(fo, index)
	local qte_type = { 'left', 'right', 'up' }

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_party_add_01')
	self.qte_success[index] = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(qte_type[index])
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.5, 'qte')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fo, { key = 'dragon_talon_signature_' .. index })

	if index == 3 then
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 1, true)
	end

	while not self.qte_success[index] do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_01')
	if index == 3 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_qte_complete_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.qte_success = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomFetchSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomFetch @
		Comment = 시체털이꾼 페치스 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 페치스
	self.get_fetchs = controller.get_fetchs
	self.saw_fetchs_talk = false
	self.saw_fetchs = false
	-- 용암다리
	self.fall_floor_count = 4
	self.floor_list = nil
	self.fall_trap_name = controller.fall_trap_name

	self.check_ailie = false

	self.fetch_star_piece_name = controller.fetch_star_piece_name
	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.floor_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.fall_floor_count do
		local cur_floor = get_field_object(self.fall_trap_name .. i)
		cur_floor.FieldObjectBehaviour:Close(true)
		self.floor_list:Add(cur_floor)
	end

	local fetch = self.get_fetchs()
	local button = get_field_object('fetchs_button')
	fetch.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	character_util.set_position(fetch, button.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(fetch, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(fetch, { name = 'smile' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	self.star_piece_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character'):Instantiate(
			fetch.Position + vector(0.5,0,3))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(131)
	if main_quest ~= nil and (main_quest.InnerProgress == 2 or main_quest.InnerProgress >= 5)
			and not main_quest.IsComplete then
		self.check_ailie = true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local fetch = self.get_fetchs()
	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(fetch) then
		fetch.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.floor_list:Clear()
	self.floor_list = nil

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fetchs()) and not self.saw_fetchs then
		if self.saw_fetchs_talk then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_fetch_talk, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_fetch_talk, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fetch, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_fetch_1', skip = true })

	local button = get_field_object('fetchs_button')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_switch_button_01')
	character_util.set_direction(fetch, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(fetch, { name = 'doyagao' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_earthquake_02')

	for i = 0, self.fall_floor_count - 1 do

	self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	if self.check_ailie then
		local ailie = get_character('ailie')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(ailie)
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(ailie, user_party, 0, 0, true,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
		ailie:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
		ailie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:rotate_fall_trap(fo)
	fo:Shake(0.04, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1

	local start_rotation = 0
	local end_rotation = 720

	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 2, 0, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotation,
				end_rotation - start_rotation, fall_time)

		cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_scale,
				end_scale - start_scale, fall_time)

		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_rotation, 0)
		fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
		fo.Position = vector(fo.Position.x, cur_y, fo.Position.z)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	branches:Add({

		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(fetch, branches)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fetch, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_fetch_16', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 등장
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.fetch_star_piece_name)
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(fetch.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2.0)

	-- 어때, 이제 용서해줄 맘이 들지 않아?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fetch, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_fetch_17', skip = true })

	branches:Clear()
	wait = true
	local choise = 0

	-- 살려준다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_fetch_18'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	-- 떨어트린다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_fetch_19'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false

--[[QuestAttribute

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.look_left_vector = vector(0,0,-0.6)
	self.look_right_vector = vector(0.8,0,-0.6)


	-- 가고일 리스트
	self.gargoyle_list = nil

	-- 가고일 나열 시 가로 크기
	self.width_size = 3

	-- 보물 상자 이름
	self.treasure_box_name = 'chest'
	-- 그리드 이름
	self.gargoyle_grid_name = 'gargoyle_grid'
	-- 보석 아이템 스프라이트
	self.itemid = 20196

	self.get_jewel = 'get_jewel'

	self.shake_req_id = {}

	-- 독백 코루틴 중복 방지
	self.req_count = 0

	-- 레이저 유지 관련 변수

		--- 클리어
		clear = 2
	}

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 가고일 석상 리스트 세팅
	self.gargoyle_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.gargoyle_count do
		local gargoyle = get_field_object(self.gargoyle_name .. i)
		self.gargoyle_list:Add(gargoyle)
	end

	self.last_pos = self.gargoyle_list[5].Position + vector(0,0,-2)

	-- 메인 가고일 석상 세팅
	local gargoyle_head = self.get_gargoyle_head()
	gargoyle_head.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	local mesh = gargoyle_head.transform:GetChild(0)--:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	mesh.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

	-- 고고학자 세팅
	local archeologist = self.get_archeologist()
	character_util.set_direction(archeologist, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(archeologist, field:GetMarker('archeologist_point').position)

	-- 진행도 세팅
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

	if stage_progress:IsBoxOpened(self.treasure_box_name) and
			self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.get_jewel) ~= 1 then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.get_jewel, 1)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	if self.gargoyle_attach_list ~= nil then
		for _, effect in ipairs(self.gargoyle_attach_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.gargoyle_attach_list = nil
	end

	for i = 0, self.gargoyle_count - 1 do
		self.gargoyle_list[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.gargoyle_list:Clear()
	self.gargoyle_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.treasure_box_name)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_item_jewel, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
			return false
		end

		if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.gargoyle_grid_name then return false end

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.soliloquy_archeologist, self))
			return true
		else
			self.saw_laser = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fire_laser_effect, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
				not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
			return false
		end

		if e.CameraGrid.name ~= self.gargoyle_grid_name then return false end

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			self.soliloquy = false
			local archeologist = self.get_archeologist()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(archeologist)
			return true
		else
			self.saw_laser = false
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, get_field_object('gargoyle_reset')) and
				self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.install_jewel then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.gargoyle_reset, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_gargoyle_head()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.install_red_jewel, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 0, self.gargoyle_count do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gargoyle_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_gargoyle, self, i + 1)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 붉은 보석 획득
function local_class:get_item_jewel()
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.get_jewel, 1)

	local start_pos = get_field_object(self.treasure_box_name).Position
	local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = start_pos,
			  target = user_party.Leader.Position, itemid = self.itemid, notforinven = true })
	drop_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_place_holder.ItemId = self.itemid
	-- 파문의 붉은 돌
	-- 누군가 이 돌로 진화를 했을지도 모릅니다.
	-- 동봉된 설명서에 빛의 힘을 증폭시키는 힘을 증폭시키는 힘이 있다고 적혀있습니다.
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_place_holder,
			'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_1', 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_2'))
end

	if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.get_jewel) ~= 1 then
		-- 석상 뒤에 무언가가 들어갈만한 홈이 있다.

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 레이저 발사 시작

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fire_laser_effect, self))

		local view_pos = field:GetMarker("gargoyle_veiw_point").position

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
			character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "surprise" })
		end

		local ailie_check = false
		local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(131)
		if main_quest ~= nil and (main_quest.InnerProgress == 2 or main_quest.InnerProgress >= 5)
				and not main_quest.IsComplete then
			ailie_check = true
		end

		if ailie_check then
			local ailie = get_character('ailie')
			character_util.set_direction(ailie, 'right')
			character_util.jump(ailie, 1, 0.5)
			character_util.set_emotion(ailie, { name = "surprise" })
		end

		-- 고고학자 놀람
		character_util.set_emotion(archeologist, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(archeologist, "01_jump_01")

		camera_util.resize_to(6, 1.5)
		camera_util.move_async(view_pos, 1.5)

		character_util.move_to_async(archeologist, archeologist.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 4, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(archeologist, 'right')

		-- 이럴수가!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(archeologist,
				{ key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_10', skip = true })

		-- 이...이게 무슨일이지?!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(archeologist,
				{ key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_11', skip = true })

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1.5)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

		-- 인터렉트 가능하도록 변경
		for i = 0, self.gargoyle_count - 1 do
			local gargoyle = self.gargoyle_list[i]
			gargoyle.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			--local attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_front):Instantiate(
			--		gargoyle.Position + self.look_front_vector)
			--table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, attach_fx)
		end

		-- 가고일 석상 head NonInteractable로 변경
		gargoyle_head.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		end

		if ailie_check then
			local ailie = get_character('ailie')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ailie)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(archeologist)
		archeologist.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_11'

-- 고고학자의 혼잣말
function local_class:soliloquy_archeologist()
	if self.req_count == 0 then
		self.req_count = 1
	else
		return
	end
	local archeologist = self.get_archeologist()
	self.soliloquy = true
	while self.soliloquy do
		-- 이 빈공간은 무언가를 끼우는 건가?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(archeologist, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_7' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if not self.soliloquy then
			break
		end
		-- 흥미로운 석상이구만…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(archeologist, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_gargoyle_room_9' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	self.req_count = 0
end

-- 레이저 이펙트 발사
function local_class:fire_laser_effect()
	local gargoyle_head = self.get_gargoyle_head()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_03')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_fire_slash_01')
	-- 레이저 관련 변수
	local laser_count = 0
	--local laser_list = {}
	local check_laser_list = { false, false, false, false, false, false }

	self.gargoyle_attach_list = {}
	local temp = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_l):Instantiate(
			gargoyle_head.Position + self.look_right_vector)
	table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, temp)

	-- head 레이저 발사
	--local pos = gargoyle_head.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	--local laser_fire_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.laser_effect_name)
	--local laser_effect = laser_fire_pool:Instantiate(pos)
	--local head_angle = gargoyle_head.transform:GetChild(0).localRotation.eulerAngles.y - 180
	--laser_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, head_angle + 90, 0)
	--laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	-- 리스트에 담기
	--table.insert(laser_list, laser_effect)
	laser_count = laser_count + 1

	-- 연결 되어 있는 가고일 석상 체크
	local next_index = 0
	-- 석상을 돌면서 레이저 연결
	while true do
		-- 현재 석상의 각도
		local mesh = self.gargoyle_list[next_index].transform:GetChild(0)--:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		local angle = mesh.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
		local gargoyle = self.gargoyle_list[next_index]

		-- 부착 이펙트 생성
		if float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 90) then
			local attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_r):Instantiate(
					gargoyle.Position + self.look_left_vector)
			table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, attach_fx)
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 180) then
			local attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_back):Instantiate(
					gargoyle.Position + self.look_back_vector)
			table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, attach_fx)
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 270) then
			local attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_l):Instantiate(
					gargoyle.Position + self.look_right_vector)
			table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, attach_fx)
		else
			local attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.gargoyle_attach_front):Instantiate(
					gargoyle.Position + self.look_front_vector)
			table.insert(self.gargoyle_attach_list, attach_fx)
		end

		-- 빠져 나올 조건 검사
		local check_index = next_index + 1
		if check_index <= self.width_size and float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 180) then
			break
		elseif (check_index % self.width_size) == 1 and float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 90) then
			break
		elseif (check_index % self.width_size) == 0 and float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 270) then
			break
		elseif check_index > self.gargoyle_count - self.width_size and float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 0) then
			break
		elseif check_laser_list[check_index] then
			break
		end

		-- 해당 인덱스 석상 체크
		check_laser_list[check_index] = true

		if float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 180) then
			next_index = next_index - self.width_size
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 270) then
			next_index = next_index + 1
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 0) then
			next_index = next_index + self.width_size
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 90) then
			next_index = next_index - 1
		end

		-- 마주보는 경우 검사
		check_index = next_index + 1
		if check_laser_list[check_index] then
			break
		end

		---- 레이저 발사
		--local laser_pos = gargoyle.Position + vector(0, 1.7, 0)
		--laser_fire_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.laser_effect_name)
		--laser_effect = laser_fire_pool:Instantiate(laser_pos)
		--laser_effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle - 90, 0)
		--laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

		-- 리스트에 담기
		--table.insert(laser_list, laser_effect)
		laser_count = laser_count + 1

		-- 다음 가고일이 없거나 이미 레이저를 쏘고 있는 가고일 석상이면 break
		if next_index < 0 or next_index >= self.gargoyle_count then
			break
		end
	end

	while self.saw_laser do
		-- 클리어 시
		if laser_count == 6 then
			laser_count = 0

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.puzzle_clear, self))
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end


	if self.gargoyle_attach_list ~= nil then
		for _, effect in ipairs(self.gargoyle_attach_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.gargoyle_attach_list = nil
	end

	---- 레이저 제거
	--for i, effect in ipairs(laser_list) do
	--	if effect ~= nil then
	--		effect:Dispose()
	--	end
	--end

	-- 리스트 초기화
	--laser_list = nil
	check_laser_list = nil
end

-- 가고일 석상 선택 시 주변 가고일 석상 회전
function local_class:interact_gargoyle(index)
	self.saw_laser = false

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_push_rock_unit_01')
	-- 부착 이펙트 제거
	if self.gargoyle_attach_list ~= nil then
		for _, effect in ipairs(self.gargoyle_attach_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.gargoyle_attach_list = nil
	end

	-- 가고일 번호 1~6 기준으로 index 계산 하도록 작성함
	if (index % self.width_size) ~= 1 then
		local index_left = index - 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, index_left))
	end
	if (index % self.width_size) ~= 0 then
		local index_right = index + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, index_right))
	end

	local index_up = index - self.width_size
	local index_down = index + self.width_size

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, index_up))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, index_down))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.saw_laser = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fire_laser_effect, self))
end

-- 가고일 석상 회전 리셋
function local_class:gargoyle_reset()
	self.saw_laser = false

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_push_rock_unit_01')
	for i = 0, self.gargoyle_count - 1 do
		local gargoyle = self.gargoyle_list[i]
		local angle = gargoyle.transform:GetChild(0).localRotation.eulerAngles.y
		if float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 180) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, i + 1, 180))
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 270) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, i + 1, 90))
		elseif float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 90) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.move_gargoyle, self, i + 1, -90))
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.saw_laser = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fire_laser_effect, self))
end
-- 가고일 석상 회전
function local_class:move_gargoyle(index, angle)
	if angle == nil then
		angle = 90
	end

	-- list에 있는 기준 index로 다시 -1 해줌
	index = index - 1

	if index < 0 or index >= self.gargoyle_count then
		return
	end

	local gargoyle = self.gargoyle_list[index]

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_time = 1
	local mesh = gargoyle.transform:GetChild(0)--:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	local start_rot = mesh.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
	local end_rot = start_rot + angle
	self:shake_3d_object(gargoyle, 1)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_rot = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rot, end_rot - start_rot, move_time)

		mesh.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_rot, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	mesh.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, end_rot, 0)
end

-- 3D 오브젝트 흔드는 루틴
function local_class:shake_3d_object_routine(fo, duration, magnitude)
	magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(magnitude, 1)

	local req_id = self.shake_req_id[fo]

	local origin_pos = fo.Position
	local pos_list = {
		vector(-0.02, 0, 0),
		vector(-0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
		vector(0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0.02, 0, 0)
	}

	local cur_idx = 3
	local dif = 1
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if req_id ~= self.shake_req_id[fo] then
			break
		end

		cur_idx = cur_idx + dif
		if cur_idx > 5 then
			cur_idx = 5
			dif = -1
		elseif cur_idx < 1 then
			cur_idx = 1
			dif = 1
		end

		fo.Position = origin_pos + (pos_list[cur_idx] * magnitude)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = origin_pos
end

--- 3D 오브젝트를 흔들어줌.
--- @param fo any 흔들 물체
--- @param duration number 흔들릴 시간
--- @param magnitude number 좌우로 흔들리는 크기
function local_class:shake_3d_object(fo, duration, magnitude)
	if self.shake_req_id[fo] == nil then
		self.shake_req_id[fo] = 0
	end
	self.shake_req_id[fo] = self.shake_req_id[fo] + 1

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_3d_object_routine, self, fo, duration, magnitude))
end

--- 3D 오브젝트를 흔드는 것을 멈춰줌.
--- @param fo any 멈출 물체
function local_class:stop_shake_3d_object(fo)
	if self.shake_req_id[fo] ~= nil then
		self.shake_req_id[fo] = self.shake_req_id[fo] + 1
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress.none and e.Zone.Name == self.incubus_invite_zone_name .. 1 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.incubus_invite_player_1, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.saw_incubus_invite_1 and e.Zone.Name == self.incubus_invite_zone_name .. 2 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.incubus_invite_player_2, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.saw_incubus_invite_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.incubus_dream_therapy_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.well_come_to_incubus_dream_therapy, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 인큐버스가 작은 목소리로 플레이어를 부름
function local_class:incubus_invite_player_1()
	local incubus_town_door = self.get_incubus_town_door()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.saw_incubus_invite_1

	-- 저기요…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_town_door, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_4', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 여기에요, 여기!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_town_door, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_5', skip = true })
end

-- 가까이 다가갔을 때 한번 더 이벤트 진행
function local_class:incubus_invite_player_2()
	local incubus_town_door = self.get_incubus_town_door()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.saw_incubus_invite_2

	-- 혹시 특별한 드림 테라피에 관심있으시면…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_town_door, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_6', skip = true })

	-- 이쪽으로 오세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_town_door, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_7', skip = true })

	incubus_town_door.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

-- 목소리를 따라 비밀길을 통과해서 가면 인큐버스들이 있다.
function local_class:well_come_to_incubus_dream_therapy()
	local incubus_1 = self.get_incubus(1)
	local incubus_2 = self.get_incubus(2)
	local incubus_3 = self.get_incubus(3)

	self.current_progress = self.progress.saw_incubus_invite_3

	self.controller:align_with_ailie(incubus_3, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 어서오세요, 드림 클리닉 서비스에!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_3, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.set_anim(incubus_3, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_3, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_8', skip = true })

	-- 드림 클리닉?
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_8_1', 'normal' } })

	-- 네! 싸구려 드림 테라피와는 다른 고급 서비스…
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.3)
	character_util.normal_jump(incubus_3, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_3, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(incubus_3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_3, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_9', skip = true })

	-- 드림 클리닉 입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(incubus_2, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_2, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_10', skip = true })

	-- 서큐버스들보다 더 저렴한 정기로 모시고 있습니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_1, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(incubus_1, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_1, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_11', skip = true })

	-- 원하는 인큐버스와 함께 행복한 시간을 보내보세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(incubus_3, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_12', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(incubus_3)

	-- 인큐버스 마을 소개 이벤트 들은 후, 서큐버스 홍보원에게 가면 드림 클리닉에 대한 선택지 추가
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	self.controller:restore_ailie()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomIncubusSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomIncubus @
		Comment = 나이트메어 던전 왕국 4스테이지 인큐버스 드림 테라피 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.incubus_dream_therapy_zone_name = 'incubus_dream_therapy_2'

	-- 캐릭터를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_succubus_guide = controller.get_succubus_guide
	self.get_succubus = controller.get_succubus
	self.get_incubus = controller.get_incubus
	self.get_dream_incubus = controller.get_dream_incubus

	-- 이벤트 프로그레스
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		succubus_go_to_incubus = 1,
		crack_down_incubus = 2,
	}

end

function local_class:enter()

	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide()
	succubus.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local incubus_1 = self.get_incubus(1)
	local incubus_2 = self.get_incubus(2)
	local incubus_3 = self.get_incubus(3)

	character_util.set_anim(incubus_1, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(incubus_2, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(incubus_3, { name = 'smile' })

	incubus_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_11'
	incubus_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_10'
	incubus_3.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_12'

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide(1)
	quest_icon_util.remove(succubus)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(succubus.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		succubus.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, succubus) then
		if not (self.current_progress == self.progress.crack_down_incubus) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_succubus, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.complete, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.incubus_dream_therapy_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.progress.succubus_go_to_incubus then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.crack_down_incubus, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 서큐버스 홍보원에게 상호작용
function local_class:interact_succubus()
	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide()

	quest_icon_util.remove(succubus)

	local result = self.controller:interact_succubus()

	if result then
		succubus.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		self.current_progress = self.progress.succubus_go_to_incubus
	end

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(succubus)
end

-- 인큐버스 단속 조치 장면
function local_class:crack_down_incubus()
	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide()

	quest_icon_util.remove(succubus)

	yield_return_func(self.controller.crack_down_incubus, self.controller)

	succubus.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(succubus)

	self.current_progress = self.progress.crack_down_incubus
end

-- 서큐버스가 감사해 하고, 퀘스트 클리어
function local_class:complete()
	local succubus_1 = self.get_succubus_guide()
	local succubus_2 = self.get_succubus(2)

	quest_icon_util.remove(succubus_1)

	self.controller:align_with_ailie((succubus_1.Position + succubus_2.Position) / 2 + vector(0.275, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 어쩐지 출근하는 인원이 적더라니…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_20', skip = true })

	-- 고마워요, 덕분에 저 망할 인큐버스들을 쫓을 수 있었어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(succubus_2, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_21', skip = true })

	-- 그나저나 슬슬 저희도 다른 일을 알아봐야겠어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_1, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_1, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_22', skip = true })

	-- 장사가 잘 안 되니 이렇게 인큐버스들한테 한 눈 파는 거겠죠.
	character_util.set_anim(succubus_1, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_1, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_23', skip = true })

	-- 이번엔 전혀 다른 방향으로 업종 변경을 해볼까 하는데…
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_24', skip = true })

	-- 그때도 찾아와 줄 거죠?
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus_2, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_2, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_25', skip = true })

	-- 뭐, 오픈 전까진 저놈들한테 홀리는 녀석들 없도록 단속해야겠지만요.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus_1, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_26', skip = true })

	succubus_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_26'
	succubus_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_25'

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

end

	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_1_halbal' and self.saw_halbal_event == false then

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_halbal, self)

function local_class:opening()

	--region 기자회견 1
	--주연급 세팅
	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	local halbal = get_character('halbal_naked')

	local npc_name = {'halbal_naked', 'streamer'}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_2_' .. npc_name[i])
		local npc = get_character(npc_name[i])

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
	end

	local ailie_marker = field:GetMarker('section_2_ailie_2')
	character_util.set_position(ailie, ailie_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(ailie, ailie_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(ailie, {name = 'doyagao'})

	--리포터 세팅
	local reporters = {}
	for i = 1, 11 do
		local name = 'reporter_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_2_' .. name)
		local npc = get_character(name)

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)

		if i % 4 == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(npc, {name = 'release'})
		end

		reporters[i] = npc
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local name = 'crowd_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_2_' .. name)
		local npc = get_character(name)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[1], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[5], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_2', skip = true})
	--할발 용사님이 용사 레이스에서 직접 잡은 몬스터가 거의 없다던데, 사실인가요?!

	self.do_flash_light = false

	character_util.set_anim(ailie, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3', skip = true})
	--맞아요! 할발은 맨날 부하 용사들한테 위험한 일은 다 떠넘기고, 자기는 아무것도 안 한다고요!

	character_util.normal_double_jump(reporters[8], '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[8], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3_1', skip = true})
	--그러면 대악마 토벌 영상에서도…

	character_util.set_direction(ailie, 'down')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(ailie, '01_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3_2', skip = true})
	--그건 제가 직접 찍은 영상이에요! 편집도 하나도 안 했다고요!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(ailie, {name = 'cast2'})
	character_util.set_emotion(ailie, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3_3', skip = true})
	--할발을 갑옷을 입었을지언정, 대악마를 정말로 쓰러뜨린 사람은 크레이그 아저씨라고요!

	character_util.normal_double_jump(reporters[3], true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[3], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3_4', skip = true})
	--할발님, 이게 사실인가요?!

	character_util.normal_double_jump(reporters[6], true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reporters[6], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s2_conference_3_5', skip = true})

function local_class:set_npcs()
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local name = 'dungeonkingdom_npc_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker(name)
		local npc = get_character(name)

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'tired'})
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local name = 'bad_guy_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_1_' .. name)
		local npc = get_character(name)

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local name = 'crowd_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_1_' .. name)
		local npc = get_character(name)

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
	end

	local npc_data =
	{
		'halbal',
		'musketeer',
		'bad_adventurer_1',
		'bad_adventurer_2'
	}

	for i = 1, #npc_data do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_1_' .. npc_data[i])
		local npc = get_character(npc_data[i])

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local board = get_field_object('sign_board_' .. i)
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_1_sign_board_' .. i)

		board.Position = marker.position
	end
end

function local_class:throw_rock_event()
	-- 랜덤으로 던지는 방향, 몇 번째 NPC가 던지는지, 던지고 나서 다음 던질 때까지의 대기 시간을 설정함
	local rand_dir = 0
	local rand_index = 0
	local rand_delay = 0

	local check_target = 0

	local craig = get_character('craig')
	local bad_guys = {get_character('bad_guy_1'), get_character('bad_guy_2'), get_character('bad_guy_3')}

	self.throwing_rock = true

	while self.throwing_rock do
		rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
		rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(1, 4))
		rand_delay = unity_class.random.Range(0.2, 0.5)

		local thrower = bad_guys[rand_index]

		check_target = check_target + 1

		if check_target < 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_target, self, thrower, craig))
		else
			check_target = 0

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_target, self, thrower, user_party_leader))
		end

		wait_for_sec(rand_delay)
	end

	for i = 0, #bad_guys do
		character_util.set_anim(bad_guys[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
		character_util.set_emotion(bad_guys[i], {name = 'surprise'})
	end
end
