function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_swing_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "attack", loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20019, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

function local_class:flash_light()

	while self.do_flash_light do
		local times_rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)

		end

	self.controller = nil

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomMain @
		Comment = 계속 욕을 먹는 크레이그, 대량의 몬스터에게 공격받음. @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_3'
	--self.stage_name = 'nightmare_china_3'

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 통로 씬
		passage = 1,
		--- 전투 & 썰 씬
		fighting = 2,
		--- 전투 후
		after_fight = 3,
	}

	self.bad_comment = false
	self.defeat_monster = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	quest_icon.PreLoad()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('clear_exit'))

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	--- progress setup
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	CS.MessyText.DisposeAll()

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main')
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'section_3_monster' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.passage
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.before_fight, self))
	elseif zone_name == 'event_battle' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.passage then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.fighting
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fighting, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_1' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.fighting then
		self.defeat_monster = true
		self:check_and_play_scene()
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_npcs()
	for i = 1, 19 do
		local monster = get_character('battle_1_' .. i)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		monster.Position = monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -30)
	end
end

function local_class:before_fight()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.comment_cloud, self,
			'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s3_1', 0.6))
	--짭할발 정의 구현한 썰 푼다
end

function local_class:fighting()
	for i = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('event_battle_gate_' .. i))
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.comment_cloud, self,
			'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s3_2', 0.4))
	--아 몬스터 좀더 풀어놓을걸 그랬나

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	character_util.set_position(ailie, ailie.Position)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.comment_cloud, self,
			'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s3_3', 0.2))
	--칼도 제대로 못 들고 쳐맞기만 하네 ㄹㅇ코미디ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

	wait_for_sec(2)

	self:comment_cloud('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s3_4', 0)
	--나만 보기 아까운데?ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 시-원

	self.bad_comment = true
	self:check_and_play_scene()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ailie, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s3_6_1', skip = true})
	--누가 아저씨 가는 길에 일부러 몬스터를 풀어놨대!
	character_util.remove_anim(ailie)

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'question', loop = false})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(craig, {name = 'question', loop = false})

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomMain @
		Comment = 할발의 주작러들을 포섭한다. @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_4'

	self.is_lynch = false

	self.party_count = 0

	self.push_over_scene = {false, false}

	self.quarrel = false
	self.finish_quarrel = false
	self.start_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('clear_exit'))
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local hater_name = 'hater_' .. i
		local hater = get_character(hater_name)

		if i == 1 then
			if hater ~= nil then
				hater.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
			end

			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main')
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main')
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if zone_name == 'section_5_saibee_' .. i and self.push_over_scene[i] == false then
			local hater = get_character('hater_' .. i + 1)
			local pushover = get_character('pushover_' .. i)
			self.push_over_scene[i] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.push_over, self, hater, pushover, i))
		end
	end

	if zone_name == 'section_5_out' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.dont_out, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_5_in' and self.quarrel == false then
		self.quarrel = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quarreling, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local hater = get_character('hater_1')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, hater) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hater_event, self)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_npcs()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local hater_name = 'hater_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_5_' .. hater_name)
		local hater = get_character(hater_name)

		character_util.set_position(hater, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(hater, marker.direction)

		if i == 1 then
			hater.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
			character_util.set_emotion(hater, {name = 'doyagao'})
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, hater)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local pushover_name = 'pushover_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('section_5_' .. pushover_name)
		local pushover = get_character(pushover_name)

		character_util.set_position(pushover, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(pushover, marker.direction)

		character_util.set_anim(pushover, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(pushover, {name = 'tired'})
	end

	self.is_play_release_sfx = false
	local release_sfx_func = function()
		if self.is_play_release_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		end
	end

	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(ailie,
		{name = 'release', sfx_name = release_sfx_func}, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_position(ailie, field:GetMarker('section_5_ailie').position)
	character_util.set_direction(ailie, field:GetMarker('section_5_ailie').direction)

	else

function local_class:lynch(fo, target)

	self.is_lynch = true

		fo.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(pos, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomMain @
		Comment = 크레이그와 부활한 용암 슬라임을 무찌른다. @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_4'

	self.show_boss_intro = false

	self.one_line_intro = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Cin_Obj_RockExplosion')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_Lavapool')
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	CS.Oak.BasicHealEffect.Preload()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('clear_exit'))
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local hater = get_character('hater_1')

	if hater ~= nil then
		hater.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main')
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'boss' and self.show_boss_intro == false then
		self.show_boss_intro = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.before_battle, self)
	elseif zone_name == 'section_6_intro' and self.one_line_intro == false then
		self.one_line_intro = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.death_rattle, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'boss' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local fake_exit = get_field_object('fake_exit')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fake_exit) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.real_ending, self)
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'ease_in_out_sine')

function local_class:dispose()

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomMainSection7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomMain @
		Comment = 부활한 대악마를 무찌르고 할발 참교육. @
		Index = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	--self.stage_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_6'
	self.stage_5_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_5'
	self.stage_6_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_6'

	self.stage_5_comment = {false, false, false}

	self.show_boss_intro = false
	self.show_kid_event = false
	self.end_intro = {false, false}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_5_name and stage.Name ~= self.stage_6_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	if stage.Name == self.stage_6_name then

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_dying_end_event')

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

		screen_util.preload_boss_title()
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_BossDemon_Spawn')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_cast_dark')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce')

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_PowerWave_flame_proj')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_PowerWave_flame_End')
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_6_name then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, get_field_object('clear_exit'))
		return
	else

	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))

	CS.MessyText.DisposeAll()
	
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main')
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if stage.Name == self.stage_5_name then
		local zone_no = {1, 3, 4}
		local func = {self.stage_5_comment_start_1, self.stage_5_comment_start_2, self.stage_5_comment_start_3}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if zone_name == 'battle' .. zone_no[i] and self.stage_5_comment[i] == false then
				self.stage_5_comment[i] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(func[i], self))
			end

		end

	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_6_name then

		if zone_name == 'boss' and self.show_boss_intro == false then
			self.show_boss_intro = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.before_battle, self)
			--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle, self)
		elseif zone_name == 'section_7_kid_event' and self.show_kid_event == false then
			self.show_kid_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.kid_event, self)
		elseif zone_name == 'section_7_real_end' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.real_ending, self)
		end

		for i = 1, 2 do
			if zone_name == 'section_7_end_intro_' .. i and self.end_intro[i] == false then
				self.end_intro[i] = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.welcome, self, i))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_dying_end_event(e)
	local boss = get_character('boss')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, boss) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.after_battle, self)
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_npcs()
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local follower_name = 'follower_' .. i
		local marker = field:GetMarker('s7_' .. follower_name)
		local follower = get_character(follower_name)

		character_util.set_position(follower, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(follower, marker.direction)
	end

	local boss = get_character('boss')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)
	character_util.set_position(boss, vector(99, 0, 99))

	local names = {'halbal', 'hater'}
	for i = 1, #names do
		local character_marker = field:GetMarker('s7_' .. names[i])
		local character = get_character(names[i])
		character_util.set_position(character, character_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(character, character_marker.direction)

		if i == 1 then
			CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, character)
		end
	end

	local crystal = get_field_object('invader_crystal')
	crystal.Position = field:GetMarker('s7_invader_crystal').position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5)
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_01')

	aura:Dispose()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_BossDemon_Spawn'):Instantiate(boss.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0))
	local dark = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_cast_dark'):Instantiate(boss.Position + vector(0, 3, 0))

	dark.transform:GetChild(0).localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	dark.transform:GetChild(1).localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	earthquake_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	screen_util.fade_out(3, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_to(2, 3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 3)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local scale_time = 3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < scale_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / scale_time

		dark.transform:GetChild(0).localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
		dark.transform:GetChild(1).localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dark:Dispose()

	crystal.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	field:Tint(nil, unity_color({1, 0, 0, 0.5}), 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dash_stomp_jump_01')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.3)
	screen_util.fade_in(0.3, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(boss, boss.Position + vector(0, -2, 0))
	character_util.set_active_state(boss, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss, 1, 1.5)

	local alter = get_field_object('boss_demon_alter')

	alter:Shake(0.04, 1)
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local down_duration = 1
	local target_y = -1.5
	local alter_pos = alter.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < down_duration do
		--local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / scale_time
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, alter_pos.y, target_y - alter_pos.y, down_duration)
		alter.Position = vector(alter_pos.x, cur_y, alter_pos.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(halbal)
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'up')
	character_util.shake(halbal, 0.04, 99)

	character_util.set_direction(craig, 'up')

	for i = 1, #followers do
		character_util.set_anim(followers[i], {name = 'embarrassed'})
		character_util.shake(followers[i], 0.04, 99)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(halbal.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(followers[1], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_15', skip = true})
	--대… 대악마!

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(followers[5], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_16', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt'})
	--아, 아직 올 때가 아닌데!

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(followers[6], {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_17', skip = true})
	--그… 그냥 던전 브이로그 찍는 거 아니었어?!

	character_util.set_position(boss, vector(boss.Position.x, 15, boss.Position.z))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(boss, vector(halbal.Position.x, boss.Position.y, halbal.Position.z + 1), 7, false, nil, 'flying')

	local fall_time = 0.5
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = boss.Position
	local end_pos = vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z)
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, start_pos.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(boss, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	character_util.set_position(boss, end_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.5)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce'):Instantiate(boss.Position)

	character_util.set_emotion(halbal, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_direction(halbal, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	local info = {
		type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear,
		stun = true,
		direction = vector(-1, 0, 0),
		linearDuration = 0.5,
		linearMagnitude = 5
	}
	command_util.publish_knock_back(halbal.Owner, halbal, info, halbal.Position)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(halbal, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(halbal, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	for i = 1, #followers do
		local info = {
			type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear,
			stun = true,
			direction = vector(0, 0, -1),
			linearDuration = 0.6,
			linearMagnitude = 5
		}
		command_util.publish_knock_back(followers[i].Owner, followers[i], info, followers[i].Position)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(followers[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(followers[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(followers[i],  i % 2 == 1 and 'left' or 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(followers[i], {name = 'hurt'})
		character_util.set_anim(followers[i], {name = 'prostrate'})
		character_util.stop_shake(followers[i])
	end

	character_util.set_direction(craig, 'left')

	character_util.move_to(craig, craig.Position + vector(8, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(craig, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(craig, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	character_util.shake(halbal, 0.04, 999)
	character_util.set_anim(halbal, {name = 'frustration', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local boss_left_offset = vector(2, 4, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(boss, vector(boss.Position.x, 0, halbal.Position.z), 3,
			false, nil, nil, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_golem_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boss, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_18_2', skip = true,
												 offset = boss_left_offset, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--두려워하라, 던전이여! 내가 너희를 벌할 것이니!

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 1})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local spread_angle = 40
		local shoot_angle = (i - 2) / 2 * spread_angle
		local shoot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(shoot_angle,
				unity_class.vector3(0, 1, 0)) * vector(0, 0, -1)
		local offset = 0.7
		local create_pos = boss.Position + shoot_dir * offset

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_slash_wave,
				self, create_pos, shoot_dir))
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(boss)

	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'left')

	for i = 1, #followers do
		character_util.set_position(followers[i], vector(99, 0, 99))
	end

	character_util.set_position(ailie, vector(99, 0, 99))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_18', skip = true, offset = boss_left_offset})
	--그 갑옷, 기억하고 있었다…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_18_1', skip = true, offset = boss_left_offset})
	--이번에야말로 제대로 끝내주지…

	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 1)
	camera_util.move(halbal.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint(boss, boss.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_19', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt'})
	--살려주세요, 악마님… 저 아니에요… 저 현장에 안 나간 지 5년이 넘었다구요…

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	camera_util.move(halbal.Position, 1)
	character_util.move_waypoint(boss, boss.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_19_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt'})
	--제…제가 아니라 저기 크레이그라는 놈입니다!

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_craig', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	character_util.jump_move(craig, halbal.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), 8, 3, false, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(14.5 / 8 / 3 * 2)

	time_util.mod('nightmare_dungeonkingdom', 0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(boss, {name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 0.3, remove_after = 2, sfx_name = '02_fire_slash_03'})

	wait_for_sec(14.5 / 8 / 3)

	character_util.set_anim(craig, {name = 'push'})

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local info = {
		type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear,
		stun = true,
		direction = vector(0, 0, -1),
		linearDuration = 0.5,
		linearMagnitude = 3
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	command_util.publish_knock_back(halbal.Owner, halbal, info, halbal.Position)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(halbal, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(halbal, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	craig.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0, 0, -0.2), 0.2, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(craig)
	character_util.set_direction(craig, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	time_util.unmod('nightmare_dungeonkingdom')

	camera_util.shake(1, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
	local info = {
		type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Linear,
		stun = true,
		direction = vector(-1, 0, 0),
		linearDuration = 0.5,
		linearMagnitude = 3
	}
	command_util.publish_knock_back(craig.Owner, craig, info, craig.Position)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(craig, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(craig, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	party_util.align_party(craig.Position, 'down', 2)

	party_util.set_direction('right')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(craig, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_22', skip = true, portraitname = 'tanker'})
	--그럼 용사의 일을 하자고 가디언!

	character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

	halbal.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	screen_util.show_boss_title('nightmare_dungeonkingdom_demon_title',
			"nightmare_dungeonkingdom_demon_subtitle", 2)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(boss))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'combat', name = 'bgm_battle_boss' })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	character_util.convert_to_party_member(craig, user_party, true)

	character_util.convert_to_monster(boss, 'boss', 'boss')

	command_util.execute_cmd(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(boss,
			user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

	for i = 1, 6 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('boss_battlegate_' .. i))
	end
end

function local_class:after_battle()
	local halbal = get_character('halbal')
	local craig = get_character('craig')
	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	local hater = get_character('hater')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--스킵 자리
	character_util.remove_emotion(hater)

	field:RemoveTint(nil, 0)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(craig)
	local after_battle_pos = field:GetMarker('s7_after_battle').position

	--에일리, 넌 괜찮…

	character_util.remove_anim(ailie)

	character_util.set_emotion(halbal, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_26', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--아이고! 나 죽네!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_27', skip = true})
	--크… 크레이그…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_28', skip = true})
	--내 갑옷이 탐났으면 달라고 하면 될 것을…

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(halbal, {key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_main_s7_29', skip = true})
	--왜 폭력으로 빼앗냐는 말이야, 자네 정말 왜 그래!

	--이 아저씨가 또 뭐라는 거야?!

	character_util.set_anim(ailie, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})

	--또 무슨 거짓말을 퍼뜨리려고!

function local_class:shoot_slash_wave(create_pos, shoot_dir)
	local wave_speed = 10
	local wave_distance = 5

	local move_dir = shoot_dir

	local move_duration = wave_distance / wave_speed

	local time_passed = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_activate_01')
	local waveEffectPool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_PowerWave_flame_proj')
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector(0, 0, -1), shoot_dir).eulerAngles.y

	local slash_wave = waveEffectPool:Instantiate(create_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rot, 0), nil)

	while time_passed <= move_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		slash_wave.transform.position = slash_wave.transform.position + wave_speed *  unity_class.time.deltaTime * move_dir

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_PowerWave_flame_End'):Instantiate(slash_wave.transform.position)
	slash_wave:Dispose()
end

function local_class:comment_cloud(str, height)
	yield_return_func(CS.MessyText.SetMessyText, game_string:GetString(str), vector(1.5, height),
			0, 9999, 40, 0, vector(-1.2, 0), 0.35, 10, CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 255, 255))
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareDungeonKingdomSurvivalSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareDungeonKingdomSurvival @
		Comment = 나이트메어 던전 왕국 2스테이지 서바이벌 챌린지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.survival_audience_name = 'survival_audience_'

	self.survival_talk_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_2_survival_talk_'
	self.survival_branch_name = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_2_survival_branch_'

	self.stage_marker_name = 'survival_stage_marker'
	self.road_marker_name = 'survival_road_marker'

	self.stage_zone_name = 'survival_zone'

	self.survival_follower_id = 56
	self.survival_mc = nil
	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 맨 처음 말 걸기 전
		first = 0,
		-- 이벤트 시작하기 전(두 번째 이후)
		idle = 1,
		-- 1단계
		on_event_1 = 2,
		-- 2단계
		on_event_2 = 3,
		-- 3단계
		on_event_3 = 4,
		-- 4단계
		on_event_4 = 5,
		-- 퀘스트 클리어
		clear = 6,
		-- 실패 후 부터 플레이어 리셋 전까지
		fail = 7
	}
	self.progress_state = self.progress_enum.first

	self.fail_routine = nil

	self.floors = {}
	self.audiences = {}

	self.mc_talking = true

	self.prev_party = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.survival_mc = get_character('survival_mc')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mc_self_talk, self))
	self.survival_mc.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.survival_mc = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:mc_self_talk()
	self.mc_talking = true
	while self.mc_talking do
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 'pre_1', life_time = 1.5})
		yield_return_func(self.yield_while, self, 5)
		if not self.mc_talking then
			break
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 'pre_2', life_time = 1.5})
		yield_return_func(self.yield_while, self, 5)
		if not self.mc_talking then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:yield_while(duration)
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		if not self.mc_talking then
			break
		end
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.survival_mc) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_mc, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, user_party.Leader) and
		self.progress_state ~= self.progress_enum.fail and
		(string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'floor2_4') or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_field_object('lava_origin'))) then

		if self.fail_routine ~= nil then return end
		self.fail_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.challenge_fail, self))
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_mc()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.mc_talking = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.survival_mc)

	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(ailie.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState) then
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToFollowingNpc(ailie, user_party, true,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(self.survival_mc, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')
	character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'left')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 'pre_1', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_jump_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 'pre_2', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'shoot'}, {name = 'smile'})
	-- 참가하시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

	local wait = true
	local join = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.survival_branch_name .. 0),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			join = true
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.survival_branch_name .. 1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.survival_mc, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not join then
		-- 많은 응원 부탁드릴께요!
		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
		clap_sfx:Stop()
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'smile'})
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mc_self_talk, self))

		for _, member in ipairs(user_party) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(ailie, member) then
				character_util.convert_to_npc(ailie)
				local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(ailie, user_party, 0, 0, true,
						CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
				ailie:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
				ailie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			end
			member = nil
		end

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	-- 네! 참가번호 15번이시고요.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	-- 휴식시간 끝나는 대로 바로 입장하실께요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'attack'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 용암타일 세팅
	yield_return_func(self.lava_setting, self)
	-- 관객 세팅
	yield_return_func(self.audience_setting, self)

	-- 생방 이벤트 세팅
	local stage_marker_pos = field:GetMarker(self.stage_marker_name).position
	character_util.set_position(self.survival_mc, stage_marker_pos + vector(-1, -1, -4), false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
	camera_util.move_async(stage_marker_pos + vector(0, -1, -4), 0)
	party_util.align_party(vector(stage_marker_pos.x + 1, 0, stage_marker_pos.z - 5), 'up', 0, 'arc')
	-- 체력 최대 설정
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = user_party.Leader
	heal_info.target = user_party.Leader
	heal_info.heal = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	-- 관객 세팅
	self:set_audience(nil, 'smile', true)
	self:party_wait()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_event', state = 'event', mix = 2.0 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.first then

		-- 자~ 안녕하세요, 뉴튜브 여러분!
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

		-- 서바이벌 챌린지 시간이 돌아왔습니다-!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

		-- 앞서 14명의 참가자들은 모두 성공하지 못 하고…
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		-- 한 줌의 재가 되어버렸는데요.
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

		-- 시작하기 전에 다음 도전자의 각오 한 번 들어볼까요?
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 9, skip = true})

		-- 15번 참가자? 지금 소감이 어떠신가요?
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 10, skip = true})

		wait = true
		local answer = -1

		branches:Clear()
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.survival_branch_name .. 2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				answer = 0
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.survival_branch_name .. 3),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				answer = 1
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.survival_branch_name .. 4),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				answer = 2
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.survival_mc, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end


		if answer == 0 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'scared'})
			character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.05, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			-- 하하, 농담도 잘 하시는 군요.
		elseif answer == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			-- 하하, 꽤 과묵한 참가자 분이시군요.
		else
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'cross_arm'}, {name = 'doyagao'})
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			-- 하하, 자신감이 넘치시는 군요!
		end

		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 11 + answer, skip = true})
		clap_sfx:Stop()

		self.progress_state = self.progress_enum.idle

	end
	-- 자, 그럼 이번 참가자 분은 레전드가 될 수 있을지 살펴볼까요?
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.survival_mc, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 14, skip = true})

	-- 도전~ 시작합니다!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_pvp_start_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.survival_mc, {name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.survival_mc, {key = self.survival_talk_name .. 15, skip = true})

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.challenge_1, self))
end

function local_class:challenge_fail()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.progress_state = self.progress_enum.fail
	user_party.Leader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 실패시 연출
	camera_util.move_async(self.survival_mc.Position, 1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')

	-- 플레이어가 강제로 초기 위치에 배치되어 첫 위치의 타일에서 이동하지 않을 시 피격되지 않는 버그가 있었습니다.
	-- 초기 위치에 해당하는 타일에 stepper로 플레이어를 강제로 등록시켜 해당 버그 수정합니다.
	message_system:Send(self.floors['lava_5_5'], CS.Oak.LavaTrapStepOnEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	local lava_set = {
		-- 1 wave
		{{1,1}, {1,2}, {2,1}, {2,2}},
		-- 2 wave
		{{3,1}, {3,2}, {4,1}, {4,2}},
		-- 3 wave
		{{3,3}, {3,4}, {4,3}, {4,4}},
		-- 4 wave
		{{1,3}, {1,4}, {2,3}, {2,4}}
	}
	-- lava_set의 패턴을 전부 90도씩 회전시켜 lava_pattern에 넣는다.
	local lava_pattern = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local pattern = {}
		for n = 0, 3 do
			pattern[n+1] = self:rotate_set(8, lava_set[n + 1], i)
		end
		lava_pattern[i] = pattern
	end

	self:manual_lava_wave(1, lava_pattern[1])
	self:manual_lava_wave(1, lava_pattern[2])
	self:manual_lava_wave(1, lava_pattern[3])
	self:manual_lava_wave(1, lava_pattern[4])
	yield_return_func(self.wait_for_fail, self, 4)

	self:manual_lava_wave(0.5, lava_pattern[2])

	self:manual_lava_wave(0.5, lava_pattern[4])

	end

-- 파티를 먼 위치에 대기시킨다.
function local_class:party_wait()
	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	if lua_helper.type_compare(ailie.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState) then
		CS.Oak.ICharacterExtensions.ConvertToFollowingNpc(ailie, user_party, true,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
	end
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[1]
		table.insert(self.prev_party, member)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

-- 대기중인 파티를 다시 합류시킨다.
function local_class:party_call()
	local ailie = get_character('ailie')
	local craig = get_character('craig')
	for _, member in ipairs(self.prev_party) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(ailie, member) then
			local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(ailie, user_party, 0, 0, true,
					CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
			ailie:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
			ailie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(craig, member) then
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party, true)
			member.Position = user_party.Leader.Position
		else
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party, false)
			member.Position = user_party.Leader.Position
		end
		member = nil
	end
	self.prev_party = {}
end

function local_class:lava_setting()
	-- 용암 발판 인덱스 받아오기
	local origin = get_field_object("lava_origin")
	local center = field:GetMarker("lava_stage_center").position
	local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3.one * 8)
	local move = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bound, move)

	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local v = list[i]
		if string.find(v.Name, 'floor2_4') or lua_helper.reference_equals(v, origin) then
			local x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(v.Position.x - origin.Position.x + 1)
			local z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(1 + origin.Position.z - v.Position.z)
			local key = 'lava_' .. x .. '_' .. z
			self.floors[key] = v

			self:reset_close_lava(v)
			--CS.Debug.LogError(string.format("%s = %s", key, v.Name))

		end
	end
end

-- x좌표와 y좌표를 받고 그에 대응되는 용암 타일의 이름을 반환한다. (1~n, 1~m)
function local_class:get_lava_name(xpos, ypos)
	return 'lava_' .. xpos .. '_' .. ypos
end

-- 용암 타일 테이블에서 x좌표와 y좌표에 대응되는 용암 타일을 반환한다.
function local_class:get_lava_tile(lava_table, xpos, ypos)

end

-- 실패하면 즉시 끝나는 대기용 루틴
function local_class:wait_for_fail(duration)
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.fail then
			break
		end
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 타일 전체 모양이 정사각형 형태여야 한다.
function local_class:rotate_pos(scale, pos, count)
	count = lua_helper.get_or_default(count, 1)
	local new_pos = pos
	for i = 1, count do
		new_pos = {scale + 1 - new_pos[2], new_pos[1]}
	end
	return new_pos
end

-- 타일 전체 모양이 정사각형 형태여야 한다.
function local_class:rotate_set(scale, set, count)
	local new_set = {}
	for _, pos in ipairs(set) do
		table.insert(new_set, self:rotate_pos(scale, pos, count))
	end
	return new_set
end

	return new_pos
end

-- 좌표를 상하 반전시킨다
function local_class:mirror_y_pos(y_scale, pos)
	local new_pos = pos
	new_pos = {new_pos[1], y_scale + 1 - new_pos[2]}
	return new_pos
end

-- 좌표 집단을 좌우 반전시킨다
function local_class:mirror_x_set(scale, set)

-- 매 interval마다 x_dist, y_dist만큼 진행하며 용암을 분출하는 패턴
-- interval : 패턴 사이의 시간 간격
-- count : 패턴이 진행될 횟수
-- x_offset : 시작점의 x좌표
-- y_offset : 시작점의 y좌표
-- x_dist : interval마다 x축으로 진행할 거리
-- y_dist : interval마다 y축으로 진행할 거리
-- width : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 용암이 분출될 면적의 너비
-- height : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 용암이 분출될 면적의 높이
function local_class:linear_lava_wave(interval, count, x_offset, y_offset, x_dist, y_dist, width, height)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		width = lua_helper.get_or_default(width, 1)
		height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 1)
		local x_level = x_offset
		local y_level = y_offset
		local counter = 0
		while counter < count do
			if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.fail then
				break
			end
			for i = 0, width - 1 do
				for j = 0, height - 1 do
					local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, x_level + i, y_level + j)
					if not is_unity_null(lava) then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
								self.activate_lava, self, lava, 1))
					end
				end
			end
			x_level = x_level + x_dist
			y_level = y_level + y_dist
			counter = counter + 1
			wait_for_sec(interval)
		end
	end))
end

-- 매 interval마다 x_dist, y_dist만큼 진행하며 용암을 분출하는 패턴
-- interval : 패턴 사이의 시간 간격
-- waypoints : 목표지점들의 테이블
-- dist : interval마다 진행할 거리(칸)
-- width : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 용암이 분출될 면적의 너비
-- height : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 용암이 분출될 면적의 높이
function local_class:waypoint_lava_wave(interval, waypoints, dist, width, height)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		width = lua_helper.get_or_default(width, 1)
		height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 1)
		local x_level = waypoints[1][1]
		local y_level = waypoints[1][2]
		for _, pos in ipairs(waypoints) do
			while true do
				if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.fail then
					break
				end
				for i = 0, width - 1 do
					for j = 0, height - 1 do
						local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, x_level + i, y_level + j)
						if not is_unity_null(lava) then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
									self.activate_lava, self, lava, 1))
						end
					end
				end
				if x_level == pos[1] and y_level == pos[2] then break end
				if x_level < pos[1] then x_level = x_level + dist end
				if x_level > pos[1] then x_level = x_level - dist end
				if y_level < pos[2] then y_level = y_level + dist end
				if y_level > pos[2] then y_level = y_level - dist end
				wait_for_sec(interval)
			end
		end
	end))
end

-- 매 interval마다 x_dist, y_dist만큼 진행하며 타일을 안전하게 뒤집는 패턴
-- interval : 패턴 사이의 시간 간격
-- waypoints : 목표지점들의 테이블
-- dist : interval마다 진행할 거리(칸)
-- width : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 타일이 뒤집힐 면적의 너비
-- height : 현재 타일 기준으로 동시에 타일이 뒤집힐 면적의 높이
function local_class:waypoint_safe_wave(interval, waypoints, dist, width, height, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		width = lua_helper.get_or_default(width, 1)
		height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 1)
		local x_level = waypoints[1][1]
		local y_level = waypoints[1][2]
		for _, pos in ipairs(waypoints) do
			while true do
				if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.fail then
					break
				end
				for i = 0, width - 1 do
					for j = 0, height - 1 do
						local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, x_level + i, y_level + j)
						if not is_unity_null(lava) then
							coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
									self.close_lava, self, lava, duration))
						end
					end
				end
				if x_level == pos[1] and y_level == pos[2] then break end
				if x_level < pos[1] then x_level = x_level + dist end
				if x_level > pos[1] then x_level = x_level - dist end
				if y_level < pos[2] then y_level = y_level + dist end
				if y_level > pos[2] then y_level = y_level - dist end
				wait_for_sec(interval)
			end
		end
	end))
end

-- 매 interval마다 x_dist, y_dist만큼 진행하며 타일을 안전하게 뒤집는 패턴
-- interval : 패턴 사이의 시간 간격
-- tilemap : 수동으로 입력된 용암 타일 패턴
function local_class:manual_lava_wave(interval, tilemap)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		for _, tileset in ipairs(tilemap) do
			if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.fail then
				break
			end
			for _, tile in ipairs(tileset) do
				local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, tile[1], tile[2])
				if not is_unity_null(lava) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
							self.activate_lava, self, lava, 1))
				end
			end
			wait_for_sec(interval)
		end
	end))
end

-- 특정 타일 좌표 집단만을 주기적으로 용암이 분출되도록 활성화시킨다
function local_class:activate_target_lava(target)
	for _, pos in ipairs(target) do
		local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, pos[1], pos[2])
		if not is_unity_null(lava) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.activate_lava, self, lava))
		end
	end
end

-- 특정 타일 좌표 집단만을 주기적으로 용암이 분출되지 않도록 비활성화시킨다
function local_class:deactivate_target_lava(target)
	for _, pos in ipairs(target) do
		local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, pos[1], pos[2])
		if not is_unity_null(lava) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.deactivate_lava, self, lava))
		end
	end
end

-- 특정 타일 좌표 집단만을 제외하고 모든 타일에서 주기적으로 용암이 분출되도록 활성화시킨다
function local_class:activate_all_lava(exception)
	exception = lua_helper.get_or_default(exception, {})
	for _, floor in pairs(self.floors) do
		local skip = false
		for _, exc in ipairs(exception) do
			local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, exc[1], exc[2])
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(floor, lava) then
				skip = true
			end
		end
		if not skip then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.activate_lava, self, floor))
		end
	end
end

-- 특정 타일 좌표 집단만을 제외하고 모든 타일이 안전하도록 닫는다.
function local_class:close_all_lava(exception)
	exception = lua_helper.get_or_default(exception, {})
	for _, floor in pairs(self.floors) do
		local skip = false
		for _, exc in ipairs(exception) do
			local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, exc[1], exc[2])
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(floor, lava) then
				skip = true
			end
		end
		if not skip then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.close_lava, self, floor))
		end
	end
end

-- 특정 타일 좌표 집단만을 제외하고 모든 타일이 안전하도록 비활성화 시킨다.
function local_class:deactivate_all_lava(exception)
	exception = lua_helper.get_or_default(exception, {})
	for _, floor in pairs(self.floors) do
		local skip = false
		for _, exc in ipairs(exception) do
			local lava = self:get_lava_tile(self.floors, exc[1], exc[2])
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(floor, lava) then
				skip = true
			end
		end
		if not skip then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.deactivate_lava, self, floor))
		end
	end
end

-- 상태에 관계 없이 즉시 용암을 분출할 수 있는 열림 상태로 전환
-- duration 값을 받으면 해당 시간 이후 용암을 분출하지 않는 열림 상태로 전환
function local_class:activate_lava(lava, duration)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	behav:Open(true, true)
	behav:Activate(true)

	if duration ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		self:deactivate_lava(lava)
	end
end

-- 상태에 관계 없이 즉시 용암을 분출하지 않는 열림 상태로 전환
-- duration 값을 받으면 해당 시간 이후 용암을 분출할 수 있는 상태로 전환
function local_class:deactivate_lava(lava, duration)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	--behav:Close(false)
	behav:Close(true)
	behav:Open(true, false)

	if duration ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.clear then return end
		self:activate_lava(lava)
	end
end

-- 상태에 관계 없이 닫힘 상태로 전환되며 닫힘 연출 재생
-- duration 값을 받으면 해당 시간 이후 주기적으로 용암을 분출하는 열림상태로 전환되며 열림 연출 재생
function local_class:close_lava(lava, duration)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	behav:Close(false)
	--behav:Close(true)

	if duration ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.clear then return end
		yield_return_func(self.open_lava, self, lava)
	end
end

-- 닫혀있는 상태에서 주기적으로 용암을 분출할 수 있는 열린 상태로 전환 및 전환 연출 재생
-- duration 값을 받으면 해당 시간 이후 닫힘상태로 전환 되며 닫힘 연출 재생
function local_class:open_lava(lava, duration)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	behav:Open()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	behav:Activate(true)

	if duration ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		yield_return_func(self.close_lava, self, lava)
	end
end

-- 전환 효과 없이 즉시 열림 상태로 전환 (타일 전환시 sfx가 재생되기 때문에 초기화가 필요한 상황에서는 이 함수를 호출해야 함)
-- 열려있지만, 주기적으로 용암을 분출하지 않도록 세팅
function local_class:reset_lava(lava)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	behav:Close(true)
	behav:Open(true, false)
end

-- 전환 효과 없이 즉시 닫힘 상태로 전환 (타일 전환시 sfx가 재생되기 때문에 초기화가 필요한 상황에서는 이 함수를 호출해야 함)
-- duration 값을 받으면 해당 시간 이후 용암을 분출하는 상태로 전환
function local_class:reset_close_lava(lava, duration)
	local behav = lava.FieldObjectBehaviour
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(behav, CS.Oak.LavaTrapFieldObjectBehaviour) then return end

	behav:Close(true)
	--behav:Close(true)

	if duration ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(duration)
		if self.progress_state == self.progress_enum.clear then return end
		yield_return_func(self.open_lava, self, lava)
	end
end

return local_class

	self.gun_fire_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun")

	return true

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:zombie_jump(madien, target_pos, speed, direction)
	madien.LockedDirection = direction
	character_util.set_anim(madien, {name = "walk4legs"})
	info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(target_pos, speed, true, direction)
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(madien, info)
	character_util.jump(madien, 1, info:GetDuration(madien.Position))
end

-- 주변 풀숲이 흔들리는 연출
function local_class:leaf_shake()
	local shake_cnt = 0
	while true do
		for i = 0, 13 do
			local leaves = get_field_object(string.format("leaf_%d", i))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(leaves.Transform, 0.2, 0.3))
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))

		for i = 14, 22 do
			local leaves = get_field_object(string.format("leaf_%d", i))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(leaves.Transform, 0.2, 0.3))
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

		if shake_cnt % 2 == 1 then
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))
		end

		shake_cnt = shake_cnt + 1
	end
end

-- 라즈베리 부쉬가 흔들리는 연출
function local_class:bush_shake(bush_count)
	local shake_cnt = 0
	while true do
		self:play_bush_shake_sfx()

		for i = 0, bush_count - 1 do
			local maiden_bush = get_field_object(string.format("maiden_bush_%d", i))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake(maiden_bush.Transform, 0.2, 0.3))

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_forest_1'

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.boss = nil
	self.panda = nil
	self.man = nil
	self.poacher_lady = nil
	self.student = nil

	self.section_inner_progress = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')

	self.boss = get_character("trio_boss")
	self.panda = get_character("trio_panda")
	self.man = get_character("trio_man")
	self.poacher_lady = get_character("poacher_lady")
	self.student = get_character("gallery_2")

	self.poacher_lady.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.student.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self.poacher_lady.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.student.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.boss = nil
	self.panda = nil
	self.man = nil
	self.poacher_lady = nil
	self.student = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		self:on_throw_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "main_trio_zone" and self.section_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.section_inner_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_appear, self, true))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.poacher_lady) and
		self.section_inner_progress == 0 then

		self.section_inner_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_appear, self, false))
		self.poacher_lady.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.student) then

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.student,
			{key = "nightmare_forest_main_s2_npc_15", bubble_type = "shout"})

		self.student.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

		return true
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('forest_main_new_section3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareForestMain @
		Comment = 괴물들에게 당한 트리오, 주인공도 기괴한 괴물과 마주한다. @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_forest_3'

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.trio_progress = 0
	self.is_trio_runaway = false
	self.is_maiden_eat = false
	self.is_maiden_fade = false
	self.boss = nil
	self.panda = nil
	self.man = nil
	self.dying_monster = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent), 'on_event')

	self.boss = get_character("trio_boss")
	self.panda = get_character("trio_panda")
	self.man = get_character("trio_man")
	self.dying_monster = get_character("dying_monster")

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		self.boss.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.panda.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.man.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.boss = nil
	self.panda = nil
	self.man = nil
	self.dying_monster = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent) then
		self:on_player_gather_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "main_trio_talk_zone" and self.trio_progress == 0 and not self.is_trio_runaway then
		self.do_hide_and_seek = true
		self.hide_and_seek_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_hide_and_seek, self))
	elseif zone_name == "main_trio_teleport_zone" and self.trio_progress == 0 then
		self.trio_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_teleport, self))
	elseif zone_name == "main_trio_fight_zone" and self.trio_progress == 1 then
		self.trio_progress = 2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_fight, self))
	elseif zone_name == "main_maiden_eat" and not self.is_maiden_eat then
		self.is_maiden_eat = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_eat, self))
	elseif zone_name == "main_maiden_fade" and not self.is_maiden_fade then
		self.is_maiden_fade = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_fade, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "main_trio_talk_zone" and self.trio_progress == 0 then
		self.do_hide_and_seek = false
		stop_coroutine(self.hide_and_seek_coroutine)
	end
end

function local_class:on_player_gather_event(e)
	local trio_bush = get_field_object("trio_bush")
	if self.trio_progress == 0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Gatherable, trio_bush)then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.trio_runaway_1, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.boss) or
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.man) or
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.panda) then
		-- if self.trio_progress == 1 then
		-- 	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
		-- 		util.cs_generator(self.trio_runaway_1, self))
		-- else
		if self.trio_progress == 2 then
			self.trio_progress = 3
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.trio_runaway_2, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trio_hide_and_seek()
	local trio = {self.boss, self.panda, self.man}
	local start_target_pos = {vector(9.9, -0.6, 0.9), vector(9.9, -0.3, 1), vector(10, -0.6, 0.9)}
	local end_target_pos = {vector(9.9, 0, 1.4), vector(9.3, 0, 1), vector(10.6, 0, 1)}
	local trio_bush = get_field_object("trio_bush")

	while self.do_hide_and_seek do
		local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - trio_bush.Position).magnitude

		if dist > 4 then dist = 4 end

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_target_pos[i], end_target_pos[i], dist / 4)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(move_util.move_to_routine, trio[i], pos, { duration = 0}))
			trio[i].Direction = (user_party_leader.Position - trio[i].Position):ToDirection()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:trio_fight()

	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage_camera:Move(vector(32.6, 1, -38), 1)

	-- 판다의 비명
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_01', parent = self.panda
	})

	-- bgm_transition: Field (bgm_forest_bright) -> Event(bgm_trio_non_fight), 2
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'bgm_trio_non_fight', state = 'event', mix = 2
	})

	for j = 0, 3 do
		local duration

		-- 적당한 위치에서 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = movers[1].Position })

		for i = 0, 6 do
			local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(movers[i+1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				1.5, false, movers[i+1].Direction)
			duration = info:GetDuration(movers[i+1].Position)

			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(movers[i+1], info)
		end

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration + 0.2))
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.boss,
		{key = "nightmare_forest_main_s3_0", skip = true, portraitname = "trio_boss.png", bubble_direction = "lb"})
		-- 놔! 얜 먹이가 아니라고!

	for j = 0, 2 do
		local duration
		local last_speed = 0.4
		local move_distance = 0.2

		if j == 2 then
			move_distance = 0.5
		end

		-- 적당한 위치에서 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = movers[1].Position })

		for i = 0, 6 do
			local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(movers[i+1].Position + vector((-1 + (j % 2 * 2)) * move_distance, 0, 0),
				0.8, false, movers[i+1].Direction)
			duration = info:GetDuration(movers[i+1].Position)

			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(movers[i+1], info)
		end

		self.boss.SpineController:Rotate(-14 * (-1 + (j % 2 * 2)), duration)
		self.man.SpineController:Rotate(-14 * (-1 + (j % 2 * 2)), duration)

		if j ~= 2 then

			-- 적당한 위치에서 재생

			for i = 0, 6 do

				duration = info:GetDuration(movers[i+1].Position)

				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(movers[i+1], info)

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration))

			-- 반항

				local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(movers[i+1].Position + vector((-1 + (j % 2 * 2)) * -0.3, 0, 0),
					1.2, false, movers[i+1].Direction)
				duration = info:GetDuration(movers[i+1].Position)

				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(movers[i+1], info)
			end

			-- 적당한 위치에서 재생
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = movers[1].Position })

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(duration + 0.1))

			duration = info:GetDuration(movers[i+1].Position)

			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(movers[i+1], info)

		-- 적당한 위치에서 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', play_pos = movers[1].Position })

		end
		if j == 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', play_pos = self.panda.Position })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.panda,

		movers[i+1]:RemoveLockedDirection(movers[i+1])
	end

	-- 떨어지기 직전 sfx
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')

function local_class:fall_down(char, target_position, cliff)
	local fall_time = 0.7

	if cliff then
		character_util.remove_anim(char, true)
		character_util.set_anim(char, { name = "cliff" })
		character_util.set_emotion(char, { name = "surprise" })

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
		fall_time = 0.7
	-- else
		-- fall_time = 0.5
	end

	local cur_pos = char.Position
	local target_pos = target_position
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(3, 37, 1, 2)
	free_fall:SetElasticity(0.8)

	character_util.set_anim(char, { name = "embarrassed" })

	char.SpineController:Rotate(360, fall_time)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		local curX = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, cur_pos.x, target_pos.x - cur_pos.x, fall_time);
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local distY = free_fall:GetDistance();
		local curZ = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, cur_pos.z, target_pos.z - cur_pos.z, fall_time);

		character_util.set_position(char, vector(curX, distY, curZ), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_position(char, target_pos, false)
	char.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(char, { name = "prostrate" })
	character_util.set_emotion(char, { name = "confused" })
	char:CancelShake()
	char.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	char.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
end

local local_class = newclass('forest_main_new_section5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareForestMain @
		Comment = 여관 주인들과 전투, 그 후 사건의 전말을 듣는다. 그리고..? @
		Index = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.section_inner_progress = 0

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_forest_6'
	self.immediately_start = false
	self.maiden = nil

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	-- boss 배틀음악 프리로드
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
		stage.StageGameObject, music_player:PreloadMusic('bgm_battle_boss')
	)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent), 'on_event')

	self.immediately_start = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 4)

	self.maiden = get_character("maiden")
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_npcs, self))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_EliteBuff_aura_B')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	if self.immediately_start and self.section_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.section_inner_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_battle_1, self))
	else
		-- 꽃 미리 열어준다
		self.controller:flower_animation("idle")
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then

	end

	self.maiden = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DyingEndEvent) then
		self:on_dying_end_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "main_flower_zone" and self.section_inner_progress == 0 then
		self.section_inner_progress = 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_battle_1, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if (e.BattleGroupName == "main_section_5_battle_1") then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_battle_2, self))
	elseif (e.BattleGroupName == "main_section_5_battle_2") then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.maiden_battle_3, self))
	elseif (e.BattleGroupName == "main_section_5_battle_3") then
		if self.section_inner_progress == 2 then
			-- CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("event start at eliminated")
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.close_flower, self))
		else
			self.section_inner_progress = 2

function local_class:on_dying_end_event(e)
	local boss_maiden = get_character("maiden_monster_3_7")
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, boss_maiden) then
		self.elite_effect:Dispose()
		if self.section_inner_progress == 2 then
			-- CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("event start at dying")
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.close_flower, self))
		else
			self.section_inner_progress = 2
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_mass_maiden()

	local maiden_pos = field:GetMarker("maiden_flower").position + vector(0, 0, 2)
	local odd = 3
	local odd_counter = 0
	local z_pos = maiden_pos.z
	local start_x_pos = maiden_pos.x
	for i = 0, 37 do
		local maiden = get_character(string.format("maiden_zombie_%d", i))
		character_util.set_active_state(maiden, "enabled")
		maiden_pos.x = start_x_pos + (i - odd_counter + odd - 2) * 1.2 - (math.ceil((odd - 2) / 2)) * 1.2
		maiden_pos.z = z_pos

		character_util.set_position(maiden, maiden_pos)

		if i == odd_counter then
			odd_counter = odd_counter + odd
			odd = odd + 2
			z_pos = z_pos + 0.8
			maiden_pos.x = start_x_pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:marian_and_marty_found_beta_weapon()
	-- 해당 구역 입장하면 컨트롤 빼앗기고 공주가 마티 주니어 왼쪽에 정렬해서 이벤트 진행.

	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local marty = self.get_marty_jr()
	local resistance_female = self.get_resistance_female()
	local resistance_male = self.get_resistance_male()
	character_util.set_active_state(marian, 'enabled')

	character_util.align_party(marty, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_typing_01')

	-- 마리안: (left, side, releasex2) 조심해야 해. 베타 웨폰은 메카 수트랑은 다르게 물리적으로 조종하는 게 아니니까.
