	character_util.set_animation_n_times(marian, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 마티 주니어: (right, side, attack, 점프x2) 마리안, 이래뵈도 로봇 조종 10년차라고요!
	character_util.set_direction(marty,'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(marty, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(marty, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(marty)

	-- 공주: 뭐 해, 다들? (마티 주니어 left로 방향 돌림)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(marty, 'left')

	-- 마리안: (left, side, smile) 인베이더 놈들이 버리고 간 베타 웨폰을 써먹을 방법을 찾는 중이야.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 마리안: (left, side, smile, 점프x2) 생체 유닛을 가진 로봇이라니… 너무 아깝잖아! (마티 주니어 nodx2)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(marian)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(marty, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 마티 주니어: (right, attack 표정) 그럼, 갑니다!
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(marty, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(marty, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 마티 주니어가 마리오 점프로 시험관 향해 한칸 앞으로 점프, 시험관에 닿으면 페이드 아웃됨.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	local tube = self.get_beta_wp_tube()
	character_util.set_position(marty,tube.Position + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0), true)
	marty.SpineController:AddColor(marty.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.set_scale_factor(marty, marty.Name, 0.8)
	character_util.set_direction(marty, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(marty, { name = 'idle', loop = false, scale = 0.2 })

	character_util.move_to_async(marian, vector(tube.Position.x - 1.5, 0, marian.Position.z),

	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(marian, nil, 'silence')

	self.controller:change_tube(tube, true)

	-- 마리안: 성공이야!
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_jump_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(marian)

	marian.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 9
	resistance_female.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 7
	resistance_male.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 10

	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

function local_class:beta_weapon_get_congested()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.battle_beta_weapon

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- shout 말풍선으로 포, 폭주합니다!
	local bubble_pos = vector(10.5,0, 84)
	local princess = user_party.Leader
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = self.script_key .. 1,
	                                                       world_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_type = 'shout',
	                                                     scale = 1.5, skip = true})

	-- 컴퓨터 앞의 레지스탕스 모션 2배 되어 있고,
	local tube = self.get_beta_wp_tube()

	local resistance_female = self.get_resistance_female()
	character_util.set_anim(resistance_female, { name = 'dualgun_attack', loop = true, scale = 2 })

	-- 컴퓨터 위의 레지스탕스는 scared, embarrassed.
	local resistance_male = self.get_resistance_male()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(resistance_male, { name = 'embarrassed'}, { name = 'scared' })

	-- 마리안 위치 시험관 왼쪽으로 이동한 상태.
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	--character_util.set_position(marian, tube.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'release', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 공주 down 방향으로 돌아 emoticon_bubble_question 띄움.

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess , nil, 'question')

	-- 아래 npc들이 세로 중앙으로 오도록 카메라 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(tube.Position, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_enemy_attack_01')

	-- 마리안: (attack, release) 마티 주니어! 정신 차려!
	local swing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })
	swing_sfx:Stop()

	-- 레지스탕스(여) : 컨트롤러의 통제를 벗어납니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_typing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_female, { key = self.script_key .. 16, skip = true })

	-- 레지스탕스(남) : 벼, 병력이라도 더 충원해올까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(resistance_male, { key = self.script_key .. 17, skip = true })

	-- 마리안: (모션 유지) 컨트롤을… 컨트롤을 쥐고 있어야 해!!!
	swing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })
	swing_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.move_distance_async(marian, vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 돌아옴.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 컨트롤 돌아옴. 베타 웨폰 전투 종료 때까지 해당 npc들 oneline
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 마리안: (시험관 옆에서 eat하며) 젠장, 주니어…
	marian.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 7

	-- 컴퓨터 앞의 레지스탕스: (dualgun_attack 모션 속도 2배) 머, 먹통이에요!
	resistance_female.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 8

	-- 컴퓨터 위의 레지스탕스: (scared, embarrassed) 그, 그러니까 그냥 갖다 버리자고 했잖아요!
	resistance_male.Interactable.Talk = self.script_key .. 9
end

function local_class:boss_battle_beta_weapon()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.defeat_beta_weapon
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local beta_weapon = self.get_beta_weapon_battle()
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, beta_weapon.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
			1.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')

	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title[1], self.boss_title[2], 2)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(beta_weapon, 'beta_weapon')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(beta_weapon, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	for i = 1, 6 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('beta_wp_door_' .. i))
	end
	--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('beta_wp_door_2'))
end

function local_class:defeat_beta_weapon()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local marty = self.get_marty_jr()
	local marian = self.get_marian()
	local princess = user_party.Leader
	local tube = self.get_beta_wp_tube()
	local beta_weapon = self.get_beta_weapon()
	local beta_weapon_battle = self.get_beta_weapon_battle()

	-- 베타 웨폰 튜브 꺼주고, 마티 주니어 원상 복귀.
	self.controller:change_tube(tube, false)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(marty, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	marty.SpineController:ResetAllColors()
	character_util.remove_scale_factor(marty, marty.Name)
	character_util.remove_anim(marty)

	-- 연출용 베타 웨폰과 교체
	character_util.set_position(beta_weapon_battle, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(beta_weapon_battle, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_position(beta_weapon, vector(12.5, 0, 113))
	character_util.set_position(princess, vector(12.5, 0, 111))
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(beta_weapon, 'down')
	character_util.set_active_state(beta_weapon, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_anim(beta_weapon, { name = 'hurt', loop = true})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 중앙에서 베타 웨폰이 hurt 상태로 있다가, 펑 하고 터지는 이펙트와 함께 사라짐.

	local dead_state = CS.Oak.CharacterSmallExplosionState.Create(beta_weapon, 3, 0.2)
	message_system:Send(beta_weapon.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(dead_state))

	wait_for_sec(4)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.script_key .. 18, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marty)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marian)

	-- 아래에서 마리안, 마티 주니어(damaged 표정, 캐릭터 shake하며)가 올라와 공주 오른쪽에 정렬.
	character_util.set_emotion(marty, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.shake(marty, 0.025, 99999)

	character_util.set_position(marian, vector(14, 0, 105))
	character_util.set_position(marty, vector(14, 0, 104))
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(marty, 'up')

	-- 마리안: 공주!
	local marian_dest = vector(marian.Position.x, marian.Position.y, princess.Position.z  + 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 11, skip = true })
	character_util.move_to_async(marian, marian_dest, 1, nil, true, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 마리안 : 덕분에 생체 유닛 가동을 겨우 중단했어…
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(marian, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 마리안: (idle) 큰일 날뻔했네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 15, skip = true })

	local marty_dest = vector(marty.Position.x, marty.Position.y, princess.Position.z  - 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(marty, marty_dest, 2, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(marty, 'left')

	-- 마티 주니어: (damaged, shake) 으으으… 죽는 줄 알았어요…
	character_util.set_emotion(marty, { name = 'damaged' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marty, { key = self.script_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 마리안: (tired, question) 정신나간 인베이더 놈들… 대체 뭘 만들어낸 거야…?
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(marian, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 13, skip = true })
	-- 마리아: (tired, question) : 제대로 연구하기 전에 무작정 실험을 강행한 나도 문제지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 20, skip = true })

	-- 마리안: (idle, nodx2) 아무튼, 고마워.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marian)
	character_util.nod_twice(marian)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(marian, { key = self.script_key .. 14, skip = true })

	-- 공주 nodx2.
	character_util.nod_twice(princess)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 마티 주니어: (damaged, shake) 으으으… 죽는 줄 알았어요…
	marty.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_beta_wp_post_1'

	-- 마리안: (tired, question) 인베이더처럼 정신나간 놈들의 기술이라면 위험할 걸 예상했어야 했는데…
	character_util.set_direction(marian, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(marian, { name = 'tired' })
	marian.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_beta_wp_post_2'

	local resistance_female = self.get_resistance_female()
	resistance_female.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_beta_wp_post_3'
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_female)
	resistance_female:HideWeapon(true)

	local resistance_male = self.get_resistance_male()
	resistance_male.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_beta_wp_post_4'
	character_util.set_emotion(resistance_male, { name = 'tired' })
	resistance_male:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.remove_anim(resistance_male)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastle2ClayShootingPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastle2ClayShooting @
		Comment = NightmareFutureCastle2ClayShooting 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_male = function(num) return get_character('clay_shoot_male_'..num) end
	self.get_sniper = function() return get_character('sniper') end

	self.zone_name ='clay_talk'

	self.zone_in_check = false
	self.first_talk_check = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	character_util.add_listener(sniper, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_anim(sniper)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(sniper)
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'attack' })

	local male_1 = self.get_male(1)
	local male_2 = self.get_male(2)
	male_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')
	male_2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')

	character_util.set_anim(male_1, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(male_2, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	-- 호흡을 가다듬고… 하나, 둘…!
	male_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_1'
	male_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_1'


	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(sniper, self.controller)
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sniper()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.request_sniper, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name) and not self.zone_in_check then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sniper_talk, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:sniper_talk()
	self.zone_in_check = true

	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	local male_1 = self.get_male(1)
	local male_2 = self.get_male(2)

	character_util.shake(male_1, 0.02, 9999)
	character_util.shake(male_2, 0.02, 9999)

	-- 나참, 눈을 뜨고는 있는 거야? 진짜 이해가 안 되네!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_2' })

	-- 조준하긴 했는데…
	male_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_5'
	-- 왜 이렇게 안 보이지…
	male_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_3_0'

	if self.first_talk_check then return end
	-- 조준하긴 했는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_3' })

	-- 눈 제대로 뜨고! 조준 딱 해서!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = sniper, loop = false })
	character_util.normal_jump(sniper, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_3_1' })

	-- 빵!
	sniper.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gun_ready_01', parent = sniper, loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_3_2' })
	sniper.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	if self.first_talk_check then return end

	-- 이게 어려워?!
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_4' })

	character_util.stop_shake(male_1)
	character_util.stop_shake(male_2)
end

function local_class:request_sniper()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	local male_1 = self.get_male(1)
	local male_2 = self.get_male(2)

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(sniper)

	character_util.remove_anim(sniper)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sniper)

	if not self.first_talk_check then
		self.first_talk_check = true
		party_util.align_to_target(sniper, 'left', 1, 'arc')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(sniper, user_party.Leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 공주! 이게 얼마 만이야~?
		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_6', skip = true })

		-- 그러게. 사격 훈련 중이야?
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_7', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		-- 맞아. 저딴 것도 사격이라고 부를 수 있다면 말이야.
		character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)
		character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_8', skip = true })

		-- 정말 조준했어요…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.look_at(male_1, sniper)
		character_util.set_emotion(male_1, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.shake(male_1, 0.02, 555)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_9', skip = true })

		character_util.stop_shake(male_1)
		character_util.stop_shake(male_2)

		-- 총구만 겨누면 조준이냐?! 눈을 제대로 떠야 할 거 아냐!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.look_at(sniper, male_1)
		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_10', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gun_ready_01')
		character_util.set_direction(male_1, 'up')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(sniper, nil, 'notice')
	else
		party_util.align_to_target(sniper, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	end

	-- 그렇지! 공주가 얘네한테 한 번 시범을 보여주는 게 어때?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.look_at(sniper, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.normal_jump(sniper, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_11', skip = true })

	-- 스트레스도 꽤 풀리고 좋을 거라고?
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_12', skip = true })

	-- 물론~ 공짜로 부탁할 수는 없으니까!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_13', skip = true })

	-- 명사수의 표본을 보여준다면 보상은 제대로 쳐줄게.
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_14', skip = true })

	-- 수락한다. / 거절한다.
	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if is_accepted then
		-- 그래, 한번 해볼게.
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_15', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		-- 후훗, 어디 공주 실력 좀 볼까?
		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_16', skip = true })

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		-- 아니, 지금은 좀…
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_17', skip = true })

		-- 뭐, 그래. 맘 바뀌면 와!
		character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_18', skip = true })
		character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'right')
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(sniper)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_male = function(num) return get_character('clay_shoot_male_'..num) end
	self.get_sniper = function() return get_character('sniper') end
	self.get_invader = function(num) return get_character('clay_shoot_end_'..num) end
	self.get_boss = function() return get_character('trio_boss') end
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('trio_man') end
	self.get_panda = function() return get_character('trio_panda') end

	self.get_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('clay_game_end') end

	-- 게임
	self.clay_shoot_game = nil
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'ClayShootingMiniGame'

	self.current_touch_event_type = nil
	self.qte_complete = false

	-- 스나이퍼 연출용 이펙트
	self.get_fx_targetcircle_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop') end
	self.get_fx_targetcircle_end = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_end') end

	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail',
			'custom_sprite',
			'fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop',
			'fx_targetcircle_typeb_end',
			'FX_dead'
	)

	self:preload_bullet_async()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	character_util.add_listener(sniper, self.controller)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == -1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mini_game_start, self, true))
	else
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(sniper)

		local male_1 = self.get_male(1)
		local male_2 = self.get_male(2)
		male_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')
		male_2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'nw_2000_sniper_rifle')

		character_util.set_anim(male_1, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
		character_util.set_anim(male_2, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

		-- 조준하긴 했는데…
		male_1.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_5'
		male_2.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_5'
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:mini_game_dispose()
	self.clay_shoot_game = nil
	self:dispose_bullet()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sniper()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.request_sniper, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
		return true
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent) then
		self:on_gamepad_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		self:mini_game_dispose()
		if e.Success then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_success, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_fail, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == self.current_touch_event_type then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:request_sniper()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local sniper = self.get_sniper()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(sniper)

	party_util.align_to_target(sniper, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	character_util.look_at(sniper, user_party.Leader)

	-- 어때, 이번에는 좀 잘할 수 있겠어?
	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(sniper, { name = 'release', count = 2 , sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_22', skip = true })

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if is_accepted then
		-- 그래, 한번 해볼게.
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_15', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

function local_class:preload_bullet_async()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
	self.sniper_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 총알 리소스 해제
function local_class:dispose_bullet()
	if self.sniper_bullet ~= nil then
		self.sniper_bullet:Dispose()
		self.sniper_bullet = nil
	end
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

-- 스나이퍼 씬 샷 연출
function local_class:shoot_to_target(start_pos, target, callback)
	local target_pos = target.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0.5)
	local bullet_speed = 100
	local effect_scale_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 1.1
	local effect_delay_ratio = bullet_speed / 30 * 0.5
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local end_pos = target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3
	local target_hit_hour = unity_class.vector3.Distance(start_pos, end_pos) / bullet_speed
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	local fx_rotation_2 = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		if target_hit_hour > effect_delay_ratio then
			wait_for_sec(target_hit_hour - effect_delay_ratio)
			local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
												   :Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.position, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		else
			local smoke_effect =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail')
												   :Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation_2, nil)
			smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(effect_scale_ratio, 1, 1)
		end
	end))
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	if callback ~= nil then
		callback()
	end
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_lavi = function() return get_character('lavi')  end
	self.get_favi = function() return get_character('favi')  end
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess')  end

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	-- 파비, 라비 존 진입 시 라비, 병사들에게 명령하는 이벤트 진행
	if zone_name == 'favi_lavi' and not self.is_lavi_order then
		self.is_lavi_order = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lavi_order_soldier, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lavi()) then
		-- 첫 대화 시(퀘스트 미완료) 컨트롤 제거 후 대화 이벤트 시작
		if not self.controller.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_lavi_favi, self)
		elseif not self.is_lavi_talking then
			self.is_lavi_talking = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_lavi, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_favi()) then
		-- 첫 대화 시(퀘스트 미완료) 컨트롤 제거 후 대화 이벤트 시작
		if not self.controller.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_lavi_favi, self)
		elseif not self.is_favi_talking then
			self.is_favi_talking = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_favi, self))
		end
		return true
	elseif table_util.contain_value({ self.get_soldier(1), self.get_soldier(2) }, e.Target) then
		-- 통로쪽 병사 둘 중 하나와 비교해 대화 함수로 넘어감
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_sentry_soldier, self, e.Target))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local passage_soldier_1 = self.get_soldier(1)
	local passage_soldier_2 = self.get_soldier(2)

	for i = 1, 6 do

local local_class = newclass('NightmareFutureCastle2GetAndroidHeadControllerSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = NightmareFutureCastle2GetAndroidHeadController @
		Comment = 머리 획득 까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_futurecastle_part2_3'

	-- 체스트
	self.chest = nil

	-- 안드로이드 머리 아이템 id
	self.head_id = 20403

	-- 안드로이드 큰 머리 아이템 id
	self.big_head_id = 20396

	-- 검은 안드로이드 머리 아이템 id
	self.head_dark_id = 20405
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.chest = get_field_object('center_box')

	if self.chest.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		-- 상자가 열렸으면 연출 본 것으로 판정해서 다음 섹션으로 넘어간다.
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_section, self))
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { "lorain_head_active_false" }))
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_highlight_item")
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded(_)
	local chest = get_field_object('center_box')

	if not chest.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { "lorain_head_active_false" }))
		end))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.chest) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_android_head, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:get_android_head()
	local android_head = get_field_object('broken_worker_a_head')
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local android_head_spine_controller = android_head.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
	local chest = self.chest
	local align_pos = chest.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -2.25)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	leader:HideWeapon(true)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, align_pos, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'get', upper = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })

	local holding_y_diff = (leader.Hitbox.size.y * 0.5) + (android_head.Hitbox.size.y * 0.5) + 0.35;
	local base_pos = leader.Hitbox:GetCenter(align_pos) - android_head.Hitbox:Pivot2Center()

	local start_v = align_pos
	local end_v = base_pos + vector(0, holding_y_diff, 0)
	local move_duration = 1.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_keyitem_01')

	-- 그림자 연출을 위해 스프라이트 사용
	local head_dark_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = start_v, itemid = self.head_dark_id,
			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
	head_dark_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
	head_dark_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0

	android_head_spine_controller.IsShadowActive = false
	android_head_spine_controller:AddColor('android_head', unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idle', true)

	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)

	local hightlighteffect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_highlight_item"):Instantiate(head_dark_item.Position)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local shadow_pos = head_dark_item.ShadowTransform.position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time <= 1.5 do
		local normalized = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 1.5)
		local current_v = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_v, end_v, normalized)

		android_head.Position = current_v

		head_dark_item.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_pos + vector(0, 0, normalized * -0.1)

		hightlighteffect.transform.localPosition = current_v + vector(0, 0.1, 0.15)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	android_head.Position = end_v

	hightlighteffect.transform.localPosition = end_v + vector(0, 0.1, 0.15)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	command_util.execute_holdup(leader, android_head, leader.Position, 0, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	head_dark_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	hightlighteffect:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_camera_emphasize_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.resize_to(2, 0.2)
	android_head_spine_controller:RemoveColor('android_head', 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	-- 죄송하지만 좀 내려주시죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_1', skip = true, scale = 0.8 })

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	-- 으악!
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 1 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	android_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	head_dark_item.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_pos
	head_dark_item.ConsumeTarget = nil
	head_dark_item:ConsumeComplete()

	android_head_spine_controller.IsShadowActive = true

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	command_util.execute_throw(leader, android_head, vector(1, 0, 0), leader.Position, 6, true)

	android_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('damaged', true)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })

	android_head_spine_controller.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	android_head_spine_controller:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'walk', true)

	start_v = android_head.Position
	end_v = leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	move_duration = (start_v - end_v).magnitude / 2

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_shake_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self:lerp_move(android_head, start_v, end_v, move_duration)

	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idle', true)
	android_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	android_head.Position = end_v

	for i = 1, 2 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		android_head_spine_controller:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
		android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	android_head_spine_controller:SetEmotion('idle', true)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 제 단잠을 깨우는 것도 모자라, 집어 던지기까지 하시다니.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_3', skip = true })

	-- 미, 미안… 갑자기 머리가 튀어나와서 놀랐어…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_4', skip = true })

	--  전 결함으로 인해 일하지 못하는 몸입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_5', skip = true })

	-- 네, 저도 정말 아쉽답니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_6', skip = true })

	-- 그럼 이만.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_7', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	android_head_spine_controller:Jump(1, move_duration)
	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'jump', false, 1, nil, nil, 'idle')

	start_v = android_head.Position
	end_v = vector(0.7, 1, 34)
	move_duration = (start_v - end_v).magnitude / 4

	self:lerp_move(android_head, start_v, end_v, move_duration, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	android_head_spine_controller:Rotate(-90, 0.1)

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 머리를 챙긴다
		{ 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_choice_1', 'normal' }
	})

	-- 이제야말로 아무 일도 하지 않을 수 있나 했는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_8', skip = true })

	-- 팔다리가 없는 안드로이드마저도 멋대로 갖다 써야 직성이 풀리시나보군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_9', skip = true })

	-- 마음대로 하십시오. 언제나처럼요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(android_head, { key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_10', skip = true })

	start_v = android_head.Position
	end_v = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1)
	move_duration = 0.5

	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'walk', true)

	self:lerp_move(android_head, start_v, end_v, move_duration, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	android_head_spine_controller:SetAnimation(base_track, 'idle', true)

	android_head.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,
			{ ItemId = self.big_head_id },
			'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_title',
			'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_subtitle',
			'nightmare_futurecastle_2_get_android_desc', 0.7)

	android_head.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	leader:HideWeapon(false)
	android_head_spine_controller:Rotate(0, 0)

	self:complete_section()
end

function local_class:complete_section()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(leader, { "lorain_head_active_true" }))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:lerp_move(fo, start_v, end_v, dur, is_flying, disable)
	local flying = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_flying, false)
	local disable_on = lua_helper.get_or_default(disable, false)
	local fo_spine_controller = fo.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time <= dur do
		local normalized = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / dur)
		local current_v = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_v, end_v, normalized)

		fo.Position = current_v

		if flying then
			fo_spine_controller.ShadowOffsetY = stage_util.get_height(current_v) - current_v.y
		end

		if disable_on then
			local current_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
					unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_scale, end_scale - start_scale, dur)
			fo.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * current_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = end_v
end

return local_class
